title: Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration
title_zh: 全局一致性：当每个智能体都正确而团队仍然错误——面向多智能体协作的局部到全局语义基础

paragraphs.en: AI agents now work together on shared code, documents, tools, and scientific analyses, often alongside people. No participant sees the whole state. Every step can look right on its own while the combined result is wrong. We call this the global coherence problem , and we argue that it is a problem of state , not only of intelligence: a stronger model makes better local decisions, but it cannot see what is not in its context, and it cannot make locally valid pieces fit together when they do not. Intelligence alone cannot guarantee a solution. To our knowledge, this paper is the first to formulate this as a failure class of AI agent systems in its own right and to synthesize the relevant limits into specifications for two practices builders already use for reliability, context engineering and the agent harness : what each agent’s context must contain, and what the harness around the agents must own and check.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，人工智能智能体在共享代码、文档、工具和科学分析方面协同工作，并且常常与人类并肩合作。 没有任何参与者能够看到整个状态的全貌。 每一步单独来看可能都正确，但综合结果却可能是错误的。 我们将此称为全局一致性问题，并认为这是一个状态问题，而不仅仅是智能性问题：更强的模型能做出更优的局部决策，但它无法看到其上下文之外的事物，也无法将局部有效的部分在它们实际上并不契合时强行组合起来。 仅凭智能本身无法保证问题的解决。 据我们所知，本文首次将这一问题明确界定为人工智能智能体系统的一种独立失效类型，并将相关限制整合为两种实践构建者已用于确保可靠性的规范：上下文工程与智能体框架——即每个智能体的上下文必须包含哪些内容，以及围绕智能体的框架必须拥有和检查哪些要素。

paragraphs.en: Our first result, the Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem , makes the missing-information case precise. A policy can guarantee a valid action from its context exactly when every world consistent with that context allows a common action. When two worlds look identical but require different actions, no amount of reasoning, deliberation, role decomposition, messaging, or randomization can guarantee the right choice. The best randomized policy succeeds with probability exactly 1 / k 1/k when k k indistinguishable worlds have disjoint valid actions, and a b b -bit hint raises this to at most 1 / ⌈ k / 2 b ⌉ 1/\lceil k/2^{b}\rceil . This is a theorem about context engineering: it says exactly what a context must contain. Choosing the smallest such context is NP-hard: putting everything in every window is rarely feasible, and finding the least that suffices is hard.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的第一个结果——观察别名不可能性定理——将缺失信息的情况具体化了。 一项策略能够从其上下文中保证有效行动，当且仅当与该上下文一致的所有世界都允许采取相同的行动。 当两个世界看起来完全相同却需要采取不同行动时，无论进行多少推理、权衡、角色分解、信息传递或随机化，都无法保证做出正确的选择。 当 k 个无法区分的世界具有互斥的有效行动时，最佳随机策略的成功概率恰好为 1/k；而一个 b 位的提示可将此概率提升至最多 1/⌈k/2^b⌉。 这是一个关于上下文工程的定理：它明确指出了上下文必须包含的内容。 选择最小的此类上下文是 NP-难问题：将每个窗口中的所有内容都包含进去通常并不可行，而找到足够的最小内容则十分困难。

paragraphs.en: The second failure survives full information. Three agents can each use a locally valid, inverse-consistent translation between neighboring units while the loop through all three does not close; three roles can each make a legal spend while the total breaks the budget. No local check identifies the global error, because it lives in how the pieces fit, not in any one piece. Checking harder locally does not solve this in general: pairwise checks suffice when overlaps are tree-like, cycles can defeat them, and no fixed locality bound works universally across unrestricted constraint semantics. The two failures are linked, and the link is the paper’s central construction. The impossibility theorem says which distinctions a harness must keep; the second failure is what happens when those distinctions are lost on the way, as state is split into local views, re-encoded between participants, or changed by actions. We give a principled synthesis for guarding all three steps: a topology of where things meet, sheaves for whether local states glue into one world, groupoids for which encodings mean the same thing, and categories for how actions compose over time. These structures are not uniquely forced machinery. Under explicit assumptions on local views, lossless translations, and state updates, each realizes a property that exact validation requires, and each becomes unnecessary when its corresponding map is absent. Version checks, dependency engines, ledgers, and escrow quotas are domain-specific realizations of the same requirements. The same language also prices the problem. Agreement across representations can be certified in linear time, yet finding the smallest repair can be NP-hard, and a shared budget cannot be protected by independent local checks at all: it must be enforced at commit or split into quotas. The design these two failures lead to goes further than a manager agent, which is one more participant with one more view and is bound by the same theorem: models propose, and a harness built on this framework decides what is allowed . The framework tells that harness its job: which distinctions it must own, where overlaps can hide global inconsistency, which loops of translation must close, and which changes must wait for commit.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个失效在完整信息下仍然存在。 三个智能体各自可以在相邻单元之间使用局部有效且逆一致的转换，但遍历全部三个单元时循环却无法闭合；三个角色各自都可以进行合法支出，但总支出却超出预算。 任何局部检查都无法识别全局错误，因为该错误存在于各部分如何契合的方式中，而非任何一个单独的部分里。 一般而言，加强局部检查也无法解决这个问题：当重叠关系呈树状结构时，成对检查就足够了；但循环结构会使其失效，且没有任何固定的局部性界限能普遍适用于无约束的语义体系。 这两个失效相互关联，而它们之间的关联正是本文的核心构造。 不可能性定理指明了约束框架必须保留哪些区别；当这些区别在状态被拆分为局部视图、在参与者之间重新编码或受行动影响而改变时，第二个失效便会发生。 我们提出了一种有原则的合成方法，用于保障全部三个步骤：通过拓扑结构描述各部分的交汇位置，通过层集判断局部状态能否粘合为一个统一世界，通过群胚确定哪些编码具有相同含义，并通过范畴描述行动如何随时间组合。 这些结构并非唯一强制性的机制。 在关于局部视图、无损转换和状态更新的明确假设下，每个结构都实现了精确验证所要求的某种属性；而当其对应的映射不存在时，该结构便不再必要。 版本检查、依赖引擎、账本和托管配额，都是相同需求在不同领域中的具体实现。 同一套语言体系也量化了该问题的代价。 不同表示之间的一致性可以在线性时间内得到认证，但找到最小的修复方案可能是 NP 难的；此外，独立的地方性检查完全无法保护共享预算——预算必须在提交时强制执行，或拆分为配额进行管理。 这两个失效所引导的设计超越了简单的管理智能体：后者不过是多一个参与者、多一个视图，并同样受该定理的约束；模型负责提出方案，而基于此框架构建的约束框架则决定哪些操作是允许的。 该框架明确告知约束框架其职责：必须保留哪些区别、哪些重叠可能隐藏全局不一致性、哪些转换循环必须闭合，以及哪些变更必须等待提交才能生效。

paragraphs.en: We test the theory in nine studies. A frontier LLM solves all 40 tasks of a revision benchmark when it can see the deciding event. With that event hidden, observed accuracy across tested reasoning, role, voting, and tool conditions is statistically compatible with guessing among three options ( 1 / 3 1/3 ); one sentence restoring the missing fact brings it to 40/40. On a preregistered 60-run TeamBench panel, ordinary agent teams overspend a shared 20-call budget in 5/5 runs, showing them the live count still leaves 4/5, and enforcing the budget at commit leaves 0/5; observed mean task progress does not fall in this five-seed comparison. A follow-up on the same task shows that fixed per-role escrow quotas also reach 0/5 violations, while an information-only counter still overspends in 4/5; progress comparisons between escrow and the ledger are descriptive because their attestation gates differ. Under an explicit unique-name diagnostic, public ontology-alignment networks contain pairwise-invisible same-ontology identity collisions in 23 of 45 networks from 2018–2024. Agents given split views reproduce such collisions in 9 of 40 merges, and a network-level check detects and removes all nine, although the send-to-all repair lowers mean F1 from 0.796 to 0.774. In a preregistered 222-episode τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench Telecom panel, ordinary policy checks tie our coherence harness where the injected change breaks a policy rule, as predicted; where a committed change is silently undone, agents with those checks score 0.07 on the benchmark’s own grader and agents with the harness score 1.00. Where a conventional tool already holds the relevant state—a dependency engine, a coupled solver—it matches our harness exactly, as the theory predicts. Across all nine studies the pattern is the one the theory draws: the harness wins where the deciding state is missing or unowned, and ties where a conventional tool already owns it. The proofs are complete and given in the appendices; the agent evidence uses one model family and modest panels, and scale is the next step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在九项研究中检验了这一理论。 当前沿 LLM 能够看到决定性事件时，它能完成修订基准测试中的全部 40 项任务。 在该事件被隐藏的情况下，在推理、角色、投票和工具等测试条件下观察到的准确率，在统计学上与三种选项中的随机猜测（1/3）一致；而仅用一句话恢复缺失的事实，就能使其达到 40/40。 在一个预先注册的包含 60 次运行的 TeamBench 面板中，普通智能体团队在所有 5 次运行中都超额使用了共享的 20 次调用预算，表明即使能看到实时计数，仍有 4/5 次超出预算；而在提交时强制执行预算限制后，则全部未超出（0/5）；观察到的平均任务进展在这五个种子组的比较中并未下降。 对同一任务的后续研究显示，按角色设定的固定预留额度同样导致 0/5 的违规率，而仅提供信息的对照组仍有 4/5 次超额使用；预留额度与账本之间的进展比较属于描述性分析，因为它们的验证机制不同。 在一项明确的唯一名称诊断测试中，2018 年至 2024 年间 45 个公共本体对齐网络中有 23 个存在同一本体内的、彼此不可见的身份冲突。 被给予分割视图的智能体在 40 次合并中有 9 次重现了此类冲突，而网络级别的检查能够检测并移除全部九处冲突，尽管“发送给所有”的修复方式将平均 F1 值从 0.796 降低到了 0.774。 在一个预先注册的包含 222 个回合的 τ²-bench Telecom 面板中，当注入的变化破坏了政策规则时，普通的政策检查与我们的一致性约束机制表现一致（如预测所示）；而当已提交的变化被静默撤销时，具备这些检查的智能体在该基准测试自身的评分器上得分为 0.07，而使用一致性约束机制的智能体则得分为 1.00。 当传统工具已经持有相关状态——例如依赖引擎或耦合求解器——时，其表现与我们的约束机制完全一致，正如理论所预测的那样。 在所有九项研究中，观察到的模式都与理论所描绘的一致：当决定性状态缺失或未由任何工具拥有时，一致性约束机制更胜一筹；而当传统工具已经拥有该状态时，两者表现相当。 证明过程是完整的，并附于附录中；智能体相关的证据基于单一模型家族和中等规模的面板，扩大规模是下一步的工作。

sents.zh: 对同一任务的后续研究显示，按角色设定的固定预留额度同样导致 0/5 的违规率，而仅提供信息的对照组仍有 4/5 次超额使用；预留额度与账本之间的进展比较属于描述性分析，因为它们的验证机制不同。

sents.en: Under an explicit unique-name diagnostic, public ontology-alignment networks contain pairwise-invisible same-ontology identity collisions in 23 of 45 networks from 2018–2024.
sents.zh: 在一项明确的唯一名称诊断测试中，2018 年至 2024 年间 45 个公共本体对齐网络中有 23 个存在同一本体内的、彼此不可见的身份冲突。

sents.en: Agents given split views reproduce such collisions in 9 of 40 merges, and a network-level check detects and removes all nine, although the send-to-all repair lowers mean F1 from 0.796 to 0.774.
sents.zh: 被给予分割视图的智能体在 40 次合并中有 9 次重现了此类冲突，而网络级别的检查能够检测并移除全部九处冲突，尽管“发送给所有”的修复方式将平均 F1 值从 0.796 降低到了 0.774。

sents.en: In a preregistered 222-episode τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench Telecom panel, ordinary policy checks tie our coherence harness where the injected change breaks a policy rule, as predicted; where a committed change is silently undone, agents with those checks score 0.07 on the benchmark’s own grader and agents with the harness score 1.00.
sents.zh: 在一个预先注册的包含 222 个回合的 τ²-bench Telecom 面板中，当注入的变化破坏了政策规则时，普通的政策检查与我们的一致性约束机制表现一致（如预测所示）；而当已提交的变化被静默撤销时，具备这些检查的智能体在该基准测试自身的评分器上得分为 0.07，而使用一致性约束机制的智能体则得分为 1.00。

sents.en: Where a conventional tool already holds the relevant state—a dependency engine, a coupled solver—it matches our harness exactly, as the theory predicts.
sents.zh: 当传统工具已经持有相关状态——例如依赖引擎或耦合求解器——时，其表现与我们的约束机制完全一致，正如理论所预测的那样。

sents.en: Across all nine studies the pattern is the one the theory draws: the harness wins where the deciding state is missing or unowned, and ties where a conventional tool already owns it.
sents.zh: 在所有九项研究中，观察到的模式都与理论所描绘的一致：当决定性状态缺失或未由任何工具拥有时，一致性约束机制更胜一筹；而当传统工具已经拥有该状态时，两者表现相当。

sents.en: The proofs are complete and given in the appendices; the agent evidence uses one model family and modest panels, and scale is the next step.
sents.zh: 证明过程是完整的，并附于附录中；智能体相关的证据基于单一模型家族和中等规模的面板，扩大规模是下一步的工作。

paragraphs.en: Consider a three-agent team on a TeamBench task [ 51 ] : a Planner writes the plan, an Executor runs commands, and a Verifier checks the result, with 20 command runs allowed for the whole team. Each agent spends runs for good reasons, and no single run is a mistake. But the limit belongs to the team , no agent owns it, and the team spends about three times the budget. This is the failure this paper is about: every step is locally justified, and together they break a rule that belongs to no one . Showing the team the running total did not fix it. When the harness itself held the count and refused the 21st run, the violations disappeared; observed mean task progress did not fall in that five-run panel (Study IV).
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一个由三个智能体组成的团队在 TeamBench 任务 [ 51 ] 中的协作：规划智能体负责制定计划，执行智能体运行命令，验证智能体则检查结果，整个团队最多允许运行 20 次命令。 每个智能体都有充分的理由使用运行次数，且没有任何一次运行是失误。 但这一限制属于整个团队，而非某个特定智能体，而团队实际使用的运行次数约为预算的三倍。 这正是本文所探讨的失败现象：每一步在局部看来都是合理的，但合在一起却违反了本不属于任何个体的规则。 向团队展示累计运行次数并未解决这个问题。 当测试框架本身开始计数并拒绝第 21 次运行时，违规行为便消失了；在该五次运行的观察区间内，任务进度的平均观测值并未下降（研究 IV）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 sketches both. The first is observation aliasing : two situations look the same to every participant but need different actions, as when two revision histories produce the same log once one event is hidden. Our first result, the Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem (Theorem 2.1 ), says exactly when this is fatal: a policy can guarantee a valid action from what it observes—for an LLM agent, its context—if and only if every world consistent with that observation allows a common action. When that fails, no amount of reasoning, deliberation, role decomposition, messaging, or sampling recovers the difference; with k k look-alike worlds whose admissible-action sets are pairwise disjoint, the best randomized worst-case success is exactly 1 / k 1/k (Theorem 2.3 ). A stronger model searches better within its context; it cannot see past it. Context engineering helps exactly when it puts the missing distinction into the window, and longer reasoning over the same window does not. This separates intelligence from identifiability , for human, AI, and mixed teams alike. In Study I, a frontier LLM solves all 40 tasks when it can see the deciding event; when that event is hidden, observed accuracy across the tested inference strategies is compatible with chance ( 1 / 3 1/3 ), and one sentence of added context stating the missing fact brings it back to 40/40.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 对两者进行了简要说明。 第一种情况是观察别名：两种情境对所有参与者而言看起来相同，但却需要采取不同的行动；例如，当隐藏某一事件后，两个修订历史会产生相同的日志。 我们的首个成果——观察别名不可能性定理（定理 2.1）——精确指出了这种情况何时会导致失败：一项策略能否根据观察结果（对 LLM 智能体而言，即其上下文）保证采取有效行动，当且仅当与该观察结果一致的所有世界都允许采取相同的行动。 一旦这一条件不满足，无论进行多少推理、权衡、角色分解、信息传递或采样，都无法恢复这种差异；对于 k 个外观相同但可接受行动集两两互斥的世界，最佳随机化策略在 worst-case 情况下的成功率恰好为 1/k（定理 2.3）。 更强的模型能在其上下文中更有效地搜索，但它无法看到上下文之外的内容。 上下文工程仅在将缺失的区分信息引入观察窗口时有效，而仅对同一窗口进行更长的推理则无效。 这一点将智能性与可识别性区分开来，无论是对人类、人工智能还是混合团队而言。 在研究一中，当能够看到决定性事件时，一个前沿 LLM 可以解决全部 40 项任务；而当该事件被隐藏时，所测试的推理策略的观察准确率与随机猜测（1/3）相符，但只需添加一句说明缺失事实的上下文，准确率即可恢复至 40/40。

paragraphs.en: The second failure concerns information the participants do have. Everyone can pass the checks available in their local scope while the whole is not coherent, because locally consistent pieces need not fit together into any single global state. Three pairwise translations can each be well formed, inverse-consistent, and locally plausible while the loop through all three does not return to where it started; three roles can each make a legal spend while the total breaks the budget, as in the TeamBench team above.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个问题涉及参与者实际上拥有的信息。 每个人都能通过其本地作用域内可用的检查，但整体却并不连贯，因为局部一致的片段未必能组合成任何单一的全局状态。 三次两两之间的转换各自都可以是结构良好、逆一致且局部合理的，但遍历全部三次转换后却无法回到起点；三个角色各自都可以进行合法支出，但总支出却超出了预算，就像上面提到的 TeamBench 团队那样。

paragraphs.en: Cost cuts across all four: how much state must be observed, how hard global checking is, how hard it is to design the smallest sufficient set of observables, and whether repairing an inconsistency is harder than detecting it.
paragraphs.zh: 这四个方面都存在成本削减问题：需要观察多少状态、全局检查的难度如何、设计最小充分可观察集的难度如何，以及修复不一致性是否比检测它更难。

paragraphs.en: The first question has a sharp answer, the impossibility theorem, and it says what the harness must keep and every decision’s context must reach: every distinction that changes which actions are valid (Proposition 2.4 ). The rest of the paper answers how . In a team the state is never in one place and never still. It is split into local views, re-encoded between participants, and changed by actions, and each of these steps can silently lose a distinction the theorem says must be kept. Mathematics already has a precise structure for each step. Together they form the paper’s central construction,
paragraphs.zh: 第一个问题有一个明确的答案，即不可能性定理。该定理指出，约束机制必须保留的内容以及每个决策的背景必须达到的要求是：任何改变哪些行动有效的区分（命题 2.4）。 本文其余部分将回答“如何”的问题。 在团队中，状态既不会处于单一位置，也永远不会静止不变。 状态被拆分为局部视图，在参与者之间重新编码，并因行动而改变；而这些步骤中的每一步都可能悄无声息地丢失一个定理指出必须保留的区分。 数学中已经为每一步提供了精确的结构。 它们共同构成了本文的核心构造，

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows all five on one example: a Design agent, a Fabrication agent, and a Cost agent share one beam, and each records its length in its own unit.
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了一个包含全部五个智能体的示例：一个设计智能体、一个制造智能体和一个成本智能体共享同一根梁，并且每个智能体都以其自身的单位记录该梁的长度。

paragraphs.en: A topology H H : where things meet. H H records which participants’ scopes overlap, and on which shared state. Here all three agents hold the beam length, so H H is a triangle. In general it is a hypergraph, because one field can be shared by many participants at once. Its shape helps decide when local checks are enough: on join trees pairwise agreement suffices, while cycles can hide inconsistency from pairwise checks.
paragraphs.zh: 一种拓扑结构 H H：事物在此交汇之处。 H H 记录了哪些参与者的作用域存在重叠，以及它们共享了哪些状态。 在这里，所有三个智能体都持有光束长度，因此 H H 是一个三角形。 通常情况下，它是一个超图，因为一个字段可以同时被多个参与者共享。 其结构有助于判断何时局部检查已足够：在连接树上，两两一致即可；而循环结构则可能使两两检查无法发现不一致性。

sents.en: A topology H H : where things meet.
sents.zh: 一种拓扑结构 H H：事物在此交汇之处。

sents.en: H H records which participants’ scopes overlap, and on which shared state.
sents.zh: H H 记录了哪些参与者的作用域存在重叠，以及它们共享了哪些状态。

sents.en: Here all three agents hold the beam length, so H H is a triangle.
sents.zh: 在这里，所有三个智能体都持有光束长度，因此 H H 是一个三角形。

sents.en: In general it is a hypergraph, because one field can be shared by many participants at once.
sents.zh: 通常情况下，它是一个超图，因为一个字段可以同时被多个参与者共享。

sents.en: Its shape helps decide when local checks are enough: on join trees pairwise agreement suffices, while cycles can hide inconsistency from pairwise checks.
sents.zh: 其结构有助于判断何时局部检查已足够：在连接树上，两两一致即可；而循环结构则可能使两两检查无法发现不一致性。

paragraphs.en: A groupoid 𝒢 \mathcal{G} : what only looks changed. The objects are the encodings of one thing ( 1 1 m, 1000 1000 mm, 39.37 39.37 in) and the arrows are the translations between them ( × 1000 \times 1000 , ÷ 25.4 \div 25.4 , × 0.0254 \times 0.0254 ). Every translation can be undone; that is what makes this a groupoid, which is like a group except that two arrows compose only when one ends where the other starts. The check that matters is that translations composed around any loop return the identity. A single wrong factor, ÷ 25 \div 25 instead of ÷ 25.4 \div 25.4 , looks plausible on its own edge and brings 1 1 m back as 1.016 1.016 m around the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 一个群胚 𝒢 \mathcal{G}：看起来只有外观发生了变化。 对象是对同一事物的不同编码（1 米、1000 毫米、39.37 英寸），而箭头则是它们之间的转换（× 1000、÷ 25.4、× 0.0254）。 每次转换都可以撤销；这正是它成为群胚的原因。群胚类似于群，但只有当一个箭头的终点与另一个箭头的起点一致时，两者才能组合。 需要验证的关键是：围绕任何循环进行的转换组合必须返回恒等变换。 只要有一个因子错误，比如用 ÷ 25 代替 ÷ 25.4，单独看这个转换似乎合理，但绕圈后却会把 1 米变成 1.016 米。

paragraphs.en: A sheaf condition ℱ \mathcal{F} : whether one world glues. Each agent holds a local piece of data: 1 1 m, 1000 1000 mm, 39.37 39.37 in. The sheaf condition asks whether pieces that agree on every overlap come from exactly one world, here exactly one beam. When it holds, local agreement is enough; when it fails, the pieces agree everywhere and come from no world at all. This is where “every agent is right and the team is wrong” becomes a condition a harness can check.
paragraphs.zh: 层条件 ℱ \mathcal{F}：一个世界是否粘合。 每个智能体都持有一个局部数据片段：1 1 m、1000 1000 mm、39.37 39.37 in。 层条件要求：在所有重叠区域一致的数据片段，是否恰好来自一个世界，此处即恰好来自一根光束。 当该条件成立时，局部一致性就足够了；当它不成立时，这些片段在所有地方都一致，但完全不属于任何世界。 正是在这里，“每个智能体都是正确的，而整个团队是错误的”这一说法，变成了一个约束系统可以验证的条件。

paragraphs.en: A category 𝒞 \mathcal{C} : what can change. The objects are versions of the shared state and the arrows are actions that really change it: revise the beam to 1.2 1.2 m, then order $720 of steel. Arrows compose into histories, most cannot be undone, and order matters, so this is a category rather than a groupoid. The line between the two is the line between 1 ​ m → 1000 ​ mm 1\,\mathrm{m}\to 1000\,\mathrm{mm} , which only re-expresses the beam, and 1 ​ m → 1.2 ​ m 1\,\mathrm{m}\to 1.2\,\mathrm{m} , which changes it. Only changes are checked at commit.
paragraphs.zh: 一个范畴 𝒞 \mathcal{C}：即哪些内容可以改变。 其中的对象是共享状态的不同版本，而箭头则是真正改变该状态的操作：将梁的宽度修订为 1.2 1.2 米，然后订购价值 $720 的钢材。 箭头可以组合成历史序列，其中大多数操作无法撤销，且顺序至关重要，因此这是一个范畴而非群胚。 两者之间的界限在于：1 ​ m → 1000 ​ mm 1\,\mathrm{m}\to 1000\,\mathrm{mm} 这一操作仅重新表达了梁的尺寸，而 1 ​ m → 1.2 ​ m 1\,\mathrm{m}\to 1.2\,\mathrm{m} 则实际改变了它。 只有变更内容会在提交时受到检查。

paragraphs.en: A history state D D : what still matters. This is the theory of agent memory. Of the whole past, the harness keeps only what changes which future actions are legal: here the budget left and the version each agent last read. That is enough to refuse an order priced from the v3 quote once the beam is revised in v4. The rest of the log can be dropped.
paragraphs.zh: 历史状态 D D：哪些内容仍然重要。 这就是智能体记忆理论。 在整个过去中，系统仅保留那些能改变未来哪些行动是合法的内容：此处包括剩余的预算以及每个智能体最后读取的版本。 一旦在 v4 中修订了光束，这足以拒绝一个基于 v3 报价定价的命令。 日志的其余部分可以丢弃。

paragraphs.en: This is a principled synthesis, not the only possible implementation. Corollary 4.2 shows that exact validation requires particular properties under explicit assumptions: realizable gluing for distributed views, reversible loop-consistent translations for lossless formats, and self-updating semantic state for actions and history. The named structures are standard, compositional realizations of those properties, and each drops out when its corresponding map is absent. The framework also absorbs what practitioners already use: version checks, dependency engines, ledgers, escrow quotas, and residual solvers are domain-specific realizations, and in our experiments each one matches the general harness exactly where it already owns the relevant state. Other routes exist—weakening the goal, restructuring state, accepting probabilistic success—and we price each one (Appendix F.4 ). Sections 3 – 4 develop the synthesis in the language of agent systems, and Section 4.3 derives the required properties and shows how these structures realize them; no category theory is needed to follow the argument.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一种基于原则的合成方法，而非唯一可能的实现方式。 推论 4.2 表明，精确验证需要在明确假设下满足特定属性：分布式视图的可实现粘合、无损格式的可逆循环一致转换，以及动作和历史记录的自我更新语义状态。 这些命名结构是上述属性的标准组合式实现，当对应的映射不存在时，它们也会随之消失。 该框架也整合了从业者已有的工具：版本检查、依赖引擎、账本、托管配额和残差求解器都是特定领域的实现方式；在我们的实验中，每个工具在已有相关状态的部分都与通用框架完全匹配。 还存在其他路径——例如弱化目标、重构状态或接受概率性成功——我们对每种路径都进行了评估（附录 F.4）。 第 3–4 节以智能体系统的语言阐述了这种合成方法，而第 4.3 节则推导了所需属性，并展示了这些结构如何实现它们；理解这一论证无需任何范畴论知识。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the impossibility theorem itself, we give the exact success rate of the best randomized policy in general (Theorem B.2 ) and the number of bits of new information needed to raise it (Corollary B.3 ). Choosing the smallest set of fields or sensors that makes validation exact is NP-hard (Theorem 2.5 ). For the second failure, classical database results say local agreement is enough on tree-like overlap structures (Theorem 3.1 ), while cycles can make pairwise agreement insufficient. More generally, no fixed locality order works universally across unrestricted constraint semantics (Proposition 3.2 ), although structured cyclic classes can admit bounded tests. Agreement across different representations reduces to a cycle check that a spanning forest certifies in linear time (Theorem 3.4 , Corollary 3.5 ), but repairing a disagreement at minimum cost is NP-hard (Proposition 3.6 ). Actions that change state are different from actions that only re-express it: re-expressions preserve global consistency automatically, while individually valid spends against a shared budget can jointly break it (Propositions F.4 and 3.3 ). So consistency must be checked when changes are committed, and version checks with atomic commit give the usual serializability guarantee, provided every value a change depends on is recorded (Proposition 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 除了不可能性定理本身之外，我们还给出了最佳随机策略在一般情况下的精确成功率（定理 B.2），以及提升该成功率所需的新信息比特数（推论 B.3）。 选择能使验证完全精确的最小字段或传感器集合是 NP-难的（定理 2.5）。 对于第二种失败情况，经典数据库理论指出，在类树结构的交叠结构中，局部一致性就足够了（定理 3.1），而循环结构则可能导致成对一致性不足。 更一般地，没有任何固定的局部性顺序能在不受限的约束语义下普遍适用（命题 3.2），尽管某些有结构的循环类可以允许有界测试。 不同表示之间的一致性可简化为一个循环检查，该检查可通过一个生成林在线性时间内得到验证（定理 3.4，推论 3.5），但以最小成本修复不一致性是 NP-难的（命题 3.6）。 改变状态的行动与仅重新表达状态的行动有所不同：重新表达会自动保持全局一致性，而针对共享预算的单独有效支出却可能共同破坏这种一致性（命题 F.4 和 3.3）。 因此，在提交变更时必须检查一致性；只要变更所依赖的每个值都被记录，使用原子提交的版本检查就能提供通常的可串行化保证（命题 4.1）。

paragraphs.en: A natural reply is that the impossibility theorem is correct but easy to escape: share all the context, and every agent will be right about the whole. We claim more than the theorem. Its corollaries are correct, and global coherence stays hard even in principle, for five separate reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的回应是，不可能性定理是正确的，但很容易规避：分享所有上下文，那么每个智能体对整体的判断都将正确。 我们的主张比该定理更为深远。 其推论是正确的，而全局一致性即使在原则上仍然难以实现，这有五个独立的原因。

paragraphs.en: Sharing everything is rarely an option, and sharing the least is hard. Context windows, bandwidth, privacy, and authority limit what each participant can see. So the real question is what to share, and removing aliasing requires exposing every distinction that changes which actions are valid. Finding the smallest context—the fewest fields, sensors, or log entries—that does this is NP-hard, and greedy selection is essentially the best polynomial-time approximation (Theorem 2.5 ). Also, in a team each decision is made on the acting participant’s own information set, not on the union of everyone’s views (Corollary 2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 完全共享几乎不是一个可行的选项，而共享最少的信息也很难。 上下文窗口、带宽、隐私和权限限制了每个参与者能看到的内容。 因此，真正的问题在于该共享什么；而要消除别名问题，就需要揭示所有会影响哪些行动有效的区别。 找到实现这一目标所需的最小上下文——即最少的字段、传感器或日志条目——是 NP 难题，而贪心选择基本上是最好的多项式时间近似方法（定理 2.5）。 此外，在团队中，每个决策都是基于执行行动的参与者自身的信息集做出的，而不是基于所有人观点的并集（推论 2.2）。

sents.en: Sharing everything is rarely an option, and sharing the least is hard.
sents.zh: 完全共享几乎不是一个可行的选项，而共享最少的信息也很难。

sents.zh: 找到实现这一目标所需的最小上下文——即最少的字段、传感器或日志条目——是 NP 难题，而贪心选择基本上是最好的多项式时间近似方法（定理 2.5）。

sents.en: Also, in a team each decision is made on the acting participant’s own information set, not on the union of everyone’s views (Corollary 2.2 ).
sents.zh: 此外，在团队中，每个决策都是基于执行行动的参与者自身的信息集做出的，而不是基于所有人观点的并集（推论 2.2）。

paragraphs.en: Local agreement does not always add up. Pairwise checks are enough when the overlaps form a join tree. Cycles can defeat pairwise checks, and no fixed locality bound is universal across unrestricted constraint semantics; structured cyclic classes can nevertheless admit bounded tests (Theorem 3.1 , Proposition 3.2 ). Exact global checking costs time exponential in the width of the interaction structure in the general finite-domain case (Section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 局部一致性并不总能保证全局一致性。 当重叠部分构成一个连接树时，成对检查就足够了。 循环结构可能使成对检查失效，并且在无限制约束语义下，任何固定的局部性界限都无法普适于所有情况；不过，有结构的循环类仍然可以接受有界的测试（定理 3.1，命题 3.2）。 在一般有限域情况下，精确的全局检查所需时间与交互结构的宽度呈指数关系（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Change and time add their own conditions. Re-expressing state preserves gluing, but changing state does not (Proposition F.4 ). A long-running process must carry exactly the history that still matters (Theorem F.3 ), and a commit is safe only if everything it read is still current (Proposition 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 变化和时间会附加它们自身的条件。 重新表述状态可以保持黏合性，但改变状态则不能（命题 F.4）。 一个长期运行的过程必须恰好携带那些仍然重要的历史信息（定理 F.3），而一次提交只有在其读取的所有内容仍然有效时才是安全的（命题 4.1）。

paragraphs.en: The theory also says when coherence is easy: when one participant can hold and act on the whole exact state, the extra structure should add little (Section 5.11 , Prediction 1). The hard case is ordinary multi-party work, where authority, views, and shared resources are split. Sections 3 and 4 prove these points. Section 5 shows them in agent runs. Showing the live budget to every agent still leaves overspending in 4 of 5 runs, and only ownership at commit or escrow stops it (Study IV). A single agent with the full view keeps an alignment network coherent, but agents with split views leave conflicts that only a network-level check finds (Study IX). And checks on the current state miss what changed since the agent read it: in τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench Telecom they commit on a stale quote in 10 of 10 episodes, and they never notice when a committed change is silently undone (Study V).
paragraphs.zh: 该理论还指出，当一致性易于实现时——即当一个参与者能够掌握并依据完整的精确状态采取行动时——额外的结构几乎不会带来影响（第 5.11 节，预测 1）。 困难的情况是普通的多方协作，其中权限、观点和共享资源被分割。 第 3 节和第 4 节证明了这些观点。 第 5 节通过智能体运行展示了这些情况。 即使向每个智能体展示实时预算，在 5 次运行中仍有 4 次出现超额支出，而只有在提交或托管时明确所有权才能阻止这种情况（研究 IV）。 一个拥有完整视角的单一智能体能保持对齐网络的一致性，但视角被分割的智能体会留下冲突，这些冲突只有网络级别的检查才能发现（研究 IX）。 此外，对当前状态的检查会遗漏自智能体读取状态以来发生的变化：在 τ² -bench Telecom 测试中，它们在所有 10 个回合中都基于过时的报价提交了操作，并且从未注意到已提交的变更被静默撤销的情况（研究 V）。

paragraphs.en: Hardness results for decentralized decisions are known in pieces, from team decision theory to decentralized POMDPs (Section 6 ), and software and systems research has long supplied related compositional structures. This paper’s contribution is to synthesize those conditions for AI agent harnesses: one framework organizes missing distinctions, cycles, shared invariants, repair, and time, helps diagnose which conditions a system faces, and names standard structures that realize the required properties. The nine studies test these pieces, the central ones on agent benchmarks under a fixed model.
paragraphs.zh: 去中心化决策的硬度研究结果以片段形式存在，从团队决策理论到去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（第 6 节），而软件与系统研究长期以来也提供了相关的组合结构。 本文的贡献在于将这些条件综合应用于 AI 智能体系统：一个框架整合了缺失的区分、循环、共享不变量、修复机制和时间要素，有助于诊断系统所面临的具体条件，并明确实现所需特性的标准结构。 这九项研究对这些片段进行了验证，其中核心研究是在固定模型下对智能体基准进行的测试。

paragraphs.en: The theory separates two jobs, and they map directly onto how agents are built today. The model supplies proposal intelligence : interpreting intent, planning, choosing tools, and drafting changes. The harness supplies state, admissibility, and commit : it decides what enters each agent’s context, holds the distinctions that matter, checks each proposed tool call against them, and accepts, repairs, or rejects it. Context engineering and harness design are usually practiced as craft; the theory turns them into specifications. The impossibility theorem says what a context must contain, and the framework says what the harness must own and check. The model can stay as flexible and stochastic as it likes; what must be fixed is the shared record of facts that decide what is allowed. Stronger models improve the first job. They cannot replace the second when the needed distinction is missing from what they see. The limits bind every layer. No matter how capable the model or how well engineered its context, a constraint that several agents act on needs an owner (Proposition 3.3 , Study IV). And no matter how carefully the harness is built, it guarantees only what its own state can tell apart (Proposition 2.4 ), catches a contradiction around a loop only if some check spans the loop (Proposition 3.2 ), and catches a stale read only if it remembers what each proposal read, since against the current state alone a stale proposal and a fresh one look the same (Theorem 2.1 applied to the harness itself, Study V). The harness is also a different thing from a manager or orchestrator agent. A manager is a model too: it proposes from its own view, so Corollary 2.2 binds it like any other role, and in Study IV a team with a dedicated Planner and Verifier still overspent its budget when shown the live count. Where an orchestrator does work, the framework says why: a hub that holds the shared fields makes the overlaps a tree, and on trees local checks are enough (Section 3.1 ). The harness is not a smarter participant. It owns the state, and the framework tells it which state to own, what to put in context, and which checks to run. The same results answer the team-design questions practitioners usually settle by intuition: who should own a decision, which roles can work in parallel, and who must wait for whom (Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该理论将两项任务区分开来，而这两项任务与当前智能体的构建方式直接对应。 该模型提供提案智能：解读意图、制定计划、选择工具以及起草变更。 控制框架提供状态、可接受性和提交机制：它决定哪些内容进入每个智能体的上下文，保留重要的区分，将每个提议的工具调用与这些区分进行比对，并决定是否接受、修正或拒绝该调用。 上下文工程和控制框架设计通常被视为经验性技艺；而该理论则将其转化为明确规范。 不可能性定理阐明了上下文必须包含的内容，而该框架则规定了控制框架必须拥有和检查的内容。 模型可以保持任意灵活和随机；但必须固定的，是决定哪些操作被允许的共享事实记录。 更强大的模型能提升第一项任务的表现。 但当所需区分信息缺失于模型所见内容时，它们无法替代第二项任务。 这些限制适用于每一层。 无论模型多么强大，或上下文设计得多么完善，只要多个智能体需要遵循某项约束，这项约束就必须有一个所有者（命题 3.3，研究 IV）。 而且无论控制框架构建得多么严谨，它只能保证其自身状态能够区分的内容（命题 2.4）；只有当某个检查跨越整个循环时，它才能在循环中捕捉到矛盾（命题 3.2）；并且只有当它记住每次提案读取的内容时，才能检测到陈旧读取——因为仅凭当前状态，一个陈旧的提案与一个全新的提案看起来是相同的（定理 2.1 应用于控制框架本身，研究 V）。 控制框架也与管理者或协调智能体不同。 管理者也是一种模型：它基于自身视角提出方案，因此推论 2.2 同样适用于它；在研究 IV 中，一个拥有专职规划者和验证者的团队，在看到实时计数后仍然超出了预算。 当协调器执行任务时，该框架也解释了原因：一个持有共享字段的中心节点使重叠部分形成树状结构，而在树结构中，局部检查就足够了（第 3.1 节）。 控制框架并非更智能的参与者。 它拥有状态，而该框架则告诉它应拥有哪些状态、哪些内容应放入上下文，以及需要执行哪些检查。 同样的结论也回答了实践者通常凭直觉解决的团队设计问题：谁应负责某项决策、哪些角色可以并行工作，以及谁必须等待谁（第 4.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: The studies follow the two failure modes; 1 1 1 The code and run records for all nine studies will be released. Figure 3 shows four causal results. A frontier LLM solves all 40 aliasing-probe tasks when it can see the deciding event; with that event hidden, all tested arms are statistically compatible with chance ( 1 / 3 1/3 ), and one sentence stating the missing fact restores 40/40 (Study I, Section 5.2 ). The finite panel supports the predicted contrast but does not establish empirical equivalence to chance. When actions change shared state, ordinary TeamBench teams overspend a shared budget in 5/5 runs, exposure leaves 4/5, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5; observed mean progress does not fall in the five-run enforced comparison (Study IV, Section 5.5 ). On the same budgeted task, per-role escrow quotas also reach 0/5 violations while an information-only counter still overspends in 4/5; progress differences between escrow and the ledger are descriptive because their attestation gates differ. Under an explicit unique-name diagnostic, public OAEI ontology-alignment networks [ 66 ] carry pairwise-invisible same-ontology identity collisions in 23 of 45 networks across seven years (Study VIII, Section 5.9 ). Agents given split views reproduce them in 9 of 40 merges, a single full-view agent leaves none, and a network-level check removes them all; the current send-to-all repair lowers mean F1 from 0.796 to 0.774, so detection succeeds while repair routing remains open (Study IX, Section 5.10 ). When state changes under a user and an assistant in τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench Telecom, ordinary policy checks tie the coherence harness where the change breaks a policy rule, as predicted; but they commit on a stale quote in 10 of 10 episodes, and when a committed change is silently undone they score 0.07 on the benchmark’s own grader while the harness scores 1.00 (Study V, Section 5.6 ). Where a conventional mechanism already owns the relevant state—dependency closure for stale derivations, a residual solver for coupled design—it matches the general harness exactly (Studies III and VI). The theory predicts that equality; the studies above test the boundaries where no such mechanism exists.

paragraphs.en: This paper’s novelty is the agent-facing synthesis and operationalization. To our knowledge, it is the first work to formulate global coherence as a failure class of agent systems in its own right, separate identifiability and commit semantics from model capability, and assemble the relevant information-theoretic and local-to-global conditions into a framework that says what each agent’s context must contain and what the harness must enforce. The mathematical ingredients have important precedents, credited below; the contribution is connecting their guarantees and limits to agent harness design and testing the resulting boundary. The experiments probe its counterintuitive parts:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的创新之处在于面向智能体的合成与操作化。 据我们所知，这是第一项将全局一致性本身确立为智能体系统的一个独立故障类别、将可识别性与承诺语义从模型能力中分离出来，并将相关的信息论及局部到全局条件整合为一个框架的研究；该框架明确了每个智能体的上下文必须包含的内容以及约束机制必须强制执行的要求。 其数学要素已有重要的先例（见下文致谢）；本文的贡献在于将这些要素的保证与极限连接到智能体约束机制的设计中，并测试由此产生的边界。 实验部分探究了其反直觉的部分：

sents.en: This paper’s novelty is the agent-facing synthesis and operationalization.
sents.zh: 本文的创新之处在于面向智能体的合成与操作化。

sents.en: To our knowledge, it is the first work to formulate global coherence as a failure class of agent systems in its own right, separate identifiability and commit semantics from model capability, and assemble the relevant information-theoretic and local-to-global conditions into a framework that says what each agent’s context must contain and what the harness must enforce.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，这是第一项将全局一致性本身确立为智能体系统的一个独立故障类别、将可识别性与承诺语义从模型能力中分离出来，并将相关的信息论及局部到全局条件整合为一个框架的研究；该框架明确了每个智能体的上下文必须包含的内容以及约束机制必须强制执行的要求。

sents.en: The mathematical ingredients have important precedents, credited below; the contribution is connecting their guarantees and limits to agent harness design and testing the resulting boundary.
sents.zh: 其数学要素已有重要的先例（见下文致谢）；本文的贡献在于将这些要素的保证与极限连接到智能体约束机制的设计中，并测试由此产生的边界。

sents.en: The experiments probe its counterintuitive parts:
sents.zh: 实验部分探究了其反直觉的部分：

paragraphs.en: A stronger model is not the fix for missing information. A model that solves every task when it can see the deciding fact produces accuracy statistically compatible with chance when that fact is hidden across the tested reasoning, deliberation, and voting conditions; one added sentence stating the fact solves every task again (Study I). The theorem supplies the general impossibility statement; the finite panel is consistent with it.
paragraphs.zh: 更强大的模型并非解决信息缺失问题的方案。 当模型能够看到决定性事实时，它就能解决所有任务；但如果该事实被隐藏在所有受测试的推理、斟酌和投票条件下，其准确率在统计上将与随机结果相当；而只需添加一句陈述该事实的句子，模型便能再次解决所有任务（研究 I）。 该定理提供了普遍的不可能性陈述；有限的专家组与此结论一致。

sents.en: A stronger model is not the fix for missing information.
sents.zh: 更强大的模型并非解决信息缺失问题的方案。

sents.en: A model that solves every task when it can see the deciding fact produces accuracy statistically compatible with chance when that fact is hidden across the tested reasoning, deliberation, and voting conditions; one added sentence stating the fact solves every task again (Study I).
sents.zh: 当模型能够看到决定性事实时，它就能解决所有任务；但如果该事实被隐藏在所有受测试的推理、斟酌和投票条件下，其准确率在统计上将与随机结果相当；而只需添加一句陈述该事实的句子，模型便能再次解决所有任务（研究 I）。

sents.en: The theorem supplies the general impossibility statement; the finite panel is consistent with it.
sents.zh: 该定理提供了普遍的不可能性陈述；有限的专家组与此结论一致。

paragraphs.en: More context is not the fix for shared state. Context fixes missing information, as Study I shows, but agents who have the live budget in their context still overspend it. A shared invariant needs an owner: enforcement at commit, or quotas that split it (Study IV).
paragraphs.zh: 更多上下文并非共享状态的解决方案。 如研究 I 所示，上下文可以解决信息缺失的问题，但将实时预算包含在上下文中的智能体仍然会超出预算支出。 共享不变量需要一个所有者：要么在提交时强制执行，要么通过配额将其分割（研究 IV）。

sents.en: More context is not the fix for shared state.
sents.zh: 更多上下文并非共享状态的解决方案。

sents.en: Context fixes missing information, as Study I shows, but agents who have the live budget in their context still overspend it.
sents.zh: 如研究 I 所示，上下文可以解决信息缺失的问题，但将实时预算包含在上下文中的智能体仍然会超出预算支出。

sents.en: A shared invariant needs an owner: enforcement at commit, or quotas that split it (Study IV).
sents.zh: 共享不变量需要一个所有者：要么在提交时强制执行，要么通过配额将其分割（研究 IV）。

paragraphs.en: Checking every handoff is not the fix. Every pairwise review can pass while the integrated result is impossible, in public benchmark data and in agent runs alike (Studies VIII and IX).
paragraphs.zh: 检查每一次交接并不能解决问题。 在公开基准数据中以及在智能体运行中，所有两两审查都可能通过，但综合结果却不可能实现（研究 VIII 和 IX）。

sents.en: Checking every handoff is not the fix.
sents.zh: 检查每一次交接并不能解决问题。

sents.en: Every pairwise review can pass while the integrated result is impossible, in public benchmark data and in agent runs alike (Studies VIII and IX).
sents.zh: 在公开基准数据中以及在智能体运行中，所有两两审查都可能通过，但综合结果却不可能实现（研究 VIII 和 IX）。

paragraphs.en: Checking the current state is not the fix. A commit can rest on a stale read, and a committed change can be silently undone, while every check on the current state passes (Study V).
paragraphs.zh: 检查当前状态并非解决方案。 一次提交可能基于过时的读取结果，而已提交的更改可能被静默撤销，同时每次对当前状态的检查都会通过（研究 V）。

sents.en: Checking the current state is not the fix.
sents.zh: 检查当前状态并非解决方案。

paragraphs.en: The mathematics is deliberately borrowed, and that is a strength. Acyclic database schemes, group synchronization, sheaves, treewidth, Myhill–Nerode minimization, and optimistic concurrency control are each battle-tested in their own field, and we credit each where it appears. What was missing is the bridge to AI agents: identifying the validation properties distributed agent systems require, showing how these classical structures realize them under explicit assumptions, and telling builders when each property matters and when it does not. The new formal results serve that bridge: the admissibility form of the aliasing theorem with its exact randomized value and bit bounds, and the hardness of choosing the smallest state to expose, a close relative of minimal reducts in rough-set theory (Appendix A sorts every result by origin). The contribution is the bridge, not new mathematics. The empirical claims are deliberately narrower than the theory. They use one model family, a synthetic aliasing probe, five seeds per arm on three TeamBench tasks, and failures that we inject into τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench tasks. Within that scope the result is that the predicted failures occur, the tested inference variations do not remove them, and owning the missing state does. How often these failures dominate on broad agent benchmarks is the next question, and the theory says where to look.
paragraphs.zh: 这些数学概念是有意借用的，而这正是一大优势。 无环数据库方案、群同步、层集、树宽、Myhill–Nerode最小化以及乐观并发控制，每一项都在各自领域经过实战检验，我们在文中对每一项都标注了出处。 所欠缺的正是连接至AI智能体的桥梁：识别分布式智能体系统所需的验证属性，阐明这些经典结构在明确假设下如何实现这些属性，并告诉构建者每种属性在何时重要、何时无关紧要。 新的形式化成果正是这座桥梁：别名定理的可接受性形式及其精确的随机化数值和比特界限，以及选择最小暴露状态时的困难性——这是粗糙集理论中极小约简的近亲（附录A按来源对每个成果进行了分类）。 贡献在于这座桥梁，而非新的数学理论。 经验性主张的范围刻意比理论更狭窄。 它们使用一个模型族、一种合成的别名探测工具、每个分支在三个TeamBench任务上的五个种子，以及我们注入到τ²-bench任务中的故障。 在该范围内，结果表明预测的故障确实发生，所测试的推理变体未能消除这些故障，而拥有缺失的状态则能解决这一问题。 这些故障在广泛智能体基准测试中出现的频率有多高是下一个问题，而理论则指明了应关注何处。

paragraphs.en: A limit on what reasoning can fix. The Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem and its quantitative forms: the exact success rate of the best randomized policy, the number of bits of new state needed, and extensions to multi-agent protocols and tool use. For AI systems the message is direct: more reasoning, more agents, more messages, and more samples cannot recover a distinction that none of them can see. Adding the missing state to context can, and the smallest such context is exactly the one that keeps apart worlds allowing different actions.
paragraphs.zh: 推理能力所能解决的问题存在极限。 观察别名不可能性定理及其量化形式：最佳随机策略的确切成功率、所需的新状态比特数，以及对多智能体协议和工具使用的扩展。 对于人工智能系统而言，结论非常明确：增加推理能力、更多智能体、更多消息和更多样本，都无法恢复那些所有方法都看不到的区别。 将缺失的状态添加到上下文中是可行的，而最小的此类上下文恰好能够区分那些允许不同行动的世界。

sents.en: A limit on what reasoning can fix.

sents.en: The Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem and its quantitative forms: the exact success rate of the best randomized policy, the number of bits of new state needed, and extensions to multi-agent protocols and tool use.
sents.zh: 观察别名不可能性定理及其量化形式：最佳随机策略的确切成功率、所需的新状态比特数，以及对多智能体协议和工具使用的扩展。

sents.en: For AI systems the message is direct: more reasoning, more agents, more messages, and more samples cannot recover a distinction that none of them can see.
sents.zh: 对于人工智能系统而言，结论非常明确：增加推理能力、更多智能体、更多消息和更多样本，都无法恢复那些所有方法都看不到的区别。

paragraphs.en: One framework for local-to-global coherence. A topology says where things meet, sheaves ask whether local views glue into one world, groupoids record which encodings mean the same thing, and categories describe how actions compose over time. Under explicit assumptions, we derive the properties exact validation requires and use these standard structures as a compositional realization of them. This turns “every agent passes its local checks and the team is wrong” from an anecdote into a condition a harness can check, and it explains why familiar tools work exactly where they do.
paragraphs.zh: 一种实现局部到全局一致性的框架。 拓扑结构描述了事物交汇的位置，层（sheaves）则追问局部视图能否粘合成一个统一的世界，群胚（groupoids）记录了哪些编码具有相同含义，而范畴（categories）描述了动作如何随时间组合。 在明确假设下，我们推导出精确验证所需的性质，并将这些标准结构用作它们的组合式实现。 这使得“每个智能体都通过局部检查，但整个团队却出错”这一说法从一个轶事转变为一个测试框架可以验证的条件，并解释了为何熟悉的工具恰好在特定场景下有效。

paragraphs.en: The price of coherence. Local checks suffice on join-tree overlap structures; cycles can defeat pairwise checks, and no fixed locality bound works universally across unrestricted constraint semantics. Agreement across encodings can be certified in linear time, while the smallest repair can be NP-hard. A shared budget cannot be protected by independent local checks, and choosing the smallest state to expose is NP-hard. The cost depends on how the parts interact, not on how many agents there are.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性的代价。 对于连接树的重叠结构，局部检查已足够；但循环结构可能使成对检查失效，且任何固定的局部性界限都无法在所有不受限的约束语义中普遍适用。 不同编码之间的一致性可以在线性时间内得到验证，而最小的修复问题可能是 NP-难的。 独立的地方性检查无法保护共享预算，而且选择要暴露的最小状态也是一个 NP-难问题。 成本取决于各部分之间的相互作用方式，而非智能体的数量。

paragraphs.en: A specification for agent harnesses. Models propose; a harness that owns the state decides what is allowed, and the framework specifies exactly what it must hold, what it must put into context, and what it must check. This goes beyond a manager agent, which proposes from its own view like any other role. The model can stay stochastic. Version checks, dependency engines, ledgers, and escrow quotas are special cases, and the theory says when each is enough. For builders this gives a concrete rule: when a multi-agent system fails, first ask which distinction no one owns, before asking for a bigger model or more agents.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架规范。 模型提出方案；拥有状态的框架决定哪些操作是允许的，而系统则明确界定其必须包含的内容、必须纳入上下文的信息以及必须检查的事项。 这超越了管理型智能体——后者像任何其他角色一样，仅从自身视角提出方案。 模型可以保持随机性。 版本检查、依赖引擎、账本和托管配额是特殊情况，该理论也说明了每种情况在何种条件下已足够。 对于构建者而言，这提供了一条具体规则：当多智能体系统出现故障时，首先应探究哪个区分责任无人承担，而不是立即寻求更大的模型或更多智能体。

paragraphs.en: Evidence that the theory predicts where the harness helps and where it does not. Nine studies, four of them causal agent experiments frozen before scoring: a controlled aliasing probe, TeamBench, τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench Telecom, and ontology alignment. The harness removes the targeted failures without a stronger model, and it ties conventional tools exactly where those tools already own the state.
paragraphs.zh: 该理论预测了辅助框架在哪些地方有效，而在哪些地方无效的证据。 九项研究，其中四项是评分前冻结的因果智能体实验：一个受控别名探测、TeamBench、τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench Telecom 以及本体对齐。 在没有更强模型的情况下，该辅助框架能够消除目标故障，并且它恰好在与传统工具已经掌控状态的地方将其结合。

paragraphs.en: The model needs three ingredients: the worlds that could be true, what each participant sees, and which actions are allowed in each world. Let X X be the set of possible global states and 𝒜 \mathcal{A} the set of actions. For each state x x , let C ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ 𝒜 C(x)\subseteq\mathcal{A} be the actions allowed there. C C can encode anything that decides legality: authority, budgets, invariants, freshness, or required artifacts. A participant does not see x x itself; it sees an observation y = Ω ⁡ ( x ) y=\Omega(x) . In a team, Ω ⁡ ( x ) \Omega(x) can be the tuple of everyone’s local views ( Ω 1 ​ ( x ) , … , Ω m ​ ( x ) ) (\Omega_{1}(x),\ldots,\Omega_{m}(x)) . A runtime, in turn, remembers some summary ϕ ⁡ ( x ) \phi(x) of the state. So Ω \Omega is what a decision-maker can see, and ϕ \phi is what the runtime keeps. In agent-engineering terms, Ω i \Omega_{i} is agent i i ’s context—its prompt, retrieved documents, tool results, and memory—and the runtime is the agent harness, the code around the model that assembles that context, executes tool calls, and decides which of them take effect. We use “runtime” and “harness” interchangeably.

paragraphs.en: Both failures from the introduction are properties of this one map. In aliasing , ρ \rho is not one-to-one: two different worlds give the same local views. paragraphs.en: The central result makes a simple point exact: no policy can act on a distinction it cannot see. The idea has a long history, as perceptual aliasing in reinforcement learning [ 82 ] and as indistinguishability arguments in distributed computing [ 29 ] . What we add is the exact condition for choosing a valid action, and what it implies for teams, randomness, tools, and hints.
paragraphs.zh: 核心结论明确了一个简单的道理：任何策略都无法基于它无法识别的区分采取行动。 这一观点历史悠久，体现在强化学习中的感知混叠现象 [ 82 ]，以及分布式计算中的不可区分性论证 [ 29 ]。 我们补充的是选择有效行动的确切条件，以及这对团队、随机性、工具和提示所蕴含的意义。

paragraphs.en: If two different realities give a group the same evidence but need different decisions, the group cannot guarantee the right decision from that evidence, and this holds for any decision process whose complete available information is Ω ⁡ ( x ) \Omega(x) : one AI agent, a team of agents, a human organization, or a human–AI collaboration. Take the revision log from the introduction. Three teams commit, revert, and re-apply changes to one shared parameter, and before writing, an agent must name the current head; if the last event is hidden, three different histories produce the same log but leave three different heads. Whatever head the agent names, it is wrong in two of the three worlds, and only recovering the hidden event changes that, which is exactly what Study I tests.
paragraphs.zh: 如果两个不同的现实情况向某个群体提供了相同的证据，但却需要做出不同的决策，那么该群体就无法仅凭这些证据保证做出正确的决策；对于任何其全部可用信息为 Ω(x) 的决策过程而言，这一结论都成立——无论是单个 AI 智能体、一个智能体团队、一个人类组织，还是人类与 AI 的合作。 参考引言中的修订日志。 三个团队对同一个共享参数进行提交、回滚和重新应用更改；在写入之前，一个智能体必须指定当前的主版本。如果最后的事件被隐藏，那么三种不同的历史过程会产生相同的日志，但会留下三个不同的主版本。 无论该智能体指定哪个主版本，在三个世界中都有两个世界中的选择是错误的；只有恢复被隐藏的事件才能改变这一结果，而这正是研究 I 所测试的内容。

paragraphs.en: The proof is an induction over communication rounds: every message is computed from what the agents saw, so the whole transcript is too. Randomness does not help either; it changes which answer is chosen, not which worlds can be told apart. The corollary also has a positive reading. When a team fails on a distinction that its joint observation does contain, the failure is one of protocol—who sends what, and who owns which decision—not an impossibility. And the theorem applies at every single decision: an action taken by one role is limited by what that role has seen and been told, not by the union of everyone’s views.
paragraphs.zh: 该证明是对通信轮次进行归纳得出的：每条消息都是基于智能体所观察到的内容计算出来的，因此整个对话记录也是如此。 随机性也无济于事；它只会改变所选的答案，而不会改变哪些世界可以被区分开来。 这个推论也可以从积极的角度来理解。 当一个团队未能区分出其联合观察结果本应包含的差异时，这种失败源于协议问题——即谁发送什么、谁负责哪项决策——而非不可能性。 而且该定理适用于每一个决策：某个角色采取的行动受限于该角色所观察到和被告知的内容，而非所有人观点的总和。

paragraphs.en: Suppose a shared project dashboard makes ten globally different situations look identical, while each situation requires a different intervention. A stochastic agent may randomize, debate, self-critique, or sample many chains of thought, but without new state information it must use the same output distribution in all ten worlds. Its worst-case success therefore cannot exceed 10 % 10\% . This is directly relevant to agent benchmarks: more inference-time compute can improve reasoning inside one observed world, but it cannot identify which member of an aliased family is actually present.
paragraphs.zh: 假设一个共享项目看板让十个全球不同的情境看起来完全相同，而每个情境都需要不同的干预措施。 一个随机智能体可能会随机化、辩论、自我批判或采样多条思维链，但如果没有新的状态信息，它在这十个世界中都必须使用相同的输出分布。 因此，其最坏情况下的成功率不能超过 10% 10\%。 这与智能体基准测试直接相关：更多的推理阶段计算能力可以改进单个可观察世界内的推理，但它无法识别出同义族中实际存在的是哪一个成员。

paragraphs.en: Two lessons follow for AI. Inference compute and semantic state are different resources, and one cannot pay for the other. And new information can be counted: extra roles, tokens, or rounds help exactly when they bring in a distinction that splits look-alike worlds. Study I tests this directly, comparing more reasoning with the same observation against the same reasoning with one added distinction (Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能由此得出两个教训。 推理计算和语义状态是两种不同的资源，一种无法替代另一种。 而且新信息是可以量化的：额外的角色、标记或轮次只有在引入能够区分相似世界的差异时才会真正发挥作用。 研究 I 直接检验了这一点，将更多推理与相同观察结果的情况，与在相同推理基础上增加一个区分因素的情况进行了比较（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: The “authoritative semantic state” means: not a copy of the whole world, but every distinction that can change whether a proposal is valid. The model does not need the whole world in its prompt. Instead, the harness can hold that state outside the model and put into each decision’s context only what it needs. For context engineering this is the exact target: a context is sufficient precisely when it never merges two worlds that allow different actions.
paragraphs.zh: “权威语义状态”指的是：它并非整个世界的复制品，而是所有可能改变某个提议是否有效的区分。 该模型无需在其提示中包含整个世界。 相反，控制层可以将这种状态保留在模型之外，并在每次决策的上下文中仅放入其所需的信息。 对于上下文工程而言，这正是精准的目标：当且仅当一个上下文从未将允许不同行动的两种世界合并时，它才是充分的。

paragraphs.en: However, knowing what must be kept does not make it easy to find. Suppose a designer has candidate fields, sensors, or log entries and wants the fewest that make validation exact.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，知道哪些内容必须保留，并不意味着就能轻易找到它们。 假设一位设计者拥有候选字段、传感器或日志条目，并希望用最少的数量实现精确验证。

paragraphs.en: Given a finite state set, admissibility profiles, and candidate observables, finding a minimum-cardinality subset of observables sufficient for exact proposal validation is NP-hard.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个有限状态集、可接受性配置文件和候选可观测量，要找到一个最小基数度的可观测量子集以实现精确提案验证，这是一个NP难问题。

paragraphs.en: The proof reduces Set Cover (Appendix B.3 ). Greedy selection is essentially the best polynomial-time approximation, and the problem is a close relative of finding minimal reducts in rough-set theory [ 72 ] . This is a hardness result about design , not about running the system: checking a proposal against a chosen state can be cheap even when finding the smallest sufficient state is hard. It is the first reason that “just share everything” is not an answer.
paragraphs.zh: 该证明将问题归约到集合覆盖问题（附录 B.3）。 贪心选择本质上是最优的多项式时间近似方法，而这个问题与粗糙集理论中寻找最小约简集的问题密切相关 [72]。 这是一个关于设计难度的结论，而非系统运行难度：即使寻找最小的充分状态很困难，将提案与选定状态进行比对的成本也可能很低。 这是“直接共享一切”并非正确答案的第一个原因。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 was about information that no one has. This section is about information that everyone has, but in pieces. Each agent’s piece passes every check the agent can run, and the pieces still add up to no possible world. It happens in three ways in agent systems—pieces compared pairwise, a budget no one owns, and translations between formats—and each is a place where the framework earns its keep. For each, a sharp result says exactly when local checks are enough and what it costs when they are not, and each turns into a design rule. Proofs are in Appendices C and D .
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节讨论的是无人拥有的信息。 本节讨论的是每个人都知道的信息，但这些信息是零散的。 每个智能体所掌握的片段都能通过该智能体能运行的所有检验，但这些片段组合起来仍然无法构成任何可能的世界。 在智能体系统中，这种情况以三种方式出现——片段的成对比较、无人拥有的预算以及格式之间的转换——而每种情况都是该框架发挥作用的环节。 对于每种情况，一个明确的结果都精确说明了局部检验何时足够，以及当它们不足时会产生什么代价，并且每种情况都会转化为一条设计规则。 证明见附录 C 和 D。

paragraphs.en: Consider three agents that each own one variable and each reconcile with a neighbor. The A–B check requires A = B A=B , the B–C check requires B = C B=C , and the A–C check requires A ≠ C A\neq C . Each check can be satisfied, and so can any two of them together. No assignment satisfies all three: the first two force A = C A=C , and the third forbids it. Replace the Booleans with “uses schema v2,” “the deadline moved,” or “these two records are the same customer,” and this is a familiar failure of multi-agent pipelines: every handoff review passes, and the integrated result is impossible (Figure 1 b).
paragraphs.zh: 假设有三个智能体，每个智能体拥有一个变量，并且每个都与一个邻居进行协调。 A–B 检查要求 A = B，B–C 检查要求 B = C，而 A–C 检查则要求 A ≠ C。 每一项检查都可以得到满足，因此其中任意两项也可以同时得到满足。 没有任何赋值能同时满足全部三项：前两项强制 A = C，而第三项则禁止这种情况。 将布尔值替换为“使用 schema v2”“截止日期已变更”或“这两条记录属于同一客户”，这就是多智能体流程中常见的失败模式：每一次交接审查都通过，但最终整合的结果却是不可能的（图 1b）。

paragraphs.en: The question underneath is whether local states that agree on every overlap come from one global state; in the notation of Section 2.1 , whether ρ \rho is onto. An assignment of states to scopes for which the answer is always yes, and uniquely so, is called a sheaf [ 67 , 6 ] . That is the right name for it: the sheaf condition is precisely the statement that local agreement implies one global state, so it gives a runtime an exact target to check. A sheaf specifies what coherence means; search and repair are separate steps.
paragraphs.zh: 下面的问题是：在每个重叠区域都一致的地方状态是否源于一个全局状态；用第 2.1 节的记法来说，就是 ρ \rho 是否为满射。 一种为作用域分配状态的方式，如果其答案总是“是”且唯一，则称为层 [67, 6]。 这正是它的正确名称：层条件恰恰意味着局部一致性会导出一个全局状态，因此它为运行时提供了一个明确的目标以供检查。 层定义了相干性的含义；搜索和修复是两个独立的步骤。

paragraphs.en: One detail matters for agent design. The false pass happens when agents compare what each considers possible —constraints, plans, ranges—rather than what each has committed to . If every agent commits to a concrete value, comparing committed values on overlaps catches the triangle. Agents usually exchange the former. (This is the possibilistic contextuality of Abramsky and Brandenburger [ 2 ] ; Appendix C .)
paragraphs.zh: 智能体设计有一个细节至关重要。 当智能体比较各自认为可能的事物——约束、计划、范围——而非各自已承诺的事物时，就会出现虚假通过的情况。 如果每个智能体都承诺一个具体的值，那么通过比较已承诺值之间的重叠部分就能识别出这种矛盾。 智能体通常会交换前者。 （这是 Abramsky 和 Brandenburger [2] 提出的可能性语境性；参见附录 C。）

sents.en: One detail matters for agent design.
sents.zh: 智能体设计有一个细节至关重要。

sents.en: The false pass happens when agents compare what each considers possible —constraints, plans, ranges—rather than what each has committed to .
sents.zh: 当智能体比较各自认为可能的事物——约束、计划、范围——而非各自已承诺的事物时，就会出现虚假通过的情况。

sents.en: (This is the possibilistic contextuality of Abramsky and Brandenburger [ 2 ] ; Appendix C .)
sents.zh: （这是 Abramsky 和 Brandenburger [2] 提出的可能性语境性；参见附录 C。）

paragraphs.en: When are pairwise checks enough? Database theory has a sharp answer, and it depends only on the shape of who overlaps with whom.
paragraphs.zh: 什么时候两两检查就足够了？ 数据库理论对此有一个明确的答案，而该答案仅取决于哪些智能体与哪些智能体存在重叠。

sents.en: When are pairwise checks enough?
sents.zh: 什么时候两两检查就足够了？

sents.en: Database theory has a sharp answer, and it depends only on the shape of who overlaps with whom.
sents.zh: 数据库理论对此有一个明确的答案，而该答案仅取决于哪些智能体与哪些智能体存在重叠。

paragraphs.en: If the overlap structure of the local constraints is acyclic (formally, α \alpha -acyclic: it has a join tree), then local constraints that agree pairwise are globally consistent. If it has a cycle, some pairwise-consistent family of local constraints is not.
paragraphs.zh: 如果局部约束的重叠结构是无环的（正式地说是 α-无环的：它拥有一棵连接树），那么两两一致的局部约束在整体上是一致的。 如果该结构存在环，则某些两两一致的局部约束族在整体上并不一致。

sents.en: If the overlap structure of the local constraints is acyclic (formally, α \alpha -acyclic: it has a join tree), then local constraints that agree pairwise are globally consistent.
sents.zh: 如果局部约束的重叠结构是无环的（正式地说是 α-无环的：它拥有一棵连接树），那么两两一致的局部约束在整体上是一致的。

sents.en: If it has a cycle, some pairwise-consistent family of local constraints is not.
sents.zh: 如果该结构存在环，则某些两两一致的局部约束族在整体上并不一致。

paragraphs.en: A planner–coder–tester chain is a tree. So is a hub-and-spoke team in which every agent reconciles only with an orchestrator that holds the shared fields. A review loop, or three teams that each share an interface with the other two, is a cycle. Cycles remove the pairwise guarantee, and increasing the checked group size has no universal fixed bound across unrestricted constraint families:
paragraphs.zh: 规划者–编码者–测试者链是一棵树。 中心辐射式团队也是如此，在这种团队中，每个智能体仅与持有共享字段的协调器进行协调。 审查循环，或三个各自与其他两个共享接口的团队，构成一个循环。 循环会消除成对保证，而扩大受检组的大小在不受限制的约束族中并不存在通用的固定界限：

sents.en: A planner–coder–tester chain is a tree.
sents.zh: 规划者–编码者–测试者链是一棵树。

sents.en: So is a hub-and-spoke team in which every agent reconciles only with an orchestrator that holds the shared fields.
sents.zh: 中心辐射式团队也是如此，在这种团队中，每个智能体仅与持有共享字段的协调器进行协调。

sents.en: A review loop, or three teams that each share an interface with the other two, is a cycle.
sents.zh: 审查循环，或三个各自与其他两个共享接口的团队，构成一个循环。

sents.en: Cycles remove the pairwise guarantee, and increasing the checked group size has no universal fixed bound across unrestricted constraint families:
sents.zh: 循环会消除成对保证，而扩大受检组的大小在不受限制的约束族中并不存在通用的固定界限：

paragraphs.en: For every k k , there is a finite set of local constraints in which every k k of them can be satisfied together, but all of them cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个 k k ，都存在一个有限的局部约束集合，其中任意 k k 个约束可以同时得到满足，但所有约束却无法同时得到满足。

paragraphs.en: The construction is a parity puzzle on a ring of more than k k agents. Any proper subset of the constraints can be satisfied, and only the sum of all of them exposes the contradiction (Appendix C.2 ). Algorithms that propagate derived constraints, rather than check groups in isolation, do solve rings, but on expander-shaped interaction graphs they too fail at every fixed level. Some structured problems do have a fixed check size—Helly’s theorem gives d + 1 d+1 for convex constraints in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} [ 58 ] —so the useful question for a given system is which structure it has.
paragraphs.zh: 该构造是一个基于超过 k 个智能体的环的奇偶性谜题。 任何约束条件的真子集都可以被满足，只有将所有约束条件相加才会暴露出矛盾（附录 C.2）。 那些传播派生约束而非孤立检查组的算法确实能够解决环状问题，但在扩张型交互图上，它们在每个固定层级上也会失败。 某些结构化问题确实具有固定的检查规模——赫利定理指出，在 ℝ^d 中对于凸性约束，该规模为 d + 1 [58]——因此，对于给定的系统，关键问题是确定其具有何种结构。

sents.en: The construction is a parity puzzle on a ring of more than k k agents.
sents.zh: 该构造是一个基于超过 k 个智能体的环的奇偶性谜题。

sents.en: Some structured problems do have a fixed check size—Helly’s theorem gives d + 1 d+1 for convex constraints in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} [ 58 ] —so the useful question for a given system is which structure it has.

paragraphs.en: Design rule. If the agents’ overlaps form a join tree, pairwise reconciliation is enough. Cycles remove that guarantee: use a global method appropriate to the constraint class, or restructure the overlaps into a join tree. For translation networks, Section 3.3 gives the exact loop check.
paragraphs.zh: 设计规则。 如果智能体的重叠部分构成一棵连接树，则成对协调就足够了。 循环会消除这一保证：请使用适用于该约束类别的全局方法，或者将重叠部分重新组织为连接树。 对于翻译网络，第 3.3 节提供了精确的环路检查方法。

sents.en: Design rule.
sents.zh: 设计规则。

sents.en: If the agents’ overlaps form a join tree, pairwise reconciliation is enough.
sents.zh: 如果智能体的重叠部分构成一棵连接树，则成对协调就足够了。

sents.en: Cycles remove that guarantee: use a global method appropriate to the constraint class, or restructure the overlaps into a join tree.
sents.zh: 循环会消除这一保证：请使用适用于该约束类别的全局方法，或者将重叠部分重新组织为连接树。

sents.en: For translation networks, Section 3.3 gives the exact loop check.
sents.zh: 对于翻译网络，第 3.3 节提供了精确的环路检查方法。

paragraphs.en: A different failure arises when a constraint lives in no agent’s scope. Give m m agents a shared budget B B of tool calls, test runs, or dollars, and let each track its own spend s i s_{i} . Each spend is legal on its own, and the agents share no variables, so there is nothing to compare: every local check passes. Nothing stops ∑ i s i > B \sum_{i}s_{i}>B . More checking between agents cannot help, because no agent’s view contains the total. This is the TeamBench failure of Study IV.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个约束条件不在任何智能体的作用范围内时，会出现另一种失败。 给 m 个智能体一个共享的预算 B，用于工具调用、测试运行或资金，并让每个智能体自行追踪其支出 s_i。 每一项支出单独来看都是合法的，且这些智能体之间没有共享变量，因此没有任何可比较的内容：所有局部检查都会通过。 没有任何机制能阻止 ∑_i s_i > B。 智能体之间的更多检查也无济于事，因为没有任何一个智能体的视角包含总和。 这就是研究 IV 中的 TeamBench 失败情况。

paragraphs.en: For m ≥ 2 m\geq 2 agents and B ≥ 1 B\geq 1 , two agents can each make a spend that is legal from a common valid state, while the two spends together exceed the budget. In database terms, the spend transactions are not invariant-confluent [ 9 ] , so protecting the budget requires coordination or a restructured budget.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 m ≥ 2 m\geq 2 个智能体和 B ≥ 1 B\geq 1，两个智能体各自可以执行一次在共同有效状态下合法的支出，但两次支出的总和会超出预算。 从数据库的角度来看，这些支出交易并非不变性汇合的 [9]，因此要保护预算就需要进行协调或对预算结构进行调整。

paragraphs.en: Two fixes work. An authoritative ledger that checks the total at commit adds a scope that contains the constraint. Escrow quotas B i B_{i} with ∑ i B i = B \sum_{i}B_{i}=B split the constraint into local ones, at the cost of flexibility: one agent cannot borrow another’s unused share. Locks and reservations are further options. Study IV runs both fixes against an information-only alternative; Appendix F.4 compares them.
paragraphs.zh: 两种修复方法都有效。 一个在提交时检查总数的权威账本，增加了一个包含该约束条件的范围。 将担保配额 B_i B_{i}（其中 ∑ i B i = B \sum_{i}B_{i}=B）拆分，可将该约束条件分解为局部约束，但会牺牲灵活性：一个智能体无法借用另一个智能体未使用的份额。 锁定和预留是其他可选方案。 研究 IV 将这两种修复方法与仅依赖信息的替代方案进行了对比；附录 F.4 对它们进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Agents translate constantly. One reports meters and another feet; one emits a JSON schema and another a SQL table; a matcher says class X X in one ontology is class Y Y in another; a refactor renames a function. Call two descriptions equivalent when a meaning-preserving translation connects them and can be undone. A collection of such reversible translations is a groupoid , or a group when the same translations apply to everything. The name carries real content, because it says what to keep: not just the fact that two things are equivalent, but the translation itself.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体持续进行翻译。 一个报告米，另一个报告英尺；一个输出 JSON 模式，另一个输出 SQL 表；一个匹配器表示某个本体中的类 X X 是另一个本体中的类 Y Y；一个重构器重命名了一个函数。 当一种保留意义的翻译能将两个描述连接起来且可以撤销时，称这两个描述为等价的。 这样一组可逆的翻译构成一个群胚；如果相同的翻译适用于所有事物，则构成一个群。 这个名称承载着实际内容，因为它指明了需要保留的内容：不仅是两个事物等价这一事实，还包括翻译本身。

sents.en: Agents translate constantly.
sents.zh: 智能体持续进行翻译。

sents.zh: 当一种保留意义的翻译能将两个描述连接起来且可以撤销时，称这两个描述为等价的。

sents.en: A collection of such reversible translations is a groupoid , or a group when the same translations apply to everything.
sents.zh: 这样一组可逆的翻译构成一个群胚；如果相同的翻译适用于所有事物，则构成一个群。

sents.en: The name carries real content, because it says what to keep: not just the fact that two things are equivalent, but the translation itself.
sents.zh: 这个名称承载着实际内容，因为它指明了需要保留的内容：不仅是两个事物等价这一事实，还包括翻译本身。

paragraphs.en: Here is why. Put agents on the nodes of a graph, and let each edge carry a translation g i ​ j g_{ij} from agent i i ’s format to agent j j ’s, with g j ​ i = g i ​ j − 1 g_{ji}=g_{ij}^{-1} . The system is globally consistent if one underlying object explains every agent’s description: there are frames h i h_{i} with g i ​ j = h i ​ h j − 1 g_{ij}=h_{i}h_{j}^{-1} . This is the noiseless group-synchronization problem [ 54 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 原因如下。 将智能体置于图的节点上，并让每条边承载一个从智能体 i 的格式到智能体 j 的格式的转换 g_{ij}，其中 g_{ji}=g_{ij}^{-1}。 如果存在一个底层对象能够解释每个智能体的描述，那么该系统就是全局一致的：即存在框架 h_i，使得 g_{ij}=h_{i}h_{j}^{-1}。 这就是无噪声的群同步问题 [54]。

sents.en: Here is why.
sents.zh: 原因如下。

sents.zh: 将智能体置于图的节点上，并让每条边承载一个从智能体 i 的格式到智能体 j 的格式的转换 g_{ij}，其中 g_{ji}=g_{ij}^{-1}。

sents.en: This is the noiseless group-synchronization problem [ 54 ] .
sents.zh: 这就是无噪声的群同步问题 [54]。

paragraphs.en: The translations are globally consistent exactly when following them around every loop returns to the identity.
paragraphs.zh: 当在每个循环中遵循这些翻译最终都回到恒等状态时，这些翻译才是全局一致的。

paragraphs.en: One direction is a telescoping product; the other builds frames along a spanning tree. That construction is also the practical algorithm:
paragraphs.zh: 一种方法是望远镜式乘积；另一种方法则是沿着生成树构建框架。 这种构造方式同时也是实用的算法：

sents.en: One direction is a telescoping product; the other builds frames along a spanning tree.
sents.zh: 一种方法是望远镜式乘积；另一种方法则是沿着生成树构建框架。

sents.en: That construction is also the practical algorithm:
sents.zh: 这种构造方式同时也是实用的算法：

paragraphs.en: Pick a spanning forest of the agent graph, fix one frame per tree, and propagate frames along the trees. Then check each remaining edge against the frames at its two ends. The translations are consistent exactly when every such check passes. With | V | |V| agents, | E | |E| translation edges, and c c connected components, this takes β 1 = | E | − | V | + c \beta_{1}=|E|-|V|+c edge checks and O ⁡ ( | V | + | E | ) O(|V|+|E|) compose-and-compare operations, although the graph can contain exponentially many loops.
paragraphs.zh: 选择智能体图的一个生成林，为每棵树固定一个帧，并沿树传播这些帧。 然后，将每条剩余的边与其两端的帧进行比较验证。 当且仅当所有此类验证都通过时，翻译结果才是一致的。 假设有 | V | 个智能体、| E | 条翻译边和 c 个连通分量，此过程需要 β 1 = | E | − | V | + c 次边验证以及 O ⁡ ( | V | + | E | ) 次组合与比较操作，尽管图中可能包含指数级数量的环。

paragraphs.en: Each edge beyond the forest adds one independent constraint; for a finite group, a uniformly random labeling is consistent with probability | G | − β 1 |G|^{-\beta_{1}} (Appendix D ). A loop whose translations do not compose to the identity is said to have nontrivial holonomy . The triangle of Section 3.1 is the smallest example: write “same” as 0 0 and “opposite” as 1 1 , and the loop sums to 0 + 0 + 1 = 1 ≠ 0 0+0+1=1\neq 0 . In ontology matching the same structure appears as a chain of “same as” links that joins two distinct classes of one ontology. No single link looks wrong; only the loop shows the conflict (Studies VIII and IX).
paragraphs.zh: 森林之外的每条边都会增加一个独立的约束；对于一个有限群，均匀随机标记与一致性相符的概率为 | G | − β 1 |G|^{-\beta_{1}}（附录 D）。 如果一个环的平移操作组合不等于恒等映射，则称其具有非平凡的荷诺米。 第 3.1 节的三角形是最小的例子：将“相同”写为 0 0，将“相反”写为 1 1，此时该环的和为 0 + 0 + 1 = 1 ≠ 0 0+0+1=1\neq 0。 在本体匹配中，相同的结构表现为一条由“等同于”链接组成的链，它将同一本体中的两个不同类连接起来。 没有任何单个链接看起来有问题；只有这个环揭示了冲突（研究 VIII 和 IX）。

paragraphs.en: A tempting shortcut is to map every description to a canonical form—a canonical ID, an embedding, a normalized schema—and compare those. That keeps whether two things are equivalent and throws away how . It can hide exactly the failure above: every description looks the same after canonicalization while the loop of translations still does not close (Study VII; Appendix F.1 ). Edits that change the object, such as revising a beam from 1 ​ m 1\,\mathrm{m} to 1.2 ​ m 1.2\,\mathrm{m} , are not translations at all. They are state changes, treated in Section 4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 一个诱人的捷径是将每种描述都映射到一个规范形式——一个规范 ID、一个嵌入向量或一个规范化模式——然后对这些规范形式进行比较。 这种做法保留了两个事物是否等价的信息，却丢弃了它们“如何”等价的细节。 这恰好可能掩盖上述问题：经过规范化处理后，所有描述看起来都一样，但翻译的循环仍然无法闭合（研究 VII；附录 F.1）。 改变对象本身的编辑，例如将一根梁从 1 m 1\,\mathrm{m} 修改为 1.2 m 1.2\,\mathrm{m}，根本不属于翻译。 这些属于状态变化，将在第 4.2 节中讨论。

paragraphs.en: How expensive is coherence? Three results say the answer depends on how agents interact, not on how many there are.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性有多昂贵？ 三项研究结果表明，答案取决于智能体如何互动，而不是它们的数量。

sents.en: How expensive is coherence?
sents.zh: 一致性有多昂贵？

sents.en: Three results say the answer depends on how agents interact, not on how many there are.
sents.zh: 三项研究结果表明，答案取决于智能体如何互动，而不是它们的数量。

paragraphs.en: For finite-domain constraints, dynamic programming over a tree decomposition checks global consistency in time roughly O ⁡ ( n ​ d w + 1 ) O(nd^{w+1}) for n n variables of domain size d d and treewidth w w [ 33 ] . For general constraint problems the exponential dependence on width cannot be substantially removed [ 40 , 57 ] (Appendix D.2 ). A hundred agents in a pipeline can be cheap to keep coherent; five densely coupled agents can be expensive.
paragraphs.zh: 对于有限域约束，基于树分解的动态规划方法检查全局一致性所需的时间大致为 O ⁡ ( n ​ d w + 1 ) O(nd^{w+1})，其中 n 是变量数量，d 是域大小，w 是树宽 [ 33 ]。 对于一般的约束问题，无法显著消除对树宽的指数级依赖 [ 40 , 57 ]（附录 D.2）。 流水线中一百个智能体保持协同可能成本较低；而五个紧密耦合的智能体则可能成本高昂。

sents.en: For finite-domain constraints, dynamic programming over a tree decomposition checks global consistency in time roughly O ⁡ ( n ​ d w + 1 ) O(nd^{w+1}) for n n variables of domain size d d and treewidth w w [ 33 ] .
sents.zh: 对于有限域约束，基于树分解的动态规划方法检查全局一致性所需的时间大致为 O ⁡ ( n ​ d w + 1 ) O(nd^{w+1})，其中 n 是变量数量，d 是域大小，w 是树宽 [ 33 ]。

sents.en: For general constraint problems the exponential dependence on width cannot be substantially removed [ 40 , 57 ] (Appendix D.2 ).
sents.zh: 对于一般的约束问题，无法显著消除对树宽的指数级依赖 [ 40 , 57 ]（附录 D.2）。

sents.en: A hundred agents in a pipeline can be cheap to keep coherent; five densely coupled agents can be expensive.
sents.zh: 流水线中一百个智能体保持协同可能成本较低；而五个紧密耦合的智能体则可能成本高昂。

paragraphs.en: For linear constraints, whether the pieces fit is decided by one short vector, the syndrome , computed from the local specifications by linear algebra. When updates can shift it arbitrarily, the syndrome is also the least a monitor must remember to track coherence over time (Theorem D.3 ). The ring puzzle that defeats every fixed-size check has a one-bit syndrome. Needing a global witness is not the same as being expensive to monitor.

paragraphs.en: Sections 2 and 3 say what can go wrong. This section proposes a runtime, the coherence harness: how it sits next to the model, what it checks when a proposal would change the world, what it remembers, and why the structures from the introduction—a topology, a category, a groupoid, and a sheaf condition—are the ones it needs. paragraphs.en: The split separates three questions that agent research usually blurs. Capability asks whether the model can propose a useful action. Identifiability asks whether the available state contains enough information to determine which actions are valid. Commit correctness asks whether accepted local actions keep the whole system consistent. Agent benchmarks usually score all three at once. The theory predicts cases where scaling capability saturates because the bottleneck is identifiability or commit semantics, not reasoning strength.
paragraphs.zh: 这种划分区分了智能体研究中通常被混淆的三个问题。 能力问题关注的是模型能否提出有用的行动。 可识别性问题关注的是可用状态是否包含足够信息来确定哪些行动是有效的。 提交正确性问题关注的是被接受的局部行动能否保持整个系统的一致性。 智能体基准测试通常同时评估这三个方面。 该理论预测了某些情况：当能力扩展达到饱和时，其瓶颈在于可识别性或提交语义，而非推理能力本身。

paragraphs.en: Two kinds of action look alike in an agent log but behave differently. A re-expression —converting units, translating a schema, re-encoding a record—leaves the underlying object unchanged. A state change —spending budget, editing a design, overwriting a file—does not. If every agent only re-expresses its state and the translations agree where scopes overlap, the result is automatically globally consistent. If agents change state, each change can be locally legal and every overlap can agree while the combination is still no valid world; the shared budget of Section 3.2 is the example. So re-expressions need no commit-time check, and state changes do. Proposition F.4 (Appendix F.6 ) states this precisely. By induction, a trajectory in which every committed step is a re-expression or was checked at commit stays coherent. This is why the framework keeps re-expressions in the groupoid 𝒢 \mathcal{G} and changes in the category 𝒞 \mathcal{C} : the split is exactly the line between what needs no check and what does.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体日志中，两种类型的操作看起来相似，但行为不同。 重表述——转换单位、翻译模式、重新编码记录——不会改变底层对象。 状态变化——支出预算、编辑设计、覆盖文件——则会改变。 如果每个智能体仅对其状态进行重表述，且在不同作用域重叠时这些转换结果一致，那么最终结果将自动实现全局一致性。 如果智能体的状态发生变化，每次变化在局部可能是合法的，所有重叠部分也可能保持一致，但整体组合仍可能不是一个有效世界；第 3.2 节中的共享预算就是这样一个例子。 因此，重表述无需提交时的检查，而状态变化则需要。 命题 F.4（附录 F.6）对此作出了精确陈述。 通过归纳法可知，在一条轨迹中，只要每个已提交的步骤都是重表述，或者在提交时经过了检查，该轨迹就会保持连贯性。 这就是为什么该框架将重表述保留在群胚 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 中，而将状态变化置于范畴 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 中：这一划分恰好区分了哪些操作无需检查，哪些则需要。

paragraphs.en: Agent memory grows without bound, and most of it does not affect what is legal next. Two histories can share one memory state exactly when every possible continuation is legal after one if and only if it is legal after the other. This is the Myhill–Nerode theorem [ 46 ] : the smallest exact monitor has one state per such class. For a budget B B and k k obligations that must be done before finish , the smallest state is the obvious pair, remaining budget and completed obligations: ( B + 1 ) ​ 2 k + 2 (B+1)2^{k}+2 states, but only ⌈ log 2 ⁡ ( B + 1 ) ⌉ + k \lceil\log_{2}(B+1)\rceil+k bits plus a terminal flag (Appendix E ). Provenance, such as which version an artifact was derived from, belongs in memory exactly when it changes which futures are legal. A stale derivation is the standard case (Study III).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的记忆无限增长，但其中大部分并不会影响接下来哪些操作是合法的。 两条历史恰好共享一个记忆状态的条件是：在一条历史之后合法的所有可能延续，在另一条历史之后也同样是合法的。 这就是 Myhill–Nerode 定理 [46]：最小的精确监控器为每个此类类分配一个状态。 对于预算 B 和必须在完成前履行的 k 项义务，最小的状态是显而易见的组合，即剩余预算和已完成的义务：(B+1)2^{k}+2 个状态，但仅需 ⌈log₂(B+1)⌉+k 位加上一个终止标志（附录 E）。 来源信息（例如某个产物源自哪个版本）应当被纳入记忆的条件是：它确实改变了哪些未来操作是合法的。 过时的派生过程是标准情况（研究 III）。

paragraphs.en: An agent reads state, thinks for several turns, and proposes a change. By then the state may have moved. The classical fix is optimistic concurrency control [ 52 ] : record the version of everything the proposal depended on, and at commit atomically check that none of it has changed before applying the change.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体读取状态，经过多轮思考后提出一项变更。 到那时，状态可能已经发生了变化。 经典的解决方案是乐观并发控制 [ 52 ]：记录该变更提案所依赖的所有内容的版本，并在提交时原子性地检查这些内容中是否有任何部分在应用变更前发生了变化。

sents.en: An agent reads state, thinks for several turns, and proposes a change.
sents.zh: 一个智能体读取状态，经过多轮思考后提出一项变更。

sents.en: By then the state may have moved.
sents.zh: 到那时，状态可能已经发生了变化。

sents.en: The classical fix is optimistic concurrency control [ 52 ] : record the version of everything the proposal depended on, and at commit atomically check that none of it has changed before applying the change.
sents.zh: 经典的解决方案是乐观并发控制 [ 52 ]：记录该变更提案所依赖的所有内容的版本，并在提交时原子性地检查这些内容中是否有任何部分在应用变更前发生了变化。

paragraphs.en: Suppose every proposal records every state item it depended on, every write advances the written item’s version, and the version check and the writes happen atomically. Then the committed changes are equivalent to running them one at a time in commit order.
paragraphs.zh: 假设每个提案都记录其依赖的每个状态项，每次写入都会推进所写项目的版本，并且版本检查与写入操作是原子性的。 那么，已提交的变更就等同于按照提交顺序逐个执行这些变更。

sents.en: Suppose every proposal records every state item it depended on, every write advances the written item’s version, and the version check and the writes happen atomically.
sents.zh: 假设每个提案都记录其依赖的每个状态项，每次写入都会推进所写项目的版本，并且版本检查与写入操作是原子性的。

sents.en: Then the committed changes are equivalent to running them one at a time in commit order.
sents.zh: 那么，已提交的变更就等同于按照提交顺序逐个执行这些变更。

paragraphs.en: For an LLM agent the first condition is the hard one. The read set is every authoritative item that entered the model’s context and influenced the proposal, not only the items the final tool call touches. A quote the agent read five turns ago belongs to the read set of the order it places now; this is what ordinary τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench checks miss (Study V). The model’s sampled output is part of the transaction, so the equivalence is to serial execution with the same samples (Appendix E.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LLM 智能体而言，第一个条件是最难满足的。 读取集包括所有进入模型上下文并影响提案的权威信息，而不仅仅是最终工具调用所接触的信息。 智能体五轮对话前读到的某段引文，属于其当前下达订单时的读取集；这正是普通 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 测试所忽略的（研究 V）。 模型采样出的输出是交易的一部分，因此其等价性应体现在使用相同样本的串行执行中（附录 E.2）。

sents.en: For an LLM agent the first condition is the hard one.
sents.zh: 对于 LLM 智能体而言，第一个条件是最难满足的。

sents.en: The read set is every authoritative item that entered the model’s context and influenced the proposal, not only the items the final tool call touches.
sents.zh: 读取集包括所有进入模型上下文并影响提案的权威信息，而不仅仅是最终工具调用所接触的信息。

sents.en: A quote the agent read five turns ago belongs to the read set of the order it places now; this is what ordinary τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench checks miss (Study V).
sents.zh: 智能体五轮对话前读到的某段引文，属于其当前下达订单时的读取集；这正是普通 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 测试所忽略的（研究 V）。

sents.en: The model’s sampled output is part of the transaction, so the equivalence is to serial execution with the same samples (Appendix E.2 ).
sents.zh: 模型采样出的输出是交易的一部分，因此其等价性应体现在使用相同样本的串行执行中（附录 E.2）。

paragraphs.en: The impossibility theorem says only that the runtime must keep every distinction that changes which actions are valid (Proposition 2.4 ), and in a simple system one ledger field does that. The structures appear because in a multi-agent system that state is never in one place and never still. It passes through maps, and each map can lose a distinction the theorem says must be kept. Each structure is the condition that its map loses nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 不可能性定理仅指出，运行时必须保留所有会改变哪些行动有效的那些区别（命题 2.4），而在一个简单的系统中，一个账本字段就能做到这一点。 这些结构之所以出现，是因为在多智能体系统中，状态既不会处于单一位置，也永远不会静止。 它会经过各种映射，而每个映射都可能丢失定理所要求必须保留的区别。 每种结构都是其对应映射不丢失任何内容的条件。

paragraphs.en: A runtime that reads only the agents’ local views can be exact only if the views jointly tell apart every two worlds that allow different actions; this is the impossibility theorem applied to the map from the world to the views. And it commits only states that some real world produces exactly when it rejects every combination of views that matches pairwise but comes from no world. These are the two conditions that define a sheaf, with one weakening that matters in practice: the views need to separate worlds only by which actions they allow, not in every detail (Proposition F.1 ). Section 3 showed both failures.
paragraphs.zh: 一个仅读取智能体局部视图的运行环境，只有当这些视图能共同区分所有允许不同行动的任意两个世界时，才能做到精确；这是将不可能性定理应用于从世界到视图的映射的结果。 并且它只接受那些某个真实世界恰好产生的状态，前提是它拒绝了所有成对匹配但无法由任何世界产生的视图组合。 这两个条件定义了层结构，其中有一个在实践中重要的弱化条件：视图只需通过所允许的行动来区分世界，而非每个细节（命题 F.1）。 第 3 节展示了这两种失败情况。

paragraphs.en: A translation cannot restore a distinction its source format already lost: if agent i i ’s format merges two objects, every format translated from it merges them too. When every format is lossless, the translations between them are forced: each can be undone, and composing them around any loop returns the identity. Conversely, any family of reversible translations that closes around every loop comes from lossless encodings of one object (Proposition F.2 ). That is exactly a groupoid with consistent loops, and Corollary 3.5 checks it.
paragraphs.zh: 一种翻译无法恢复其源格式已经失去的区分：如果智能体 i 的格式合并了两个对象，那么从它翻译而来的每种格式也会将它们合并。 当所有格式都是无损的时，它们之间的翻译就被唯一确定：每个翻译都可以被撤销，并且围绕任何循环组合这些翻译都会返回恒等变换。 反之，任何围绕每个循环都封闭的可逆翻译族，都源于对单个对象的无损编码（命题 F.2）。 这恰好是一个具有一致循环的群胚，而推论 3.5 验证了这一点。
