paragraphs.en: A runtime that must re-read the world after every action to know what is now legal is not keeping state; it is polling. For the runtime to update its own state, the state must keep apart any two worlds that some future sequence of actions would tell apart. A budget shows the difference. With one or two units left, the same actions are legal now, but after one spend they are not. “May spend now” is exact for one step; the remaining count is the smallest state that updates itself (Theorem F.3 , the Myhill–Nerode construction applied to valid actions [ 46 , 60 ] ). Because the updates compose—updating for a a and then for b b is updating for a ​ b ab —actions act on the runtime’s state as a category. The history state D D is the same construction indexed by histories.
paragraphs.zh: 一个必须在每次行动后重新读取世界才能知道当前哪些行动是合法的运行时，并没有维护状态；它只是在轮询。 为了让运行时能够更新自身状态，该状态必须区分任何两个在未来某个行动序列中会被区分开的世界。 预算显示了这种差异。 当还剩一个或两个单位时，相同的行动现在是合法的，但在消耗一个之后就不再合法了。“现在可以消耗”对于单步操作而言是精确的；剩余数量是能够自我更新的最小状态（定理 F.3，将 Myhill–Nerode 构造应用于有效行动 [46, 60]）。 由于这些更新是可组合的——先为 a 更新，再为 b 更新，等同于为 ab 更新——因此行动作为范畴作用于运行时的状态。 历史状态 D 是同一构造按历史索引的结果。

paragraphs.en: Consider a runtime that must accept exactly the valid actions and commit only realizable states. If it accepts arbitrary combinations of local views at commit, it needs the gluing check. If agents use several lossless formats, it needs reversible, loop-consistent translations. If it must update its state under actions without re-reading the world, it needs the self-updating state. Conversely, with one scope there is nothing to glue, with one format there is nothing to translate, and when no action changes the state the self-updating state reduces to the exact state of Proposition 2.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一个运行时，它必须仅接受有效的动作，并且只提交可实现的状态。 如果它在提交时接受局部视图的任意组合，那么就需要粘合检查。 如果智能体使用多种无损格式，那么就需要可逆且循环一致的转换。 如果它必须在执行动作时更新自身状态，而无需重新读取世界，那么就需要自更新状态。 反之，当只有一个作用域时，就没有需要粘合的内容；当只有一种格式时，就没有需要转换的内容；而当没有任何动作改变状态时，自更新状态就简化为命题 2.4 中的精确状态。

paragraphs.en: This is the sense in which the framework is principled rather than arbitrary. Remove a map and its corresponding property drops out; add the map under the assumptions above and exact validation requires that property. The named mathematical structure is a standard compositional realization, not the only possible implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 正是在这个意义上，该框架才具有原则性，而非随意性。 移除一个映射，其对应的属性也会随之消失；在上述假设下添加该映射，则严格的验证需要该属性。 这种有名称的数学结构是一种标准的组合实现，而非唯一可能的实现方式。

paragraphs.en: Appendix F.3 gives the precise conditions and proofs. The corollary is what the predictions of Section 5.11 test: each structure should help where its map can lose information, and add only overhead elsewhere. It also explains the ties in Studies III and VI. The corollary constrains properties, not machinery. A version counter, a dependency engine, or a residual solver meets the relevant condition in its own domain, and there it should match the general runtime. The structures are the general way to meet the conditions across boundaries where no such mechanism exists.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 F.3 给出了精确的条件和证明。 该推论正是第 5.11 节中预测所检验的内容：每种结构都应在其映射可能丢失信息的地方提供帮助，而在其他地方仅增加额外开销。 它还解释了研究 III 和 VI 中的平局情况。 该推论约束的是属性，而非机制本身。 版本计数器、依赖引擎或残差求解器在其各自的领域内满足相关条件，并且在这些领域中应与通用运行时相匹配。 当不存在此类机制时，这些结构就是跨越边界满足条件的通用方法。

paragraphs.en: The same pattern—first a requirement for sufficient information, then a structure chosen to preserve it as it is distributed—appears in team decision theory, in atlases of charts in geometry, in sufficient statistics and filtering, and in version control, where a merge conflict is a gluing failure (Appendix F.3 ). The impossibility theorem does not force this design on its own. Weakening the goal, querying for the information, restructuring the state, or accepting probabilistic success are legitimate alternatives, each with a cost (Appendix F.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 同样的模式也出现在团队决策理论、几何学中的图表集、充分统计量和过滤技术，以及版本控制中——在版本控制里，合并冲突就是一种粘合失败（附录 F.3）。 不可能性定理本身并不会强制采用这种设计。 弱化目标、查询所需信息、重构状态或接受概率性成功都是合理的替代方案，而每种方案都伴随着代价（附录 F.4）。

paragraphs.en: Putting the pieces together gives the framework of the introduction as five runtime components: H H , where things meet; 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , what can change; 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , what only looks changed; ℱ \mathcal{F} , whether one world glues; and D D , what still matters. Figure 2 shows them on one example; the table says what each does and what fails without it.
paragraphs.zh: 将各部分整合起来，便得到了引言的框架，即五个运行时组件：H H，事物交汇之处；𝒞 \mathcal{C}，可能发生变化的事物；𝒢 \mathcal{G}，仅看似发生变化的事物；ℱ \mathcal{F}，一个世界是否与其他世界相连接；以及 D D，仍然重要的事物。 图 2 在一个示例中展示了这些组件；表格则说明了每个组件的作用，以及缺少它们时会发生什么故障。

paragraphs.en: For readers who know the categorical form: the translations 𝒢 \mathcal{G} make the assignment of states to the scopes of H H a groupoid-valued presheaf 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , the gluing check ℱ \mathcal{F} is its descent condition, and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} is a category-valued prestack whose groupoid core is 𝒮 \mathcal{S} . Appendix F.3 spells this out. The experiments use only the concrete checks; the formalism is what guarantees that those checks are the right ones.

paragraphs.en: A model supplies proposals; an authoritative state holds the distinctions that matter; a governed commit decides which proposals change the world. The model can remain stochastic. The runtime need not reproduce its chain of thought and need not replace domain solvers. It must own the distinctions required by Theorem 2.1 and Proposition 2.4 , check global consistency where local checks are not enough, and check state changes at commit.

paragraphs.en: Each component catches failures the others cannot see, so none of them is redundant. Two systems can agree on every other component and still differ on the one in question. paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems today are organized by job title. A tech lead oversees the project, engineers do the work, and the pricing role waits until the design is done. These choices are made by human intuition. They are often right, but nothing says when they are necessary or what else would work. The framework turns each of them into a question about state, and each question has an answer among the results above. Fix the roles 1 , … , m 1,\ldots,m . For role i i , let W i W_{i} be the items of authoritative state its proposals write, and let R i R_{i} be every item whose value can change whether its proposals are valid. R i R_{i} therefore includes the scope of every constraint the proposal must respect, not only the fields the tool call touches. In the beam example of Figure 2 , the Cost agent’s quote has R cost ∋ beam length R_{\mathrm{cost}}\ni\text{beam length} , which the Design agent writes, and both agents’ spends read the shared budget.
paragraphs.zh: 如今的智能体系统是按职位头衔来组织的。 技术负责人负责监督项目，工程师执行工作，而定价角色则等待设计完成。 这些选择是基于人类的直觉做出的。 这些选择通常是对的，但没有任何机制说明何时需要它们，或者还有哪些其他方法可行。 该框架将每个选择转化为一个关于状态的问题，而每个问题在上述结果中都有对应的答案。 固定角色 1, …, m 1,\ldots,m 。 对于角色 i，令 W_i 为其提案所写入的权威状态项，令 R_i 为所有因该提案是否有效而可能改变值的项。 因此，R_i 包含了提案必须遵守的所有约束范围，而不仅仅是工具调用所涉及的字段。 在图 2 的光束示例中，成本智能体的报价包含 R_cost ∋ beam length，该项由设计智能体写入，而两个智能体的支出都读取共享预算。

paragraphs.en: Give each role the distinctions its decisions need. The harness can reject an invalid proposal, but it cannot make a role propose a valid one. Role i i can always propose an admissible action exactly when every fiber of its own context Ω i \Omega_{i} has a common admissible action for that role (Theorem 2.1 ); otherwise the harness keeps rejecting it. Its information set is its own: a decision taken by role i i is bounded by Ω i \Omega_{i} and the messages it has received, not by the union of all views (Corollary 2.2 ). A context that never merges two worlds allowing that role different actions is always sufficient (Proposition 2.4 ). Finding the smallest one is NP-hard (Theorem 2.5 ), so in practice it is chosen greedily.
paragraphs.zh: 为每个角色提供其决策所需的区分信息。 该约束机制可以拒绝无效提议，但无法促使某个角色提出有效的提议。 角色 i 总能且仅当其自身上下文 Ω i 的每条纤维都对该角色存在一个共同的可行行动时，才能提出一个可接受的动作（定理 2.1）；否则，该约束机制会持续拒绝它。 其信息集仅限于自身：角色 i 所做的决策受限于 Ω i 以及其已接收的消息，而非所有视图的并集（推论 2.2）。 一个从未将两个允许该角色采取不同行动的合并的世界融合在一起的上下文总是充分的（命题 2.4）。 寻找最小的此类上下文是 NP-难的（定理 2.5），因此实践中通常采用贪心策略进行选择。

paragraphs.en: Give every cross-role constraint an owner. A constraint whose scope lies in no single role’s W i W_{i} , and whose actions are not invariant-confluent, cannot be protected by the roles checking independently (Proposition 3.3 for a budget; Bailis et al. [ 9 ] in general). It needs either a scope that contains it and is checked at commit (a ledger), or a split into local constraints (escrow, ∑ i B i = B \sum_{i}B_{i}=B ); locks, reservations, and conservative stopping are costlier alternatives (Appendix F.4 ). In the formal sense this is what leading means: the lead for a constraint is whichever component holds its whole scope and refuses violating commits. A person or an agent can lead in this sense only by holding that state authoritatively and controlling the commit, which is the harness’s job. A lead agent that receives only summaries is one more Ω i \Omega_{i} , and Corollary 2.2 binds it like any other role. Study IV shows the difference: a team with a Planner and a Verifier overspent when shown the live count, and both an owning ledger and escrow quotas stopped it.
paragraphs.zh: 为每个跨角色约束指定一个所有者。 如果一个约束的作用域不属于任何单个角色的 W i W_{i}，且其操作不具备不变性汇流特性，那么独立检查的角色无法保护该约束（预算情况参见命题 3.3；一般情况参见 Bailis 等人 [9]）。 它要么需要一个包含自身并在提交时受到检查的作用域（即账本），要么需要拆分为局部约束（托管账户，∑ i B i = B \sum_{i}B_{i}=B）；锁、预留和保守停止则是成本更高的替代方案（附录 F.4）。 从形式化意义上说，这正是“主导”的含义：某个约束的主导者，是持有其全部作用域并拒绝违规提交的组件。 一个人或智能体要在此意义上发挥主导作用，必须权威地持有该状态并控制提交过程，而这正是约束机制的职责。 一个仅接收摘要的主导智能体，不过是另一个 Ω i \Omega_{i}，而推论 2.2 对其的约束与其他角色无异。 研究 IV 揭示了这种差异：当展示实时计数时，配备规划器和验证器的团队出现了超支现象，而拥有专属账本和托管配额则阻止了这种情况的发生。

If W i ∩ R j = W j ∩ R i = W i ∩ W j = ∅ W_{i}\cap R_{j}=W_{j}\cap R_{i}=W_{i}\cap W_{j}=\varnothing , neither role can invalidate the other. Committing them in either order gives the same state, and the version check of Proposition 4.1 never fires, so parallel work is free. These are Bernstein’s conditions for parallel execution [ 18 ] , with R i R_{i} widened to everything that bears on validity. When W i ∩ R j ≠ ∅ W_{i}\cap R_{j}\neq\varnothing , as when Design writes the length that Cost reads, there are three correct options, each with a price:

sents.en: When W i ∩ R j ≠ ∅ W_{i}\cap R_{j}\neq\varnothing , as when Design writes the length that Cost reads, there are three correct options, each with a price:

paragraphs.en: Sequence j j after i i , which is a lock. This is “pricing waits for engineering,” and it costs latency.

paragraphs.en: Run in parallel with a check at commit. Role j j records the versions of R j R_{j} , and the harness rejects or reruns j j ’s proposal if i i has since written. This is correct by Proposition 4.1 and costs rework in proportion to how often the two actually conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 与提交时的检查并行运行。 角色 j 记录 R_j 的版本，如果 i 在此之后已写入，则测试框架会拒绝或重新运行 j 的提案。 根据命题 4.1，这是正确的，其返工成本与两者实际冲突的频率成正比。

paragraphs.en: Restructure the dependency. Cost quotes a named version, and the history state D D records that provenance, so a later design change invalidates the quote instead of silently outdating it (Theorem F.3 , Study III). Escrow is the same move applied to a budget: it shrinks each R i R_{i} to the role’s own share, which makes the roles independent.
paragraphs.zh: 重构依赖关系。 成本报价引用了一个命名版本，而历史状态 D D 记录了该来源信息，因此后续的设计变更会使得报价失效，而不是悄无声息地使其过时（定理 F.3，研究 III）。 托管机制是将同样的操作应用于预算：它将每个 R i R_{i} 缩减为角色自身的份额，从而使各角色相互独立。

sents.en: Restructure the dependency.

paragraphs.en: The common-sense rule is therefore one point on a trade-off, not the only correct design.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，常识规则只是权衡取舍中的一个点，而非唯一正确的设计。

paragraphs.en: Shape who must reconcile with whom. Let H H record which roles’ scopes overlap and on which state, as in Section 1 ; two roles overlap when ( R i ∪ W i ) ∩ ( R j ∪ W j ) ≠ ∅ (R_{i}\cup W_{i})\cap(R_{j}\cup W_{j})\neq\varnothing , or when a translation must hold between their encodings. If H H is acyclic in the sense of Theorem 3.1 (it has a join tree), checking each handoff is enough. Cycles remove that general guarantee, and no fixed locality bound works universally across unrestricted constraint semantics (Proposition 3.2 ). For translation handoffs, either the whole cycle space is certified, at a cost of β 1 = | E | − | V | + c \beta_{1}=|E|-|V|+c checks (Corollary 3.5 ), or a hub that owns the shared fields makes every other role overlap only with the hub, so H H becomes a star, which is a tree. This is why hub-and-spoke orchestration often works, and it says what the hub must hold. Exact finite-domain checking can cost time exponential in the treewidth of H H (Section 3.4 ), so the design target is low width rather than few agents.

paragraphs.en: Each step rests on the result it cites, and together they address the failure modes of Sections 2 and 3 . Like the framework itself (Corollary 4.2 ), a step matters only where its condition is present: a team with one encoding needs no translations, and roles with disjoint read and write sets need no schedule. The steps do not give the optimal team. They do not say which role does the work best, which is a matter of capability. And the cheapest design meeting the conditions involves problems that are hard in general: the smallest sufficient context is NP-hard to find (Theorem 2.5 ), and exact checking grows exponentially with the width of H H (Section 3.4 ). What they replace is the guesswork. “Should this be led by the tech lead?” becomes “which constraint spans these roles, and who holds its scope?” “Should pricing wait?” becomes “does W design W_{\mathrm{design}} meet R cost R_{\mathrm{cost}} , and which of the three options is cheapest here?” Individual steps have direct evidence: ownership and escrow in Study IV, commit-time version checks in Study V, provenance invalidation in Study III, and loop checks and full versus split views in Studies VII–IX. Testing the procedure as a whole is an open experiment (Section 5.12 ).

paragraphs.en: Each study targets one claim of the theory. The agent studies and the real-data study could have come out the other way; the deterministic studies confirm that a mechanism behaves as proved. The table lists them in paper order; the text below says how much weight each can bear.

paragraphs.en: All agent studies use one LLM, gpt-6-sol , with the reasoning effort stated in each study. The conclusions are designed to hold for any model, for three reasons. The impossibility theorem binds every policy however capable, so no model can lift Study I’s aliased tasks above chance. Each causal study holds the model fixed and changes only what state the agents see or what the runtime enforces, so every comparison measures the state, not the model. And Study I shows the model is competent: it solves every task whose deciding event it can see. A stronger model improves what agents do with the information they have; the theory says it cannot recover information they lack. Repeating the frozen designs with other model families is a direct replication and the natural next test. Every agent panel was frozen before its first scored call and ran under a spending cap fixed in its preregistration, so no panel could be extended, or stopped early, after its results were seen.
paragraphs.zh: 所有智能体研究都使用一个大型语言模型 gpt-6-sol，并在每项研究中说明了其推理努力程度。 这些结论的设计旨在基于三个原因对任何模型都成立。 不可能定理约束了所有无论能力多强的策略，因此没有任何模型能将研究 I 中的别名任务表现提升至偶然水平之上。 每项因果研究都保持模型固定，仅改变智能体所观察到的状态或运行时强制执行的内容，因此每次比较衡量的是状态而非模型。 并且研究 I 表明该模型具备能力：它能解决所有其决策事件可以被观察到的任务。 更强的模型能提升智能体利用已有信息所完成的任务表现；但理论指出，它无法恢复智能体所缺乏的信息。 使用其他模型家族重复这些冻结设计，是直接复制实验，也是顺理成章的下一步测试。 每个智能体小组在其首次评分调用前均被冻结，并在其预注册时固定的支出上限下运行，因此没有任何小组在结果显现后能够被延长或提前终止。

paragraphs.en: Read together, the nine studies trace the boundary the theory draws. The runtime wins where the deciding state is missing or unowned (Studies I, IV, V, and IX), and it ties where a conventional mechanism already owns that state (Studies III and VI, and the predicted-tie half of Study V). Both halves matter: a theory that only predicted wins could not be wrong. Studies I, IV, IX, and the Study V revision panel are the causal agent experiments: each holds the model fixed and changes only what state the agents see or what the runtime enforces. Study VIII shows that the failure Study IX isolates is common in real matching systems. Studies III, VI, and VII are deterministic checks: VII confirms that the certificate works as proved, and III and VI confirm that conventional mechanisms match the runtime where they already own the relevant state. Study II and the Study V structural audit are descriptive; they show that the structures the theory is about are present in public benchmarks, not that a coherence mechanism improves them. Every result is backed by recorded run data and, for the deterministic studies, an executable reproduction.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这九项研究追踪了该理论所划定的边界。 在决定性状态缺失或未受控制的情况下（研究 I、IV、V 和 IX），运行时机制会获胜；而在传统机制已控制该状态的情况下（研究 III 和 VI，以及研究 V 中预测为平局的半数情况），则会形成平局。 两种结果都具有重要意义：一个仅预测胜利的理论与错误无关。 研究 I、IV、IX 以及研究 V 的修订小组属于因果智能体实验：每个实验都保持模型不变，仅改变智能体所见的状态或运行时机制所强制执行的内容。 研究 VIII 表明，研究 IX 所识别出的失败现象在真实的匹配系统中普遍存在。 研究 III、VI 和 VII 是确定性验证：研究 VII 证实了证书按证明方式有效运行，而研究 III 和 VI 则证实，在传统机制已控制相关状态的情况下，其表现与运行时机制一致。 研究 II 和研究 V 的结构审计属于描述性分析；它们表明理论所讨论的结构确实存在于公开基准测试中，但并未证明一致性机制能够改善这些结构。 所有结果均有记录在案的运行数据支持，对于确定性研究，还提供了可执行的复现程序。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 2.1 and its quantitative forms predict a sharp contrast. On an aliased fiber with pairwise-disjoint admissible sets, no policy that reasons, samples, or deliberates on the same observation can succeed with probability above 1 / k 1/k (Theorem 2.3 ); one added authoritative distinction resolves the task; and a tool query helps exactly when it splits the fiber (Theorem B.4 ). Study I tests all three directly, on a synthetic benchmark we built so that the aliasing is exact by construction. Each task is a 60-event revision log in which three teams commit, revert, or re-apply changes to one shared parameter. The agent must name the current head, and the commit server rejects any other parent. The final event is one of three operations that leave three different heads, and the options are exactly those three. In the identifiable version the final event is visible; in the aliased version it is redacted, so the prompt is identical across all three truths, chance is 1 / 3 1/3 , and there is no fallback action. Forty paired tasks were frozen before any scored call; every arm uses gpt-6-sol .
paragraphs.zh: 定理 2.1 及其量化形式预测了一种显著差异。 在一个具有成对不相交容许集的混叠纤维上，任何基于同一观察结果进行推理、采样或审慎决策的策略，其成功概率都无法超过 1 / k（定理 2.3）；增加一个权威区分即可解决该任务；而工具查询仅在它能分割该纤维时有效（定理 B.4）。 研究 I 直接测试了这三种情况，所用的是我们构建的合成基准，其中混叠特性通过构造被精确控制。 每个任务都是一个包含 60 个事件的修订日志，其中三个团队会对一个共享参数进行提交、回滚或重新应用更改。 智能体必须指出当前的头节点，而提交服务器会拒绝任何其他父节点。 最终事件是三种操作之一，这三种操作会产生三个不同的头节点，且选项恰好就是这三个。 在可识别版本中，最终事件是可见的；而在混叠版本中，它被删除了，因此提示在所有三种真相下都相同，概率为 1 / 3，且没有备用行动。 在开始任何评分调用之前，已冻结了四十个成对任务；每个分支都使用 gpt-6-sol。

sents.en: Theorem 2.1 and its quantitative forms predict a sharp contrast.
sents.zh: 定理 2.1 及其量化形式预测了一种显著差异。

sents.en: On an aliased fiber with pairwise-disjoint admissible sets, no policy that reasons, samples, or deliberates on the same observation can succeed with probability above 1 / k 1/k (Theorem 2.3 ); one added authoritative distinction resolves the task; and a tool query helps exactly when it splits the fiber (Theorem B.4 ).
sents.zh: 在一个具有成对不相交容许集的混叠纤维上，任何基于同一观察结果进行推理、采样或审慎决策的策略，其成功概率都无法超过 1 / k（定理 2.3）；增加一个权威区分即可解决该任务；而工具查询仅在它能分割该纤维时有效（定理 B.4）。

sents.en: Study I tests all three directly, on a synthetic benchmark we built so that the aliasing is exact by construction.
sents.zh: 研究 I 直接测试了这三种情况，所用的是我们构建的合成基准，其中混叠特性通过构造被精确控制。

sents.en: Each task is a 60-event revision log in which three teams commit, revert, or re-apply changes to one shared parameter.
sents.zh: 每个任务都是一个包含 60 个事件的修订日志，其中三个团队会对一个共享参数进行提交、回滚或重新应用更改。

sents.en: The agent must name the current head, and the commit server rejects any other parent.
sents.zh: 智能体必须指出当前的头节点，而提交服务器会拒绝任何其他父节点。

sents.en: The final event is one of three operations that leave three different heads, and the options are exactly those three.
sents.zh: 最终事件是三种操作之一，这三种操作会产生三个不同的头节点，且选项恰好就是这三个。

sents.en: In the identifiable version the final event is visible; in the aliased version it is redacted, so the prompt is identical across all three truths, chance is 1 / 3 1/3 , and there is no fallback action.
sents.zh: 在可识别版本中，最终事件是可见的；而在混叠版本中，它被删除了，因此提示在所有三种真相下都相同，概率为 1 / 3，且没有备用行动。

sents.en: Forty paired tasks were frozen before any scored call; every arm uses gpt-6-sol .
sents.zh: 在开始任何评分调用之前，已冻结了四十个成对任务；每个分支都使用 gpt-6-sol。

paragraphs.en: Every arm solves every identifiable task, so the model has the competence the task requires. On aliased tasks, observed accuracy ranges from 12/40 to 17/40, and no arm that keeps the same observation significantly exceeds 1 / 3 1/3 (best one-sided binomial p = 0.14 p=0.14 ), whether it reasons longer, deliberates in two roles, or votes over five samples. This failure to reject does not establish empirical equivalence to chance; the exact impossibility result comes from the task construction and Theorem 2.3 . Model-stated confidence is 1.0 on identifiable tasks and 0.35–0.45 on aliased single-agent arms; the majority arm’s 0.58 is its five-sample vote share, not stated confidence. The single sentence naming the current head raises accuracy to 40/40 (23 tasks gained over medium effort, none lost; McNemar p = 1.2 × 10 − 7 p=1.2\times 10^{-7} ). A query tool that can read the redacted event also reaches 40/40 and read that event in all 40 runs, while a matched tool that returns only visible team notes stays at 13/40 (27 tasks gained, none lost; p = 7.5 × 10 − 9 p=7.5\times 10^{-9} ). All four preregistered hypotheses hold; the frozen report is marked incomplete because one majority-vote cell failed on a transient API error, which cannot change the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都能解决所有可识别的任务，因此模型具备任务所需的处理能力。 在存在歧义的任务中，观测到的准确率介于 12/40 到 17/40 之间，且没有任何保持相同观测结果的智能体能显著超过 1/3（最佳单侧二项检验 p = 0.14），无论其推理时间更长、以两种角色进行审议，还是对五个样本进行投票。 这种无法拒绝原假设的结果并未证明其与随机结果存在经验上的等价性；严格的不可行性结论源于任务构造和定理 2.3。 模型声明的置信度在可识别任务中为 1.0，而在存在歧义的单一智能体任务中为 0.35–0.45；多数智能体的 0.58 是其五个样本投票中的份额，而非声明的置信度。 仅用一句话命名当前负责人使准确率提升至 40/40（相比中等努力水平增加了 23 项任务，未减少任何一项；麦克尼马尔检验 p = 1.2 × 10⁻⁷）。 能够读取已编辑事件的查询工具也达到了 40/40 的准确率，并在全部 40 次运行中读出了该事件；而仅返回可见团队笔记的匹配工具则停留在 13/40（增加了 27 项任务，未减少任何一项；p = 7.5 × 10⁻⁹）。 所有四个预先注册的假设均成立；由于一个多数投票单元格因临时 API 错误而失败，冻结报告被标记为不完整，但该错误无法改变最终结果。

paragraphs.en: This is the paper’s central claim in its cleanest form. Across the tested arms, more reasoning, more roles, and more samples on the same observation leave observed accuracy statistically compatible with the information-theoretic value of 1 / 3 1/3 ; one authoritative distinction, supplied directly or through a query that splits the fiber, raises the observed result to 40/40. The theorem, not a null result from forty tasks, supplies the general limit.
paragraphs.zh: 这是该论文最简洁形式的核心主张。 在所有受测试的分支中，针对同一观察结果，更多的推理、更多的角色以及更多的样本，使得观测到的准确率在统计上与信息论理论值 1 / 3 1/3 保持一致；而一个权威性的区分——无论是直接提供，还是通过分割纤维的查询获得——则将观测结果提升至 40/40。 该定理而非四十项任务中的零结果，提供了普遍的上限。

paragraphs.en: TeamBench structurally separates Planner, Executor, and Verifier permissions and provides deterministic artifact graders [ 51 ] . In its Restricted condition a single agent works without the full specification, so the requirements reach the work only if a teammate relays them; this is the information asymmetry the theory is about. We recomputed five-condition summaries from the six cross-model result files released with TeamBench (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5 mini, GPT-5 nano, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 on 28 tasks); no new model runs are involved. Requiring all five conditions for the same model–task pair leaves 164 matched cells, representing 820 condition records at seed 0.
paragraphs.zh: TeamBench 在结构上将规划器、执行器和验证器的权限分离，并提供确定性的成果评分器 [ 51 ]。 在受限条件下，单个智能体在没有完整规格说明的情况下工作，因此只有当队友传递要求时，这些要求才能传达给执行者；这正是该理论所探讨的信息不对称问题。 我们基于 TeamBench 随附的六个跨模型结果文件（Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite、Gemini 3 Flash、GPT-5 mini、GPT-5 nano、Claude Haiku 4.5 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6，共 28 项任务）重新计算了五种条件的摘要；此过程未涉及任何新的模型运行。 要求同一模型–任务对同时满足全部五个条件后，剩余 164 个匹配单元格，对应于种子为 0 时的 820 条条件记录。

sents.en: TeamBench structurally separates Planner, Executor, and Verifier permissions and provides deterministic artifact graders [ 51 ] .
sents.zh: TeamBench 在结构上将规划器、执行器和验证器的权限分离，并提供确定性的成果评分器 [ 51 ]。

sents.en: In its Restricted condition a single agent works without the full specification, so the requirements reach the work only if a teammate relays them; this is the information asymmetry the theory is about.

sents.zh: 我们基于 TeamBench 随附的六个跨模型结果文件（Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite、Gemini 3 Flash、GPT-5 mini、GPT-5 nano、Claude Haiku 4.5 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6，共 28 项任务）重新计算了五种条件的摘要；此过程未涉及任何新的模型运行。

sents.zh: 要求同一模型–任务对同时满足全部五个条件后，剩余 164 个匹配单元格，对应于种子为 0 时的 820 条条件记录。

paragraphs.en: TeamBench’s default grader fails any run that lacks a valid attestation file, the Verifier’s sign-off, even when every task check passes. Its own leaderboard counts such attestation-only failures as passes. We report pass rate both ways.
paragraphs.zh: TeamBench 的默认评分器会判定任何缺少有效认证文件（即 Verifier 的签署确认）的运行失败，即使所有任务检查都通过了。 它自己的排行榜却将这类仅因缺少认证而导致的失败计为通过。 我们会同时报告这两种情况下的通过率。

sents.en: TeamBench’s default grader fails any run that lacks a valid attestation file, the Verifier’s sign-off, even when every task check passes.
sents.zh: TeamBench 的默认评分器会判定任何缺少有效认证文件（即 Verifier 的签署确认）的运行失败，即使所有任务检查都通过了。

sents.en: Its own leaderboard counts such attestation-only failures as passes.
sents.zh: 它自己的排行榜却将这类仅因缺少认证而导致的失败计为通过。

sents.en: We report pass rate both ways.
sents.zh: 我们会同时报告这两种情况下的通过率。

paragraphs.en: Each role carries weight under either grading. Removing the Planner lowers pass rate by 14.0 points with the default grader and by 11.0 points with attestation-only failures counted as passes (the full team wins 26 matched cells and loses 8; two-sided sign test p = 0.003 p=0.003 ); mean partial score falls by 0.068. Removing the Verifier lowers pass rate by 11.0 and 11.6 points (22 wins, 3 losses; p = 0.0002 p=0.0002 ), and mean partial by 0.051. Task-cluster bootstrap intervals for the two partial-score differences are [ 0.029 , 0.115 ] [0.029,0.115] and [ 0.016 , 0.086 ] [0.016,0.086] , and under the default grader every model loses pass rate when either role is removed. Against the single agent that lacks the specification, the full team gains 13.4 points even with attestation-only failures counted as passes (25 wins, 3 losses).
paragraphs.zh: 在两种评分标准下，每个角色都具有一定权重。 移除规划器后，使用默认评分器时通过率下降 14.0 分；若仅将认证失败计为通过，则下降 11.0 分（完整团队赢得 26 个匹配单元格，输掉 8 个；双侧符号检验 p = 0.003 p=0.003）；平均部分得分下降 0.068。 移除验证器后，通过率分别下降 11.0 分和 11.6 分（赢得 22 个，输掉 3 个；p = 0.0002 p=0.0002），平均部分得分下降 0.051。 两种部分得分差异的任务集群自助置信区间分别为 [ 0.029 , 0.115 ] [0.029,0.115] 和 [ 0.016 , 0.086 ] [0.016,0.086]；在使用默认评分器时，移除任一角色都会导致所有模型的通过率下降。 在与缺少规格说明的单个智能体对比中，即使仅将认证失败计为通过，完整团队仍可获得 13.4 分的提升（赢得 25 个，输掉 3 个）。

sents.zh: 在两种评分标准下，每个角色都具有一定权重。

paragraphs.en: TeamBench reports that its Full Team is not significantly better than Solo on average (a + 0.5 +0.5 -point uplift on its 155-task reference ablation with Gemini 3 Flash) [ 51 ] . The large gap in our default-grader column, 35.4% versus 15.9%, does not contradict that result; it is mostly an attestation effect. Without a Verifier, a single agent often never writes the sign-off: 102 of 164 single-agent runs fail the attestation check, against 26 of 164 full-team runs. Once attestation-only failures count as passes, the gap shrinks to 36.0% versus 31.1%. The team wins 18 cells and loses 10, which is not significant (sign test p = 0.18 p=0.18 ) and agrees with TeamBench’s null. The team keeps a modest edge in mean partial score (0.764 versus 0.709; task-cluster interval [ 0.017 , 0.093 ] [0.017,0.093] ). That edge is consistent with TeamBench’s finding that teams help most where single-agent performance is low, which describes these six models: on its leaderboard, for example, Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 gain 20.0 and 16.7 points from the team.
paragraphs.zh: TeamBench 报告称，其“完整团队”在平均表现上并未显著优于“单人模式”（在其包含 155 个任务的参考消融测试中，与 Gemini 3 Flash 相比仅提升了 +0.5 +0.5 分）[ 51 ]。 我们默认评分器列中的巨大差距（35.4% 对比 15.9%）并不与该结果矛盾；这主要是一个认证效应。 如果没有验证器，单个智能体通常永远无法写出最终确认：在 164 次单人智能体运行中，有 102 次未通过认证检查，而完整团队运行中仅有 26 次未通过。 一旦仅因认证失败的情况也被视为通过，差距缩小至 36.0% 对比 31.1%。 团队在 18 个单元格中胜出，在 10 个单元格中失利，这一结果并不显著（符号检验 p = 0.18 p=0.18），且与 TeamBench 的零假设一致。 团队在平均部分得分上仍保持微弱优势（0.764 对比 0.709；任务簇区间为 [ 0.017 , 0.093 ] [0.017,0.093]）。 这一优势与 TeamBench 的发现一致：团队主要在单人智能体表现较低的情况下提供帮助，而这六个模型正是如此。例如，在其排行榜上，Sonnet 4.6 和 Haiku 4.5 通过团队协作分别获得了 20.0 分和 16.7 分的提升。

sents.en: TeamBench reports that its Full Team is not significantly better than Solo on average (a + 0.5 +0.5 -point uplift on its 155-task reference ablation with Gemini 3 Flash) [ 51 ] .

sents.en: The large gap in our default-grader column, 35.4% versus 15.9%, does not contradict that result; it is mostly an attestation effect.
sents.zh: 我们默认评分器列中的巨大差距（35.4% 对比 15.9%）并不与该结果矛盾；这主要是一个认证效应。

sents.en: Without a Verifier, a single agent often never writes the sign-off: 102 of 164 single-agent runs fail the attestation check, against 26 of 164 full-team runs.
sents.zh: 如果没有验证器，单个智能体通常永远无法写出最终确认：在 164 次单人智能体运行中，有 102 次未通过认证检查，而完整团队运行中仅有 26 次未通过。

sents.en: Once attestation-only failures count as passes, the gap shrinks to 36.0% versus 31.1%.
sents.zh: 一旦仅因认证失败的情况也被视为通过，差距缩小至 36.0% 对比 31.1%。

sents.en: The team wins 18 cells and loses 10, which is not significant (sign test p = 0.18 p=0.18 ) and agrees with TeamBench’s null.
sents.zh: 团队在 18 个单元格中胜出，在 10 个单元格中失利，这一结果并不显著（符号检验 p = 0.18 p=0.18），且与 TeamBench 的零假设一致。

sents.en: The team keeps a modest edge in mean partial score (0.764 versus 0.709; task-cluster interval [ 0.017 , 0.093 ] [0.017,0.093] ).

That edge is consistent with TeamBench’s finding that teams help most where single-agent performance is low, which describes these six models: on its leaderboard, for example, Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 gain 20.0 and 16.7 points from the team.
sents.zh: 这一优势与 TeamBench 的发现一致：团队主要在单人智能体表现较低的情况下提供帮助，而这六个模型正是如此。例如，在其排行榜上，Sonnet 4.6 和 Haiku 4.5 通过团队协作分别获得了 20.0 分和 16.7 分的提升。

paragraphs.en: When the specification is split across roles, the Planner and the Verifier each carry weight, and a team recovers much of what the uninformed single agent loses. Whether a team beats a fully informed single agent is not established here; it depends on how the attestation is graded. Because the panel varies structure together with inference budget and opportunities for correction, isolating the state-semantics hypothesis is left to the fixed-budget intervention of Study IV.
paragraphs.zh: 当规范被分配到不同角色时，规划器和验证器各自都具有一定权重，团队能够恢复许多原本由无信息单一智能体所失去的能力。 团队能否超越完全知情的单一智能体在此尚未确定；这取决于认证如何评分。 由于评审小组的结构会随着推理预算和纠正机会的变化而改变，因此对状态-语义假设的孤立分析被留到研究四的固定预算干预部分进行。

paragraphs.en: The theory makes two claims about memory that this study checks directly. First, two states with identical current values can differ in whether they are still valid, so a check that sees only current values is aliased: by Theorem 2.1 applied to the checker, it cannot tell a fresh derivation from a stale one. The distinction lives in the history state D D , here the provenance of which input revision each artifact was built from (Theorem F.3 ). Second, a conventional mechanism that already tracks that provenance should match the general runtime exactly (Prediction 4). It is the smallest executable form of both claims.
paragraphs.zh: 该理论对记忆提出了两项主张，本研究将直接验证这两项主张。 首先，两个具有相同当前值的状态可能在是否仍然有效方面存在差异，因此仅检查当前值的机制会产生别名：根据应用于检查器的定理 2.1，它无法区分新的推导和过时的推导。 这种区别存在于历史状态 D D 中，即此处每个工件是由哪个输入修订版本构建而来的来源（定理 F.3）。 其次，一个已经追踪该来源的传统机制应当与通用运行时完全一致（预测 4）。 这是两项主张最小的可执行形式。

sents.zh: 该理论对记忆提出了两项主张，本研究将直接验证这两项主张。

sents.zh: 其次，一个已经追踪该来源的传统机制应当与通用运行时完全一致（预测 4）。

sents.zh: 这是两项主张最小的可执行形式。

paragraphs.en: The instrument is a synthetic, deterministic pipeline that we built for this test; no public benchmark and no LLM are involved. Eight source inputs each feed a chain of three derived artifacts, as an analysis pipeline turns datasets into cleaned tables, fitted results, and report figures. Every artifact records its value and the revision of each source it was derived from. One source changes before planning, and the plan recomputes its chain. Then, between planning and commit, a second source is reissued as a new revision with the same value, as when an input is re-approved or re-signed. The three artifacts derived from it now cite a superseded revision. Their values are numerically correct and every artifact is well formed, so every local check passes, including one that recomputes the values and compares only the numbers. A commit is unsafe if the committed pipeline contains any artifact derived from a superseded revision. The eight cases, one per seed, vary the coefficients and which chains are involved, not the failure.
paragraphs.zh: 该工具是我们为本次测试构建的合成确定性流程；其中不涉及任何公开基准或大型语言模型。 每个源输入都会向由三个派生产物组成的链式流程提供数据，正如分析流程将数据集转化为清洗后的表格、拟合结果和报告图表一样。 每个产物都会记录其自身值以及它源自的每个源的修订版本。 在规划阶段之前，其中一个源发生了变化，于是该计划重新计算了其整个链式流程。 随后，在规划与提交之间，第二个源以具有相同值的新修订版本重新发布，就像输入被重新批准或重新签署时一样。 由此派生的三个产物现在引用的是一个已被取代的修订版本。 它们的数值是正确的，且每个产物都结构完整，因此所有本地检查均通过，包括重新计算数值并仅比较数字的检查。 如果已提交的流程包含任何源自已被取代修订版本的产物，则该提交是不安全的。 这八种情况（每种种子对应一种）改变了系数和涉及的具体链式流程，但并未改变故障本身。

paragraphs.en: We compare four guards, each run on all eight cases:
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了四种智能体，每种智能体都在全部八个案例上运行：

paragraphs.en: In this instrument a guard commits unsafely exactly when it misses the late revision, so the column also reads as detection: the first two guards detect 0 of 8 late revisions, and the last two detect 8 of 8.
paragraphs.zh: 在此仪器中，当守卫未能检测到延迟修订时，它才会不安全地行动，因此该列也读作“检测”：前两个守卫在 8 次延迟修订中检测到了 0 次，而后两个守卫则检测到了全部 8 次。

paragraphs.en: The two failing guards fail for different reasons, and each reason is a result of the theory. Local checks fail because the stale state and the fresh state look identical artifact by artifact: an aliasing failure, not a reasoning failure. Changed-source closure fails although it is a correct dependency engine, because it checks against the state as it was at planning time; this is the stale-read condition of Proposition 4.1 , which requires validation against everything read, at commit. The two passing guards both keep provenance and both validate at commit, and they tie exactly. That tie is the prediction, not a disappointment: where a conventional mechanism already owns the relevant history, the general runtime should add nothing (Prediction 4, Corollary 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 两个失败的智能体失败的原因各不相同，而每个原因都是该理论的结果。 局部检查之所以失败，是因为旧状态和新状态在每一个具体产物上都看起来完全相同：这是一种别名冲突问题，而非推理错误。 尽管已更改源数据的闭包是一个正确的依赖引擎，但它仍然会失败，因为它依据的是规划时的状态进行检查；这就是命题 4.1 中提到的“旧读”条件，该条件要求在提交时验证所有读取的内容。 两个通过测试的智能体都保留了来源信息，并且都在提交时通过了验证，它们的结果完全一致。 这种一致性正是预期结果，而非令人失望之处：当一个传统机制已经拥有相关历史时，通用运行时不应添加任何额外内容（预测 4，推论 4.2）。

Studies V and IX test the runtime where no conventional check owns the relevant state.

paragraphs.en: Proposition 3.3 predicts that a budget shared by several agents cannot be protected by the agents themselves, however well informed, and that two remedies work: an owner that refuses the violating commit, or a split into per-role quotas. Study IV tests this on TeamBench [ 51 ] in three panels, each frozen before scoring, with one model held fixed ( gpt-6-sol at medium reasoning effort) on the same three hard tasks: a budgeted workflow (LH2), specification-to-tests (TEST1), and leader election (DIST5, a control). The prediction holds on every safety count. Ordinary teams overspend the 20-call budget in 5 of 5 runs. Showing them the live count still leaves 4 of 5. Enforcing the budget at commit leaves 0 of 5, and so do per-role escrow quotas. Mean task progress does not fall in the five-run enforced comparison; the panel is too small for a noninferiority claim. How we got there is itself evidence: the first panel’s guard made no difference because it owned a different variable from the one the task and grader counted, and once ownership was aligned, the guard removed the failure.
paragraphs.zh: 命题 3.3 预测，即使多个智能体掌握充分信息，它们也无法自行保护由多个智能体共享的预算；但有两种解决方案有效：要么由所有者拒绝违规提交，要么将预算拆分为按角色分配的配额。 研究 IV 在 TeamBench [51] 上通过三个面板对此进行了测试，每个面板在评分前均已冻结，其中一种模型（gpt-6-sol，中等推理强度）在相同的三项困难任务上保持固定：有预算限制的工作流（LH2）、从规范到测试的转换（TEST1），以及领导者选举（DIST5，对照组）。 该预测在所有安全指标上均成立。 普通团队在全部 5 次运行中均有 5 次超出了 20 次调用的预算限制。 即使向它们展示实时计数，仍有 4/5 次超出预算。 在提交时强制执行预算限制后，5 次中有 0 次超出；按角色分配的担保配额也产生了相同效果。 在五次运行的受控比较中，平均任务进度并未下降；但面板样本量过小，无法据此得出非劣效性结论。 我们达成这一结果的过程本身即是证据：第一个面板中的防护机制并未产生任何影响，因为它所控制的变量与任务和评分标准计数的变量不同；而一旦所有权对齐，该防护机制便消除了失败现象。

paragraphs.en: The 27-run panel compared an ordinary Planner–Executor–Verifier team, TeamBench’s budget-matched solo agent, and a coherent_full team with a ledger guard and attestation gate. Their strict passes were 1/9, 0/9, and 1/9, with mean partial scores 0.856, 0.833, and 0.856. The arms did not separate because the guard, task, and grader measured different state. The generator drew workspace limits from 15 to 30 while the specification and grader fixed 20; the guard counted an internal script ledger that the task already self-limited; and the attestation gate enforced presence rather than the truth of the attested claim. A post-scoring audit found the actual shared-budget failure: ordinary teams issued 55–67 shell commands and guarded teams 22–57 against the stated limit of 20, while solo agents issued 4–6. This is the ownership condition of Proposition 2.4 : a guard constrains the state it owns and nothing else.

paragraphs.en: Before a second panel, the budget was pinned at 20; the task defined calls to TeamBench’s shell-command tool, run , summed across the team, as the authoritative unit; the guard rejected a call before execution once the aggregate reached 20; the evaluator counted that same unit from saved logs; and the attestation gate required both a pass verdict and a successful rerun of the task’s visible check. A fourth arm, visible_state , exposed exactly the same live budget and attestation state without enforcing either. Across the three team arms, model, prompts, tools, turn and remediation caps, tasks, and graders were held fixed; the budget-matched solo arm is a non-causal efficiency reference. All five preregistered seed blocks completed within the spending cap: three tasks, four arms, 60 runs.
paragraphs.zh: 在第二个面板之前，预算被固定为 20；任务定义了 TeamBench 的 shell-command 工具的调用（run），并将整个团队的调用总和作为权威单位；当累计值达到 20 时，守卫会在执行前拒绝一次调用；评估者从保存的日志中统计了相同的单位；而认证关卡则要求同时通过判定并成功重新运行任务的可见检查。 第四个分支 visible_state 暴露了完全相同的实时预算和认证状态，但并未强制执行其中任何一项。 在三个团队分支中，模型、提示词、工具、轮次与修复上限、任务以及评分器均保持不变；预算匹配的独立分支是一个非因果的效率参考。 所有五个预先注册的种子块都在支出上限内完成：三个任务、四个分支、60 次运行。

paragraphs.en: On LH2, every enforced run stopped at exactly 20 executed calls, rejecting 1–32 surplus attempts (mean 10.4). Ordinary teams issued 57–72 calls; showing the live count lowered the median from 70 to 29 but still left 4/5 violations. Enforcement therefore removed the targeted failure while exposure alone did not. Progress did not collapse: on LH2, coherent_full scored 0.874 mean partial with 2/5 strict passes versus 0.860 and 0/5 for the ordinary team; on TEST1 it scored 0.820 versus 0.740; and on the DIST5 control both guarded arms scored 0.900 versus 0.860. TEST1 showed the same ordering on missing-or-false attestations—2/5 under enforcement, 3/5 with exposure, 5/5 ordinarily—although hidden mutant misses remained outside the visible check the gate owned.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LH2 上，每次强制执行运行都恰好停在第 20 次调用处，并拒绝了 1–32 次多余的尝试（均值为 10.4）。 普通团队发出了 57–72 次调用；实时计数将中位数从 70 降至 29，但仍留下了 4/5 的违规情况。 因此，强制执行消除了目标失败，而仅靠暴露则未能做到这一点。 进展并未崩溃：在 LH2 上，coherent_full 的平均部分得分为 0.874，严格通过率为 2/5，而普通团队的成绩为 0.860 和 0/5；在 TEST1 上，其得分为 0.820，对比普通团队的 0.740；而在 DIST5 控制测试中，两种受控方法均得分 0.900，对比普通团队的 0.860。 TEST1 在缺失或虚假的认证上显示出相同的排序——强制执行下为 2/5，暴露情况下为 3/5，普通情况下为 5/5——尽管隐藏突变体的未命中情况仍位于可见检查范围之外。

paragraphs.en: Appendix F.4 lists classical alternatives to a shared ledger: expose a counter without refusing, stop conservatively when remaining budget is uncertain, or restructure the invariant into fixed per-role escrow quotas. A third, separately frozen panel held the second panel’s LH2 task, model, seeds, and grader fixed, reused the ordinary and ledger arms, and ran three new arms (15 cells): query_counter (live count, no refuse), conservative_stop (refuse once remaining would fall below slack 5), and quota_escrow (executor 14 + verifier 6). Attestation gates were off on the new arms so the contrast isolates the budget escape.
paragraphs.zh: F.4 附录列出了共享账簿的经典替代方案：公开计数器但不拒绝请求，在剩余预算不确定时采取保守策略停止，或者将不变量重构为按角色划分的固定托管配额。 第三个独立冻结的面板保留了第二个面板的 LH2 任务、模型、种子和评分器不变，重用了普通分支和账簿分支，并运行了三个新分支（15 个单元格）：query_counter（实时计数，不拒绝）、conservative_stop（一旦剩余预算低于 5 的容差即拒绝）以及 quota_escrow（执行者 14 + 验证者 6）。 新分支上的认证门处于关闭状态，因此这种对比能够单独隔离预算溢出问题。

paragraphs.en: Information alone still fails: the query counter overspends in 4/5 runs, matching the visible_state finding. Both ownership mechanisms succeed on safety. Escrow matches the ledger at 0/5 violations and has higher observed progress on this panel (mean partial 0.960 versus 0.874; strict 4/5 versus 2/5). That progress gap is descriptive, not a causal ledger-versus-escrow contrast: there are only five seeds, and the reused ledger arm still carries the attestation gate that the escape arms turned off. The safety result is unambiguous: for this additive shared budget, splitting into local quotas is enough. Conservative stopping also prevents overspend by construction, at the cost of unused slack (every run stops at 15). The frozen decision is therefore restructuring suffices for this invariant : a unique shared-ledger claim is not required on LH2. The general runtime remains warranted where no such restructuring is available a priori, as in Study IX’s split-view conflicts.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠信息仍然无法解决问题：在 5 次运行中，查询计数器有 4 次出现超额支出，这与 visible_state 的发现一致。 两种所有权机制在安全性方面均取得成功。 托管机制在 5 次违规中有 0 次与账本一致，且在本面板上观察到的进展更高（平均部分进度为 0.960，对比 0.874；严格一致性为 4/5，对比 2/5）。 这种进展差异仅具有描述性，并非账本与托管机制之间的因果对比：实验仅使用了五个种子，而重复使用的账本分支仍然保留着被逃生分支关闭的认证门控。 安全性结果明确无误：对于这种可加共享预算，将其拆分为局部配额就足够了。 保守停止策略也能从结构上防止超额支出，但代价是未使用的剩余额度（每次运行都在 15 处停止）。 因此，对于这一不变量而言，冻结决策只需重构即可：在 LH2 中不需要唯一的共享账本声明。 在没有先验重构可能性的情况下（如研究 IX 中的分视图冲突），通用的运行时保障仍然成立。

paragraphs.en: Each panel isolates one claim of the theory.
paragraphs.zh: 每个面板都单独展示了该理论的一个论点。

paragraphs.en: Information is not ownership. The visible_state and query_counter arms gave every agent the exact live count, and the teams still overspent in 4 of 5 runs. The agents were not missing the fact, and the team already had a dedicated Planner and Verifier, so neither more context nor more roles closes the gap (Proposition 3.3 , Corollary 2.2 ). Visibility lowered the median spend from 70 to 29 calls, but not below the limit: it changes behavior without guaranteeing the invariant.
paragraphs.zh: 信息不等于所有权。 visible_state 和 query_counter 分支为每个智能体提供了精确的实时计数，但团队在 5 次运行中仍有 4 次超额支出。 智能体并非没有意识到这一点，而且团队已经拥有专门的规划器和验证器，因此无论是增加更多上下文还是更多角色都无法填补这一差距（命题 3.3，推论 2.2）。 可见性将平均支出从 70 次调用降低到了 29 次，但并未低于限制：它改变了行为，却未能保证不变量的成立。

paragraphs.en: Ownership works, in either of its two forms. Refusal at commit and per-role escrow both reach 0 of 5, the two remedies Proposition 3.3 names. Observed mean progress is not lower in either five-run panel. This rules out collapse in these runs, not a general safety–progress trade-off; the escrow–ledger progress contrast is additionally confounded by different attestation gates.
paragraphs.zh: 所有权在两种形式下都能发挥作用。 提交时的拒绝和按角色划分的托管机制都达到了 0/5，这正是命题 3.3 所提及的两种补救措施。 在五个运行组中，观察到的平均进度均没有降低。 这排除了这些运行中的崩溃情况，而非普遍存在的安全与进度之间的权衡；此外，托管与账本进度的对比还因不同的验证门限而受到干扰。

paragraphs.en: A guard is only as good as the state it owns. The first panel’s guard was active and still changed nothing, because it counted a different quantity from the task’s limit (Proposition 2.4 , Prediction 7). For harness builders this is the most practical lesson: before asking whether a guard works, check that it guards the variable the task is scored on.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体的价值仅取决于其所控制的系统状态。 第一块面板的智能体是活跃的，但依然没有改变任何结果，因为它所计量的数值与任务设定的限制不同（命题 2.4，预测 7）。 对于智能体构建者而言，这是最实用的经验：在询问某个智能体是否有效之前，应先确认它是否真正保护了任务评分所依据的变量。

paragraphs.en: Within each comparison the model, prompts, tools, tasks, and graders were fixed, so the differences come from what the harness owns, not from the model. The limits are those of a small panel: three tasks, five seeds per cell, and one model family.

paragraphs.en: τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench is unusually well matched to the coherence hypothesis because the benchmark itself makes global state distributed. The user controls device-side actions, the assistant controls carrier-side actions, and the environment evaluates the joint result [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 与一致性假设的匹配程度异常高，因为该基准本身就将全局状态进行了分布式处理。 用户控制设备侧的操作，助手控制载体侧的操作，而环境则评估联合结果 [ 12 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We audited the 114 public base tasks in the pinned τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench v0.2.0 Telecom corpus, containing 803 initialization actions, 516 declared golden actions, and 209 terminal environment assertions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们审计了固定版 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench v0.2.0 Telecom 语料库中的 114 个公共基础任务，其中包括 803 个初始化动作、516 个声明的黄金动作以及 209 个终端环境断言：

paragraphs.en: 97 of 114 initialize both user/device and assistant/carrier state;
paragraphs.zh: 114 中的第 97 个同时初始化用户/设备和助手/载体的状态；

paragraphs.en: 71 declare golden actions for both requestors;
paragraphs.zh: 71 为两个请求者声明黄金动作；

paragraphs.en: 59 assert postconditions in both environments;
paragraphs.zh: 59 在两种环境中断言后置条件；

paragraphs.en: 94 declare at least two golden actions and 82 declare at least three;
paragraphs.zh: 94 声明至少两个黄金动作，以及 82 声明至少三个；

paragraphs.en: 98 contain at least eight initialization, golden-action, and assertion items.
paragraphs.zh: 98 至少包含八个初始化、黄金动作和断言项。

paragraphs.en: The counts show that dual-control global state is central to the benchmark. The golden actions describe benchmark solutions rather than observed trajectories or uniquely required action sequences; all 71 dual-requestor cases are graded through terminal environment assertions rather than exact action matching. The 114 generated cases are not independent real-world samples. Thus the audit establishes prevalent two-actor structure, not model performance; it contains structures relevant to typed locality, transformation semantics, compatibility, and dynamics without testing a coherence intervention. Representation equivalence is exercised less, so 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is predicted to add little marginal value unless the task construction is extended.
paragraphs.zh: 统计结果表明，双控制全局状态是该基准测试的核心。 黄金动作描述的是基准解决方案，而非观察到的轨迹或唯一必需的动作序列；所有 71 个双请求者案例均通过终端环境断言进行评分，而非通过精确匹配动作。 这 114 个生成的案例并非独立的真实世界样本。 因此，此次审计确立了普遍存在的两角色结构，而非模型性能；它包含了与类型化局部性、转换语义、兼容性和动态性相关的结构，但并未测试一致性干预措施。 表示等价性的运用较少，因此预测 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 几乎不会带来额外价值，除非任务构建得到扩展。

paragraphs.en: The audit shows where the structure is; the panel tests whether owning it matters. We injected three kinds of coherence failure into public Telecom tasks. In a stale read , a carrier fact the assistant already read changes before it writes. In an authority change , an action that was allowed becomes forbidden during the conversation. In a silent revert , a carrier change the assistant already committed is undone. There are 12 injected tasks on 7 public base tasks, plus the 7 bases uninjected as controls. Task labels give the kind of injection: S1–S4 inject a stale read, A1–A4 an authority change, and P1–P4 a change after a committed step (in P1 a payment fails to post; P2–P4 are silent reverts). The τ 2 \tau^{2} agent, user simulator, conversation loop, and evaluator are unmodified; the agent is gpt-6-sol at medium effort and the simulated user is gpt-6-sol at low effort. Three arms differ only in how the assistant’s write calls are handled. The unguarded arm uses the stock tools. The conventional arm adds three policy preconditions from the Telecom policy, checked on the current carrier state at call time. The coherence arm adds two things on top: read-set validation, which rejects a write when a fact it depends on has changed since the agent read it (Proposition 4.1 ), and a committed-effect monitor, which sends one notice if a postcondition of an earlier committed write stops holding.
paragraphs.zh: 审计显示了结构所在之处；而面板测试则检验了拥有该结构是否重要。 我们在公开的电信任务中注入了三种类型的连贯性故障。 在陈旧读取中，助手在写入之前，载体的某个事实已经发生了变化。 在权限变更中，原本被允许的操作在对话过程中变成了禁止操作。 在静默回滚中，助手此前已提交的载体变更被撤销了。 在 7 个公开基础任务上共注入了 12 个任务，此外还有 7 个未注入的基础任务作为对照。 任务标签表明了注入的类型：S1–S4 注入陈旧读取，A1–A4 注入权限变更，而 P1–P4 则是在已提交步骤之后发生的变更（在 P1 中，支付未能成功记录；P2–P4 是静默回滚）。 τ² 智能体、用户模拟器、对话循环和评估器均未修改；智能体为中等努力程度的 gpt-6-sol，模拟用户则为低努力程度的 gpt-6-sol。 三个分支仅在处理助手写入调用方式上有所不同。 无防护分支使用原始工具。 常规分支增加了来自电信政策的三项策略前提条件，并在调用时根据当前载体状态进行验证。 连贯性分支在此基础上又增加了两项内容：读取集验证（当助手所依赖的某个事实自其读取以来发生变化时，拒绝执行写入操作，见命题 4.1），以及已提交效果监控器（如果早期已提交的写入操作的某个后置条件不再成立，则发送一条通知）。

sents.en: The audit shows where the structure is; the panel tests whether owning it matters.
sents.zh: 审计显示了结构所在之处；而面板测试则检验了拥有该结构是否重要。

sents.zh: 我们在公开的电信任务中注入了三种类型的连贯性故障。

sents.en: In a stale read , a carrier fact the assistant already read changes before it writes.
sents.zh: 在陈旧读取中，助手在写入之前，载体的某个事实已经发生了变化。

sents.zh: 在权限变更中，原本被允许的操作在对话过程中变成了禁止操作。

sents.zh: 在静默回滚中，助手此前已提交的载体变更被撤销了。

sents.zh: 在 7 个公开基础任务上共注入了 12 个任务，此外还有 7 个未注入的基础任务作为对照。

sents.zh: 任务标签表明了注入的类型：S1–S4 注入陈旧读取，A1–A4 注入权限变更，而 P1–P4 则是在已提交步骤之后发生的变更（在 P1 中，支付未能成功记录；P2–P4 是静默回滚）。

sents.en: The τ 2 \tau^{2} agent, user simulator, conversation loop, and evaluator are unmodified; the agent is gpt-6-sol at medium effort and the simulated user is gpt-6-sol at low effort.

sents.zh: 三个分支仅在处理助手写入调用方式上有所不同。

sents.en: The unguarded arm uses the stock tools.
sents.zh: 无防护分支使用原始工具。

sents.en: The conventional arm adds three policy preconditions from the Telecom policy, checked on the current carrier state at call time.
sents.zh: 常规分支增加了来自电信政策的三项策略前提条件，并在调用时根据当前载体状态进行验证。

sents.en: The coherence arm adds two things on top: read-set validation, which rejects a write when a fact it depends on has changed since the agent read it (Proposition 4.1 ), and a committed-effect monitor, which sends one notice if a postcondition of an earlier committed write stops holding.
sents.zh: 连贯性分支在此基础上又增加了两项内容：读取集验证（当助手所依赖的某个事实自其读取以来发生变化时，拒绝执行写入操作，见命题 4.1），以及已提交效果监控器（如果早期已提交的写入操作的某个后置条件不再成立，则发送一条通知）。

paragraphs.en: The theory predicts a split, not a blanket win, and the split was frozen before any scored episode. When the injected change breaks a policy precondition, an ordinary current-state check already catches it, so conventional and coherence should tie (Prediction 4). When no current precondition fails—the fact behind a legal write went stale, or a committed change stopped holding—only a runtime that remembers what was read and what was committed can see the problem. All 222 episodes completed, with no infrastructure failures.
paragraphs.zh: 该理论预测的是分裂，而非全面胜利，而且这种分裂在任何得分回合之前就已经被冻结了。 当注入的变化破坏策略的前置条件时，普通的当前状态检查已经能够捕捉到这一点，因此传统方法和一致性方法的结果应当一致（预测 4）。 当没有当前前置条件失败时——即合法写入背后的事实已经过时，或已提交的变化不再有效——只有能够记住已读内容和已提交内容的运行时才能发现问题。 全部 222 个回合均已完成，且未出现任何基础设施故障。

sents.zh: 当没有当前前置条件失败时——即合法写入背后的事实已经过时，或已提交的变化不再有效——只有能够记住已读内容和已提交内容的运行时才能发现问题。

sents.en: All 222 episodes completed, with no infrastructure failures.
sents.zh: 全部 222 个回合均已完成，且未出现任何基础设施故障。

paragraphs.en: The frozen decision rules are all met: the split is confirmed. Three readings follow, in increasing order of strength.
paragraphs.zh: 所有冻结的决策规则均已满足：分割已确认。 接下来是三次读数，强度依次递增。

sents.en: The frozen decision rules are all met: the split is confirmed.
sents.zh: 所有冻结的决策规则均已满足：分割已确认。

sents.en: Three readings follow, in increasing order of strength.
sents.zh: 接下来是三次读数，强度依次递增。

paragraphs.en: Where an ordinary check owns the invariant, it is enough. When a contract ends mid-call or a second overdue bill posts, the unguarded agent resumes the line anyway (14 of 34 exposed episodes), and both guarded arms stop every such write with the same reward. This is the same predicted tie as in Studies III and VI: where a conventional mechanism owns the invariant, the runtime adds nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个普通检查拥有该不变量时，这就足够了。 当合约在调用中途结束或出现第二张逾期账单时，未受保护的智能体仍会继续执行该流程（34个已暴露案例中的14个），而两个受保护分支都会以相同的奖励阻止所有此类写入操作。 这与研究III和VI中预测的平局结果一致：当一个传统机制拥有该不变量时，运行时不会增加任何内容。

sents.en: Where an ordinary check owns the invariant, it is enough.
sents.zh: 当一个普通检查拥有该不变量时，这就足够了。

sents.en: When a contract ends mid-call or a second overdue bill posts, the unguarded agent resumes the line anyway (14 of 34 exposed episodes), and both guarded arms stop every such write with the same reward.
sents.zh: 当合约在调用中途结束或出现第二张逾期账单时，未受保护的智能体仍会继续执行该流程（34个已暴露案例中的14个），而两个受保护分支都会以相同的奖励阻止所有此类写入操作。

sents.en: This is the same predicted tie as in Studies III and VI: where a conventional mechanism owns the invariant, the runtime adds nothing.
sents.zh: 这与研究III和VI中预测的平局结果一致：当一个传统机制拥有该不变量时，运行时不会增加任何内容。

paragraphs.en: Stale reads are invisible to current-state checks. When a price or bill amount changed after the agent quoted it, the conventional arm committed on the old figure in 10 of 10 episodes; every one of those writes was legal at call time. The coherence arm’s zero is guaranteed by the definition of its check, so it is not the informative number. The informative numbers are that the agent never re-read on its own, and that after one rejection it re-read, re-quoted, and lost no reward. The τ 2 \tau^{2} grader itself does not penalize these stale commits (the conventional arm scores 1.00 on them), so this violation is one the benchmark does not see.
paragraphs.zh: 过时的读取操作对当前状态检查是不可见的。 当智能体报出价格或账单金额后该金额发生变化时，传统策略在所有 10 个实验实例中均按旧数值执行操作；这些写入操作在调用时刻均为合法操作。 一致性策略的零值由其检查机制的定义所保证，因此它并非信息性数值。 信息性数值在于：智能体从未主动重新读取，并且在一次拒绝后，它进行了重新读取、重新报价，且未损失任何奖励。 τ² 评分器本身不会对这些过时的执行操作进行惩罚（传统策略在这些操作上的得分为 1.00），因此这种违规行为是基准测试所无法察觉的。

sents.en: Stale reads are invisible to current-state checks.
sents.zh: 过时的读取操作对当前状态检查是不可见的。

sents.zh: τ² 评分器本身不会对这些过时的执行操作进行惩罚（传统策略在这些操作上的得分为 1.00），因此这种违规行为是基准测试所无法察觉的。

paragraphs.en: Silent reverts are the strongest result, and it is behavioral. When a line activation, a roaming change, or a data refuel was quietly undone after the agent committed it, the unguarded and conventional arms scored 0.00 and 0.07 on τ 2 \tau^{2} ’s own grader: they believed the job was done. The coherence arm scored 1.00 in 15 of 15 episodes. It received one notice each time, and the agent redid the change. Nothing in the design forces this outcome; the agent had to act on the notice. This is the transition layer in practice: a runtime that keeps committed postconditions as part of its state turns an invisible reversal into a visible one.
paragraphs.zh: 静默回滚是最强的结果，而且这是一种行为表现。 当某条线路的激活、一次漫游变更或一次数据补给在智能体执行后被悄然撤销时，未受保护的传统分支在 τ₂ 自身的评分器上获得了 0.00 和 0.07 的分数：它们认为任务已经完成。 在全部 15 个回合中，连贯性分支有 15 次获得了 1.00 的分数。 它每次都会收到一条通知，而智能体则会重新执行该变更。 设计本身并未强制产生这一结果；智能体必须根据通知采取行动。 这就是实践中的过渡层：一个将已提交的后续条件保留在自身状态中的运行时，会将一次不可见的回滚转化为一次可见的回滚。

sents.en: The coherence arm scored 1.00 in 15 of 15 episodes.
sents.zh: 在全部 15 个回合中，连贯性分支有 15 次获得了 1.00 的分数。

sents.zh: 它每次都会收到一条通知，而智能体则会重新执行该变更。

paragraphs.en: The guard was cheap. No correct action was rejected in any uninjected control, and coherence episodes on injected tasks were shorter (44 messages versus 51) and cheaper. The panel has weak spots, recorded rather than fixed because the design was frozen. In two tasks (S1 and A3) the agent re-reads the changed fact before acting, so no arm, including unguarded, ever acts on stale data. In one task (P1) the frozen success criterion was too narrow: when a payment failed to post, agents in every arm handed the customer to a human instead of requesting payment again, so its reward is 0 in every arm, though its violation count remains valid. One unguarded control episode failed through an ordinary agent error. The panel has five runs per injected cell, uses one model family for both agent and simulated user, and injects the failures itself; it measures what the mechanism does when these failures occur, not how often they occur naturally.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体成本较低。 在任何未注入的对照组中，都没有正确的行动被拒绝；而在注入任务中的连贯性事件则更短（44条消息对比51条）且成本更低。 该面板存在薄弱环节，由于设计已定稿，因此这些环节仅被记录而非修复。 在两个任务（S1和A3）中，智能体在行动前会重新阅读已更改的事实，因此没有任何分支（包括无防护分支）会基于过时数据采取行动。 在一个任务（P1）中，固化的成功标准过于狭窄：当付款未能成功提交时，所有分支中的智能体都会将客户转交给人类处理，而不是再次请求付款，因此其奖励在所有分支中均为0，尽管其违规计数仍然有效。 一个无防护的对照组事件因普通智能体错误而失败。 该面板每个注入单元格运行五次，为智能体和模拟用户使用同一模型家族，并由其自身注入故障；它衡量的是当这些故障发生时机制的行为，而非它们自然发生的频率。

sents.en: The guard was cheap.
sents.zh: 该智能体成本较低。

sents.en: No correct action was rejected in any uninjected control, and coherence episodes on injected tasks were shorter (44 messages versus 51) and cheaper.
sents.zh: 在任何未注入的对照组中，都没有正确的行动被拒绝；而在注入任务中的连贯性事件则更短（44条消息对比51条）且成本更低。

sents.zh: 该面板存在薄弱环节，由于设计已定稿，因此这些环节仅被记录而非修复。

sents.en: In two tasks (S1 and A3) the agent re-reads the changed fact before acting, so no arm, including unguarded, ever acts on stale data.
sents.zh: 在两个任务（S1和A3）中，智能体在行动前会重新阅读已更改的事实，因此没有任何分支（包括无防护分支）会基于过时数据采取行动。

sents.en: In one task (P1) the frozen success criterion was too narrow: when a payment failed to post, agents in every arm handed the customer to a human instead of requesting payment again, so its reward is 0 in every arm, though its violation count remains valid.
sents.zh: 在一个任务（P1）中，固化的成功标准过于狭窄：当付款未能成功提交时，所有分支中的智能体都会将客户转交给人类处理，而不是再次请求付款，因此其奖励在所有分支中均为0，尽管其违规计数仍然有效。

sents.en: One unguarded control episode failed through an ordinary agent error.
sents.zh: 一个无防护的对照组事件因普通智能体错误而失败。

sents.en: The panel has five runs per injected cell, uses one model family for both agent and simulated user, and injects the failures itself; it measures what the mechanism does when these failures occur, not how often they occur naturally.
sents.zh: 该面板每个注入单元格运行五次，为智能体和模拟用户使用同一模型家族，并由其自身注入故障；它衡量的是当这些故障发生时机制的行为，而非它们自然发生的频率。

paragraphs.en: Prediction 4 says that where a conventional mechanism already owns the relevant state, the general runtime should do exactly as well as that mechanism, no better and no worse. Study III checked this on a pipeline we built. This study checks it on a public engineering benchmark whose classical tools are decades old: iterate coupled equations until they converge, and restart when the design version changes. A tie is the expected result. A runtime win here would mean the classical tools were broken; a loss would mean the general semantics costs more than they do.
paragraphs.zh: 预测 4 指出，在常规机制已经拥有相关状态的情况下，通用运行时表现应与该机制完全一致，既不会更好，也不会更差。 研究 III 在我们构建的一条流程上对此进行了验证。 这项研究在一个公共工程基准上进行了验证，其经典工具已有数十年历史：迭代耦合方程直至收敛，并在设计版本变更时重新开始。 打平是预期的结果。 如果运行时在此处获胜，则意味着经典工具存在缺陷；如果失败，则意味着通用语义学的成本高于它们本身。

paragraphs.en: The Sobieski Supersonic Business Jet (SSBJ) is a standard multidisciplinary design benchmark with exact public equations [ 35 , 36 , 71 ] . Four disciplines play the role of agents, each a deterministic function; no LLM is involved. Structure computes weights from the lift and the engine weight. Aerodynamics computes lift and drag from those weights and the engine scale factor. Propulsion computes engine weight, scale factor, and fuel consumption from the drag. Mission computes the aircraft’s range from all of them. The first three form a cycle: three feedback values (lift, engine weight, and engine scale factor) must equal what each consumer assumed when it ran. In the paper’s terms, the coupling graph is H H , and the gluing condition ℱ \mathcal{F} is that every shared value equals the value its consumer used, so that the four disciplines describe one aircraft. We use GEMSEO’s public implementation of the equations; our independent reconstruction of the Propulsion and Mission submodels matches published values to within 7 × 10 − 8 7\times 10^{-8} (Appendix G.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: Sobieski 超音速商务喷气机（SSBJ）是一个标准的跨学科设计基准，具有精确的公开方程 [ 35 , 36 , 71 ] 。 四个学科扮演智能体的角色，每个学科都是一个确定性函数；不涉及任何大型语言模型。 结构学科根据升力和发动机重量计算权重。 空气动力学学科根据这些权重和发动机比例因子计算升力和阻力。 推进系统学科根据阻力计算发动机重量、比例因子和燃料消耗量。 任务规划学科根据所有上述参数计算飞机的航程。 前三个学科构成一个循环：三个反馈值（升力、发动机重量和发动机比例因子）必须等于每个学科在运行时所假设的值。 用论文中的术语来说，耦合图是 H H ，而粘合条件 ℱ \mathcal{F} 是：每个共享值都必须等于其使用者所使用的值，这样四个学科才能共同描述一架飞机。 我们使用了 GEMSEO 对这些方程的公开实现；我们对推进系统和任务规划子模型的独立重建结果与已发表值的差异在 7 × 10 − 8 7\times 10^{-8} 以内（附录 G.3 ）。

sents.en: The Sobieski Supersonic Business Jet (SSBJ) is a standard multidisciplinary design benchmark with exact public equations [ 35 , 36 , 71 ] .
sents.zh: Sobieski 超音速商务喷气机（SSBJ）是一个标准的跨学科设计基准，具有精确的公开方程 [ 35 , 36 , 71 ] 。

sents.zh: 四个学科扮演智能体的角色，每个学科都是一个确定性函数；不涉及任何大型语言模型。

sents.en: Structure computes weights from the lift and the engine weight.
sents.zh: 结构学科根据升力和发动机重量计算权重。

sents.en: Aerodynamics computes lift and drag from those weights and the engine scale factor.
sents.zh: 空气动力学学科根据这些权重和发动机比例因子计算升力和阻力。

sents.en: Propulsion computes engine weight, scale factor, and fuel consumption from the drag.
sents.zh: 推进系统学科根据阻力计算发动机重量、比例因子和燃料消耗量。

sents.en: Mission computes the aircraft’s range from all of them.
sents.zh: 任务规划学科根据所有上述参数计算飞机的航程。

sents.en: The first three form a cycle: three feedback values (lift, engine weight, and engine scale factor) must equal what each consumer assumed when it ran.
sents.zh: 前三个学科构成一个循环：三个反馈值（升力、发动机重量和发动机比例因子）必须等于每个学科在运行时所假设的值。

sents.en: In the paper’s terms, the coupling graph is H H , and the gluing condition ℱ \mathcal{F} is that every shared value equals the value its consumer used, so that the four disciplines describe one aircraft.
sents.zh: 用论文中的术语来说，耦合图是 H H ，而粘合条件 ℱ \mathcal{F} 是：每个共享值都必须等于其使用者所使用的值，这样四个学科才能共同描述一架飞机。

sents.en: We use GEMSEO’s public implementation of the equations; our independent reconstruction of the Propulsion and Mission submodels matches published values to within 7 × 10 − 8 7\times 10^{-8} (Appendix G.3 ).
sents.zh: 我们使用了 GEMSEO 对这些方程的公开实现；我们对推进系统和任务规划子模型的独立重建结果与已发表值的差异在 7 × 10 − 8 7\times 10^{-8} 以内（附录 G.3 ）。

paragraphs.en: Three terms recur below. An update call is one execution of one discipline. A sweep runs all four once, in order from Structure to Mission, and so costs four calls. Because the disciplines form a cycle, one sweep does not settle the values: each sweep feeds its outputs back as the next sweep’s inputs, and the values approach a consistent solution only gradually. A case is coherent when one further sweep, run as an independent audit, changes no feedback value by more than 10 − 7 10^{-7} of its scale; at that point the disciplines agree on one aircraft. We also report the error in computed range against an exact root-finder solution of the coupled equations.
paragraphs.zh: 下文中有三个术语重复出现。 一次更新调用即一个学科的一次执行。 一次扫描按顺序依次执行全部四个学科，从结构到任务，因此需要四次调用。 由于这些学科构成一个循环，一次扫描无法确定最终值：每次扫描都会将其输出作为下一次扫描的输入反馈回去，数值只会逐渐趋近于一个稳定的解。 当一个独立的审计扫描运行后，没有任何反馈值的改变超过其量级的 10^{-7} 时，该案例即为一致的；此时，各学科对同一架飞机达成了一致。 我们还报告了计算出的射程与耦合方程的精确求根解之间的误差。

sents.en: Three terms recur below.
sents.zh: 下文中有三个术语重复出现。

sents.en: An update call is one execution of one discipline.
sents.zh: 一次更新调用即一个学科的一次执行。

sents.en: A sweep runs all four once, in order from Structure to Mission, and so costs four calls.
sents.zh: 一次扫描按顺序依次执行全部四个学科，从结构到任务，因此需要四次调用。

sents.en: Because the disciplines form a cycle, one sweep does not settle the values: each sweep feeds its outputs back as the next sweep’s inputs, and the values approach a consistent solution only gradually.
sents.zh: 由于这些学科构成一个循环，一次扫描无法确定最终值：每次扫描都会将其输出作为下一次扫描的输入反馈回去，数值只会逐渐趋近于一个稳定的解。

sents.en: A case is coherent when one further sweep, run as an independent audit, changes no feedback value by more than 10 − 7 10^{-7} of its scale; at that point the disciplines agree on one aircraft.
sents.zh: 当一个独立的审计扫描运行后，没有任何反馈值的改变超过其量级的 10^{-7} 时，该案例即为一致的；此时，各学科对同一架飞机达成了一致。

sents.en: We also report the error in computed range against an exact root-finder solution of the coupled equations.
sents.zh: 我们还报告了计算出的射程与耦合方程的精确求根解之间的误差。

paragraphs.en: The 86 cases are 43 designs (the benchmark’s initial, feasible, and near-optimal designs, and 40 designs drawn between the feasible and optimal designs with small perturbations), each started from two different initial guesses for the feedback values. Four schedulers decide when to stop. One sweep and three sweeps stop after a fixed budget of 4 or 12 calls. Residual-converged Gauss–Seidel , the classical method, sweeps until the feedback values stop changing. The coherence guard , the runtime’s commit rule, commits only when every shared value agrees with what its consumer used, and otherwise sweeps again.
paragraphs.zh: 这 86 个案例包括 43 种设计（基准的初始、可行和近似最优设计，以及通过微小扰动在可行设计与最优设计之间生成的 40 种设计），每种设计都从反馈值的两个不同初始猜测开始。 四个调度器决定何时停止。 一次遍历和三次遍历在调用次数达到固定的 4 次或 12 次预算后停止。 残差收敛的 Gauss–Seidel 方法（经典方法）会持续遍历，直到反馈值不再变化。 相干性守卫（运行时的提交规则）仅在所有共享值与其消费者使用的值一致时才会提交，否则将再次进行遍历。

sents.en: The 86 cases are 43 designs (the benchmark’s initial, feasible, and near-optimal designs, and 40 designs drawn between the feasible and optimal designs with small perturbations), each started from two different initial guesses for the feedback values.
sents.zh: 这 86 个案例包括 43 种设计（基准的初始、可行和近似最优设计，以及通过微小扰动在可行设计与最优设计之间生成的 40 种设计），每种设计都从反馈值的两个不同初始猜测开始。

sents.en: Four schedulers decide when to stop.
sents.zh: 四个调度器决定何时停止。

sents.en: One sweep and three sweeps stop after a fixed budget of 4 or 12 calls.
sents.zh: 一次遍历和三次遍历在调用次数达到固定的 4 次或 12 次预算后停止。

sents.en: Residual-converged Gauss–Seidel , the classical method, sweeps until the feedback values stop changing.
sents.zh: 残差收敛的 Gauss–Seidel 方法（经典方法）会持续遍历，直到反馈值不再变化。

sents.en: The coherence guard , the runtime’s commit rule, commits only when every shared value agrees with what its consumer used, and otherwise sweeps again.
sents.zh: 相干性守卫（运行时的提交规则）仅在所有共享值与其消费者使用的值一致时才会提交，否则将再次进行遍历。

paragraphs.en: Every fixed-budget run stops at an aircraft whose disciplines disagree: Structure was sized for a lift that Aerodynamics no longer produces. After one sweep the computed range is off by about 0.5% on average; after three, by about 0.005%. Nothing inside a sweep reports that the system has not settled, and the number of sweeps needed varies from 8 to 10 across cases, so no fixed budget is safe in advance. The difference between 4 and 35.5 mean calls is the price of being right: about nine times the cost of a single sweep, spent on reaching agreement rather than wasted. The converged scheduler and the guard make exactly the same calls because, on this system, the guard’s agreement check is the same test Gauss–Seidel uses to stop. A converged residual is the gluing condition ℱ \mathcal{F} in numerical form, so the tie is exact by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 每次固定预算的运行都会在一架各学科结果不一致的飞机上停止：结构尺寸是根据空气动力学不再能产生的升力设计的。 经过一次迭代，计算出的航程平均偏差约为 0.5%；经过三次迭代后，偏差约为 0.005%。 在一次迭代中，没有任何内部报告表明系统尚未稳定，而所需的迭代次数在不同案例中从 8 到 10 不等，因此无法提前确定安全的固定预算。 4 次和 35.5 次调用之间的差异就是做出正确决策的代价：大约是一次迭代成本的九倍，这些成本用于达成共识，而非被浪费。 收敛的调度器和守卫执行完全相同的调用，因为在这个系统中，守卫的一致性检查与高斯-赛德尔方法用于停止的判断是相同的测试。 收敛的残差是数值形式下的黏合条件 ℱ \mathcal{F}，因此这种关联在构造上就是精确的。

sents.en: Every fixed-budget run stops at an aircraft whose disciplines disagree: Structure was sized for a lift that Aerodynamics no longer produces.
sents.zh: 每次固定预算的运行都会在一架各学科结果不一致的飞机上停止：结构尺寸是根据空气动力学不再能产生的升力设计的。

sents.en: After one sweep the computed range is off by about 0.5% on average; after three, by about 0.005%.
sents.zh: 经过一次迭代，计算出的航程平均偏差约为 0.5%；经过三次迭代后，偏差约为 0.005%。

sents.en: Nothing inside a sweep reports that the system has not settled, and the number of sweeps needed varies from 8 to 10 across cases, so no fixed budget is safe in advance.
sents.zh: 在一次迭代中，没有任何内部报告表明系统尚未稳定，而所需的迭代次数在不同案例中从 8 到 10 不等，因此无法提前确定安全的固定预算。

sents.en: The difference between 4 and 35.5 mean calls is the price of being right: about nine times the cost of a single sweep, spent on reaching agreement rather than wasted.
sents.zh: 4 次和 35.5 次调用之间的差异就是做出正确决策的代价：大约是一次迭代成本的九倍，这些成本用于达成共识，而非被浪费。

sents.en: The converged scheduler and the guard make exactly the same calls because, on this system, the guard’s agreement check is the same test Gauss–Seidel uses to stop.
sents.zh: 收敛的调度器和守卫执行完全相同的调用，因为在这个系统中，守卫的一致性检查与高斯-赛德尔方法用于停止的判断是相同的测试。

sents.en: A converged residual is the gluing condition ℱ \mathcal{F} in numerical form, so the tie is exact by construction.
sents.zh: 收敛的残差是数值形式下的黏合条件 ℱ \mathcal{F}，因此这种关联在构造上就是精确的。

paragraphs.en: In each of 40 cases the design is revised from the feasible design to a new one partway toward the optimum, and the revision lands mid-sweep: Structure has already run on the old design, while Aerodynamics, Propulsion, and Mission run on the new one. The result has mixed provenance . It blends two aircraft and describes neither. Four revision policies respond. Accept mixed revision keeps that result as it is (4 calls). Continue for two sweeps keeps it and iterates two more sweeps on the new design (12 calls). The provenance guard and restart , the runtime’s rule, uses the history state D D to record which design revision each output came from, discards outputs from a superseded revision, and iterates to agreement. The conventional version-aware restart , the classical rule, discards in-progress work whenever the design’s version number changes and solves again.
paragraphs.zh: 在 40 个案例中，每个案例的设计都从可行设计被修订为一种新的、部分朝向最优解的设计，且此次修订发生在扫描过程中间：结构分析已经基于旧设计运行，而空气动力学、推进和任务分析则基于新设计运行。 该结果具有混合的来源。 它融合了两种飞机，但并未对其中任何一种进行描述。 四种修订策略作出了响应。 接受混合修订会保留该结果不变（4 次调用）。 继续执行两次扫描会保留该结果，并基于新设计再迭代两次（12 次调用）。 来源守卫与重启机制——即运行时规则——使用历史状态 D D 来记录每个输出源自哪一次设计修订，丢弃来自已被取代的修订的输出，并迭代直至达成一致。 传统的版本感知重启机制——即经典规则——每当设计的版本号发生变化时，都会丢弃正在进行的计算工作，并重新开始求解。

sents.en: In each of 40 cases the design is revised from the feasible design to a new one partway toward the optimum, and the revision lands mid-sweep: Structure has already run on the old design, while Aerodynamics, Propulsion, and Mission run on the new one.
sents.zh: 在 40 个案例中，每个案例的设计都从可行设计被修订为一种新的、部分朝向最优解的设计，且此次修订发生在扫描过程中间：结构分析已经基于旧设计运行，而空气动力学、推进和任务分析则基于新设计运行。

sents.en: The result has mixed provenance .
sents.zh: 该结果具有混合的来源。

sents.en: It blends two aircraft and describes neither.
sents.zh: 它融合了两种飞机，但并未对其中任何一种进行描述。

sents.en: Four revision policies respond.
sents.zh: 四种修订策略作出了响应。

sents.en: Accept mixed revision keeps that result as it is (4 calls).
sents.zh: 接受混合修订会保留该结果不变（4 次调用）。

sents.en: Continue for two sweeps keeps it and iterates two more sweeps on the new design (12 calls).
sents.zh: 继续执行两次扫描会保留该结果，并基于新设计再迭代两次（12 次调用）。

sents.en: The provenance guard and restart , the runtime’s rule, uses the history state D D to record which design revision each output came from, discards outputs from a superseded revision, and iterates to agreement.
sents.zh: 来源守卫与重启机制——即运行时规则——使用历史状态 D D 来记录每个输出源自哪一次设计修订，丢弃来自已被取代的修订的输出，并迭代直至达成一致。

sents.en: The conventional version-aware restart , the classical rule, discards in-progress work whenever the design’s version number changes and solves again.
sents.zh: 传统的版本感知重启机制——即经典规则——每当设计的版本号发生变化时，都会丢弃正在进行的计算工作，并重新开始求解。

paragraphs.en: Accepting the mixed result fails every case, with range off by up to 0.9%. Two more sweeps wash out the old design but stop before the values settle, so they also fail every case. Both restart policies succeed in all 40 at 40 calls, 4 of them on the discarded sweep, and they make identical calls: here the version number is the provenance the runtime keeps, D D in its simplest form.
paragraphs.zh: 接受混合结果在所有测试用例中均失败，范围偏差高达 0.9%。 另外两次扫描清除了旧的设计，但在数值稳定前停止，因此它们在所有测试用例中也均失败。 两种重启策略在 40 次调用中均成功通过了全部 40 个测试用例，其中 4 个来自被丢弃的扫描，且它们的调用完全相同：此处的版本号是运行时保留的来源信息，D D 是其最简单的形式。

paragraphs.en: The study supports the theory in two ways, neither of which is a runtime advantage. The 0/86 and 0/40 rows show that the failure the theory describes occurs in classical engineering too: every discipline computes correctly and every stopping rule is reasonable, yet the committed aircraft is incoherent unless something checks the global condition. The 86/86 and 40/40 rows, at identical cost, show that the runtime adds nothing where a classical tool already owns the state. A converged residual is a specialized compatibility check, and a version counter is a specialized history state, so the general semantics reduces to them, as Prediction 4 requires. The runtime is needed where shared state has no common numerical residual or single version counter, such as agents with split views (Study IX) or a stale read under dual control (Study V). There the same semantics apply and no classical tool supplies them.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究从两个方面支持了这一理论，但这两个方面都不涉及运行时优势。 0/86 和 0/40 行表明，该理论所描述的问题也存在于经典工程中：每个学科的计算都是正确的，每个停止规则也都是合理的，但除非有机制对全局状态进行检查，否则已部署的飞行器将处于不一致状态。 在成本完全相同的情况下，86/86 和 40/40 行表明，当经典工具已经掌握状态时，运行时并不会带来任何额外价值。 收敛的残差是一种专门的兼容性检查，而版本计数器则是一种专门的历史状态，因此一般语义学可简化为这两种情况，正如预测 4 所要求的那样。 在共享状态没有共同的数值残差或单一版本计数器的情况下，就需要运行时机制，例如具有分裂视角的智能体（研究 IX）或在双重控制下出现过时读取的情况（研究 V）。 在这些情况下，相同的语义学依然适用，但没有经典工具能够提供这些机制。

paragraphs.en: Section 3.3 makes three claims about translations between agents’ formats. A translation error can be invisible to every check that looks at one agent or one edge, including canonical IDs. Checking short loops is not enough. And checking every loop, which sounds infeasible because a graph can have exponentially many, costs only β 1 = | E | − | V | + c \beta_{1}=|E|-|V|+c comparisons along a spanning forest (Theorem 3.4 , Corollary 3.5 ). This study runs those claims as code. It is deterministic and model-free, and its decision rules were frozen before any score was computed.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.3 节对智能体格式之间的转换提出了三项主张。 转换错误可能对任何仅检查单个智能体或单条边的检测手段（包括标准 ID）都不可见。 仅检查短循环是不够的。 而检查所有循环看似不可行，因为图可能包含指数级数量的循环，但沿生成森林进行判断的成本仅为 β₁ = |E| − |V| + c（定理 3.4、推论 3.5）。 本研究将这些主张以代码形式实现。 该实现是确定性的且无需依赖模型，其决策规则在计算任何分数之前就已固定。

sents.en: Section 3.3 makes three claims about translations between agents’ formats.
sents.zh: 第 3.3 节对智能体格式之间的转换提出了三项主张。

sents.en: A translation error can be invisible to every check that looks at one agent or one edge, including canonical IDs.
sents.zh: 转换错误可能对任何仅检查单个智能体或单条边的检测手段（包括标准 ID）都不可见。

sents.en: Checking short loops is not enough.
sents.zh: 仅检查短循环是不够的。

sents.en: And checking every loop, which sounds infeasible because a graph can have exponentially many, costs only β 1 = | E | − | V | + c \beta_{1}=|E|-|V|+c comparisons along a spanning forest (Theorem 3.4 , Corollary 3.5 ).
sents.zh: 而检查所有循环看似不可行，因为图可能包含指数级数量的循环，但沿生成森林进行判断的成本仅为 β₁ = |E| − |V| + c（定理 3.4、推论 3.5）。

sents.en: This study runs those claims as code.
sents.zh: 本研究将这些主张以代码形式实现。

sents.en: It is deterministic and model-free, and its decision rules were frozen before any score was computed.
sents.zh: 该实现是确定性的且无需依赖模型，其决策规则在计算任何分数之前就已固定。

paragraphs.en: Each instance is the simplest translation problem: sign synchronization . Agents sit on the nodes of a graph and each holds the same axis, but each may orient it either way. Each edge records whether two neighbors’ orientations are the “same” or “opposite”. The instance is coherent when one choice of orientations explains every edge label, which by Theorem 3.4 means every loop has an even number of “opposite” labels. We used twenty graphs: rings of 3 to 12 nodes, two complete graphs, two grids, the Petersen graph, a pair of disjoint rings, and four random graphs, with β 1 \beta_{1} (the number of independent loops) ranging from 1 to 25. Each graph carries 90 instances, 1,800 in all. On each graph, 30 are coherent and 30 carry the primary corruption, a flipped label on one edge that lies on a loop. That flip leaves every node valid and every edge self-consistent; only the loops through that edge stop closing. The other 30 carry one of three control corruptions that simpler validators can see: a malformed node, a node describing a different object, or an edge whose two directions do not undo each other.
paragraphs.zh: 每个实例都是最简单的翻译问题：符号同步。 智能体位于图的节点上，每个智能体都持有相同的轴，但每个智能体都可以将其朝向任意一侧。 每条边记录两个相邻节点的朝向是“相同”还是“相反”。 当一种朝向选择能够解释所有边的标签时，该实例就是连贯的；根据定理 3.4，这意味着每个环中“相反”标签的数量必须是偶数。 我们使用了二十个图：节点数为 3 到 12 的环、两个完全图、两个网格、彼得森图、一对不相交的环以及四个随机图，其中 β₁（独立环的数量）范围从 1 到 25。 每个图包含 90 个实例，总共 1,800 个。 在每个图中，有 30 个实例是连贯的，另外 30 个则存在主要错误：一条位于环上的边标签被翻转了。 这种翻转使每个节点仍然有效，每条边也保持自洽；只有经过该边的环无法闭合。 其余 30 个实例包含三种更简单的验证器能够识别的控制性错误：结构错误的节点、描述不同物体的节点，或两个方向无法相互抵消的边。

sents.zh: 每个实例都是最简单的翻译问题：符号同步。

sents.zh: 每条边记录两个相邻节点的朝向是“相同”还是“相反”。

sents.zh: 在每个图中，有 30 个实例是连贯的，另外 30 个则存在主要错误：一条位于环上的边标签被翻转了。

paragraphs.en: Seven validators run on every instance, ordered by how much of the loop structure they examine:
paragraphs.zh: 每个实例上都会运行七个验证器，它们的排序依据是各自对循环结构的检查程度：

paragraphs.en: Local only checks that each node’s data is well formed.
paragraphs.zh: 本地检查仅确保每个节点的数据格式正确。

paragraphs.en: Pairwise only also checks every edge: its two directions undo each other, and it carries one neighbor’s description to the other’s.
paragraphs.zh: 成对处理还会检查每一条边：其两个方向会相互抵消，并且会将一个邻居的描述传递到另一个邻居处。

paragraphs.en: Quotient-first is the canonical-ID approach: map every node’s description to a canonical form, confirm that all forms match, and discard the translations.
paragraphs.zh: 商值优先是一种规范 ID 方法：将每个节点的描述映射到规范形式，确认所有形式均匹配，然后丢弃这些转换结果。

paragraphs.en: Bounded cycles adds a check of every loop of length at most k k , for k = 3 k=3 , 4, and 6.
paragraphs.zh: 有界循环增加了对每个长度至多为 k 的环路的检查，其中 k = 3、4 和 6。

paragraphs.en: Sampled cycles checks β 1 \beta_{1} randomly chosen loops, the same budget as the forest but without its choice of loops.
paragraphs.zh: 采样周期检查 β 1 \beta_{1} 个随机选择的循环，其预算与森林相同，但不会选择其中的循环。

paragraphs.en: Spanning forest is Corollary 3.5 : fix orientations along a spanning tree, then check each of the β 1 \beta_{1} leftover edges against them.
paragraphs.zh: 生成森林是推论 3.5：沿着一棵生成树固定方向，然后检查每条剩余的 β 1 \beta_{1} 边与这些方向是否一致。

paragraphs.en: Groupoid descent is an independent implementation of the same decision by a different algorithm (union-find), included as a cross-check. It re-examines each translation in both directions, so it reports more checks.
paragraphs.zh: 群胚下降是同一决策由另一种算法（并查集）实现的独立版本，作为交叉验证被包含在内。 它会重新检查每个翻译的两个方向，因此会报告更多的检查结果。

sents.en: Groupoid descent is an independent implementation of the same decision by a different algorithm (union-find), included as a cross-check.
sents.zh: 群胚下降是同一决策由另一种算法（并查集）实现的独立版本，作为交叉验证被包含在内。

sents.en: It re-examines each translation in both directions, so it reports more checks.
sents.zh: 它会重新检查每个翻译的两个方向，因此会报告更多的检查结果。

paragraphs.en: No validator raised a false alarm on any coherent instance, so the table measures only how many real errors each catches and at what cost.
paragraphs.zh: 没有验证器在任何连贯实例上发出误报，因此该表仅衡量每个验证器能检测出多少真实错误以及其代价。

paragraphs.en: Checks that never look at a loop catch nothing. Local, pairwise, and canonical-ID validators miss every flipped edge. They are blind to this error class, not weak: each catches the control corruption it can see. Quotient-first is the important case, because canonical IDs are the common engineering shortcut. Every description maps to the same canonical form, so the check passes while the loop does not close. This is the failure Section 3.3 predicts.
paragraphs.zh: 从不观察循环的检查无法捕获任何内容。 局部、成对和标准 ID 验证器都会遗漏每一条被翻转的边。 它们对这类错误视而不见，但这并非能力不足：每种验证器都能捕获其能够检测到的控制破坏。 商优先是关键情况，因为标准 ID 是常见的工程捷径。 每个描述都映射到相同的标准形式，因此检查通过，而循环并未闭合。 这正是第 3.3 节所预测的故障。

sents.en: Checks that never look at a loop catch nothing.
sents.zh: 从不观察循环的检查无法捕获任何内容。

sents.en: Local, pairwise, and canonical-ID validators miss every flipped edge.
sents.zh: 局部、成对和标准 ID 验证器都会遗漏每一条被翻转的边。

sents.en: They are blind to this error class, not weak: each catches the control corruption it can see.
sents.zh: 它们对这类错误视而不见，但这并非能力不足：每种验证器都能捕获其能够检测到的控制破坏。
