sents.zh: 商优先是关键情况，因为标准 ID 是常见的工程捷径。

sents.en: Every description maps to the same canonical form, so the check passes while the loop does not close.
sents.zh: 每个描述都映射到相同的标准形式，因此检查通过，而循环并未闭合。

sents.en: This is the failure Section 3.3 predicts.
sents.zh: 这正是第 3.3 节所预测的故障。

paragraphs.en: Checking short loops catches only errors on short loops. A bounded-cycle check catches a flipped edge exactly when that edge lies on a loop of length at most k k , matching the frozen prediction on every instance. Raising k k from 3 to 6 multiplies the checks thirteenfold and still misses a third of the errors, including every error on rings longer than six. This is Proposition 3.2 in executable form: no fixed loop length is enough.
paragraphs.zh: 检查短循环只会发现短循环上的错误。 有界循环检查恰好会在某条边位于长度至多为 k 的循环时检测到该边的翻转，这与每个实例上的冻结预测一致。 将 k 从 3 提高到 6 会使检查次数增加十三倍，但仍会遗漏三分之一的错误，包括所有长度超过六的环上的错误。 这就是命题 3.2 的可执行形式：任何固定的循环长度都不足以解决问题。

sents.en: Checking short loops catches only errors on short loops.
sents.zh: 检查短循环只会发现短循环上的错误。

sents.en: A bounded-cycle check catches a flipped edge exactly when that edge lies on a loop of length at most k k , matching the frozen prediction on every instance.
sents.zh: 有界循环检查恰好会在某条边位于长度至多为 k 的循环时检测到该边的翻转，这与每个实例上的冻结预测一致。

sents.en: Raising k k from 3 to 6 multiplies the checks thirteenfold and still misses a third of the errors, including every error on rings longer than six.
sents.zh: 将 k 从 3 提高到 6 会使检查次数增加十三倍，但仍会遗漏三分之一的错误，包括所有长度超过六的环上的错误。

sents.en: This is Proposition 3.2 in executable form: no fixed loop length is enough.
sents.zh: 这就是命题 3.2 的可执行形式：任何固定的循环长度都不足以解决问题。

paragraphs.en: Random loops do well on average but carry no guarantee. With the same budget as the forest, random loops catch 94.5% overall but only 76.7% on the hardest graph, and nothing in the result tells the user which errors were missed.
paragraphs.zh: 随机循环在平均表现上不错，但没有任何保证。 在与森林模型相同的预算下，随机循环的整体捕获率为 94.5%，但在最难处理的图上仅为 76.7%，且结果中没有任何信息能告诉用户哪些错误被遗漏了。

sents.en: Random loops do well on average but carry no guarantee.
sents.zh: 随机循环在平均表现上不错，但没有任何保证。

sents.en: With the same budget as the forest, random loops catch 94.5% overall but only 76.7% on the hardest graph, and nothing in the result tells the user which errors were missed.
sents.zh: 在与森林模型相同的预算下，随机循环的整体捕获率为 94.5%，但在最难处理的图上仅为 76.7%，且结果中没有任何信息能告诉用户哪些错误被遗漏了。

paragraphs.en: The spanning forest catches every error at the minimum cost. It catches all 600 flipped edges and uses exactly β 1 \beta_{1} checks on every coherent instance, 4.2 on average, slightly more than the k = 4 k=4 short-loop check spends while catching 43.8%, and under a third of what k = 6 k=6 spends while catching 66.2%. The independent union-find implementation agrees with it on all 1,800 instances.
paragraphs.zh: 该生成森林以最低成本捕获了所有错误。 它捕获了全部 600 条翻转边，并且在每个连贯实例中恰好使用 β₁ 次检查，平均为 4.2 次，略高于 k = 4 的短循环检查在捕获 43.8% 错误时所需的次数，且低于 k = 6 在捕获 66.2% 错误时所需次数的三分之一。 独立的并查集实现与它在全部 1,800 个实例上的结果一致。

sents.en: The spanning forest catches every error at the minimum cost.
sents.zh: 该生成森林以最低成本捕获了所有错误。

sents.en: It catches all 600 flipped edges and uses exactly β 1 \beta_{1} checks on every coherent instance, 4.2 on average, slightly more than the k = 4 k=4 short-loop check spends while catching 43.8%, and under a third of what k = 6 k=6 spends while catching 66.2%.
sents.zh: 它捕获了全部 600 条翻转边，并且在每个连贯实例中恰好使用 β₁ 次检查，平均为 4.2 次，略高于 k = 4 的短循环检查在捕获 43.8% 错误时所需的次数，且低于 k = 6 在捕获 66.2% 错误时所需次数的三分之一。

sents.en: The independent union-find implementation agrees with it on all 1,800 instances.
sents.zh: 独立的并查集实现与它在全部 1,800 个实例上的结果一致。

paragraphs.en: The suite also confirms the counting law behind that cost: a random labeling is coherent with probability exactly 2 − β 1 2^{-\beta_{1}} on every graph small enough to enumerate. Each independent loop is therefore a separate constraint, so β 1 \beta_{1} loop checks are necessary as well as sufficient: any smaller set of loops leaves some loop unconstrained (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 该公式也证实了该成本背后的计数定律：对于每个足够小以至可以枚举的图，随机标记与一致性相符的概率恰好为 2 − β 1 2^{-\beta_{1}}。 因此，每个独立回路都是一个独立的约束，所以 β 1 \beta_{1} 个回路检查既是必要的也是充分的：任何更小的回路集合都会留下某些回路不受约束（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: The spanning forest is the only validator here that is both complete and cheap. It needs one comparison per independent loop, a number set by the graph’s shape and not by its exponentially many loops, and it misses nothing. Every other strategy either cannot see this error or catches it only sometimes, and the most common shortcut, canonical IDs, is among those that cannot see it. For a harness builder, the rule of Section 3.3 is therefore practical as well as correct: keep the translations, and check β 1 \beta_{1} edges against a spanning forest.
paragraphs.zh: 生成树森林是这里唯一既完整又经济的验证器。 它每个独立循环只需一次比较，这一数量由图的结构决定，而非其指数级数量的循环，并且它不会遗漏任何内容。 所有其他策略要么无法发现这个错误，要么只能偶尔发现它，而最常见的捷径——规范 ID——就属于那些无法发现该错误的策略之一。 因此，对于构建测试框架的人来说，第 3.3 节的规则既实用又正确：保留这些转换，并将 β₁ \beta_{1} 条边与生成树森林进行比对。

paragraphs.en: The errors are planted, and the instance is built so that local checks cannot see them, so the zeros confirm the theorem as stated rather than estimate how often such errors occur. Study VIII supplies that estimate from real data, where hidden loop conflicts appear in 23 of 45 ontology-alignment networks and a triangle check catches a median of only 80% of them per network, the same short-loop gap seen here. The suite uses one simple group and noise-free labels; non-commuting translations and noisy data are left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 这些错误被植入，且实例的构建方式使得局部检查无法发现它们，因此零值会确认定理如陈述所示成立，而非估计此类错误出现的频率。 研究 VIII 基于真实数据提供了这一估计：在 45 个本体对齐网络中，有 23 个出现了隐藏循环冲突，而三角形检查在每个网络中仅能检测出其中约 80% 的冲突，这与此处观察到的短循环问题一致。 该工具包使用了一个简单的群组和无噪声的标签；非交换的平移和含噪声的数据则留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Particular instances of this obstruction have been studied in data integration: cycles of schema mappings used to detect erroneous mappings among peers [ 1 ] , chains of owl:sameAs links that join two distinct identifiers of one dataset [ 23 ] , and alignments that are pairwise consistent but globally inconsistent across three ontologies [ 53 ] . Each addresses one setting. Here the same obstruction is one case of the general local-to-global problem of Section 3 , certified by the spanning-forest check of Section 3.3 , and measured systematically, under a preregistered design, on an established matching benchmark. On the OAEI 2025 Conference track [ 66 ] , seven matching systems each produce twenty-one pairwise equivalence alignments among seven ontologies of the public OntoFarm collection of conference-organization ontologies [ 87 ] . Treating each system’s alignments as an undirected equality network, we apply an explicit unique-name diagnostic : a chain of “same as” links is flagged when it identifies two distinct identifiers inside one ontology even though every individual alignment can look locally one-to-one. We call that flagged pattern a same-ontology identity collision , or “conflict” below for brevity. It is not, by itself, an OWL logical contradiction, because OWL does not generally impose a unique-name assumption; it is a structural warning whose relation to curated reference alignments is measured rather than assumed.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集成领域已对这种阻碍的具体实例进行了研究：用于检测同侪之间错误映射的模式映射循环 [ 1 ]、将同一数据集的两个不同标识符连接起来的 owl:sameAs 链接链 [ 23 ]，以及在三个本体中两两一致但整体不一致的映射关系 [ 53 ]。 每个实例都针对一种特定场景。 在此，同一种阻碍是第 3 节所述局部到全局一般问题的一种情况，这一点由第 3.3 节的生成树检查得以证实，并且根据预先注册的设计，在已建立的匹配基准上进行了系统性测量。 在 OAEI 2025 会议赛道中 [ 66 ]，七个匹配系统各自生成了公共 OntoFarm 会议组织本体集合中七个本体之间的二十一对等性映射关系 [ 87 ]。 我们将每个系统的映射关系视为一个无向相等性网络，并应用一种显式的唯一名称诊断方法：当“相同于”链接链在同一个本体内部识别出两个不同的标识符时，就会被标记为异常，尽管每个单独的映射关系在局部看起来都是一对一的。 我们将这种被标记的模式称为同本体身份冲突，下文为简洁起见简称为“冲突”。 这本身并非 OWL 的逻辑矛盾，因为 OWL 通常并不强制要求唯一名称假设；它是一种结构性警告，其与人工校准的参考映射之间的关系需要通过测量而非假设来确定。

paragraphs.en: Six of the seven systems’ networks contain such conflicts, and five contain conflicts that no pairwise check can see: fifty conflict pairs have shortest witness chains of length L ≥ 3 L\geq 3 and are therefore invisible to a per-alignment one-to-one check (LSMatch has no conflicts; LogMapLt’s are all L = 2 L=2 ). Correspondences on those invisible chains are absent from the public curated reference alignment (OAEI’s ra1 ) at 60 / 144 = 41.7 % 60/144=41.7\% , versus 420 / 1555 = 27.0 % 420/1555=27.0\% for the remaining correspondences (one-sided Fisher p = 2.1 × 10 − 4 p=2.1\times 10^{-4} ; optimistic, because overlapping chains make units dependent). Fifty-five non-reference correspondences are flagged only by the whole-network check. A triangle-only check catches 78 % 78\% of the invisible conflicts; the rest need chains of length 4 4 – 7 7 . Typical audited cases merge a class with its own subclass or neighbour—for example sigkdd#Author ≡ sigkdd#Author_of_paper \texttt{sigkdd\#Author}\equiv\texttt{sigkdd\#Author\_of\_paper} in five systems. The curated reference itself has fifteen conflict pairs, thirteen pairwise-invisible (e.g. ekaw#Paper ≡ ekaw#Regular_Paper \texttt{ekaw\#Paper}\equiv\texttt{ekaw\#Regular\_Paper} at L = 4 L=4 ), consistent with OAEI’s note that transitive closure of ra1 surfaced conflicts later addressed in ra2 .

paragraphs.en: To test whether 2025 is a one-campaign artifact, we froze a second design before scoring and applied it to every complete Conference participant network from 2018 to 2024. Many submissions are byte-identical resubmissions across years, so the unit is the distinct network: 72 system-years reduce to 48 distinct networks, and removing three identical to networks already scored above leaves 45 new ones. Because overlapping chains make correspondences dependent, the frozen tests are network-level rather than pooled.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验 2025 年是否属于单次活动产物，我们在评分前冻结了第二个设计，并将其应用于 2018 年至 2024 年间所有完整的会议参与者网络。 许多提交内容在不同年份中是字节完全相同的重复提交，因此这里的单位是独特的网络：72 个系统年可简化为 48 个独特网络，而移除三个与已评分网络完全相同的网络后，还剩下 45 个新的网络。 由于重叠的链式结构会使对应关系产生依赖，因此这些冻结测试是在网络层面进行的，而非合并处理。

paragraphs.en: The outcome is replicates under the frozen rule. Across all distinct networks from 2018 to 2025, 28 of 52 contain a pairwise-invisible collision under the unique-name diagnostic. The negative rank correlation makes collision density a candidate reference-free quality signal: networks with more hidden holonomy per correspondence agree less with the curated answers, without implying that every flagged collision is an error. Different systems repeat the same merges: sigkdd#Author ≡ sigkdd#Author_of_paper \texttt{sigkdd\#Author}\equiv\texttt{sigkdd\#Author\_of\_paper} and ekaw#Session ≡ ekaw#Conference_Session \texttt{ekaw\#Session}\equiv\texttt{ekaw\#Conference\_Session} each occur in ten distinct networks, and edas#ConferenceChair ≡ edas#SessionChair \texttt{edas\#ConferenceChair}\equiv\texttt{edas\#SessionChair} in eight—again mostly a class merged with a subclass or sibling. One observation was made after scoring and is not a frozen result: two unusually large outputs form giant components that contain 99% of the 31,245 invisible collision pairs, so pooled pair-level figures describe mainly those two networks. The per-network median share caught by a triangle check is 80%, close to the 2025 figure of 78%; the network-level tests above are unaffected by the outliers.

paragraphs.en: The panel covers the Conference track, and absence from the reference is an upper bound on error because the reference is incomplete. Within that scope, the evidence is consistent across eight campaigns and dozens of independently built systems: informal multi-view “sameness” routinely produces same-ontology identity collisions that pairwise checks cannot see, and the correspondences on those witness chains are absent from the curated reference more often than other correspondences. The diagnostic is therefore associated with alignment quality; it does not declare every collision a logical error.
paragraphs.zh: 该面板涵盖了会议流程，而参考数据中的缺失是误差的一个上限，因为参考数据本身并不完整。 在该范围内，证据在八项活动和数十个独立构建的系统之间保持一致：非正式的多元视角“一致性”检查通常会引发相同本体论的身份冲突，而这些冲突是成对检查无法发现的；此外，这些见证链上的对应关系在整理后的参考数据中缺失的频率高于其他对应关系。 因此，该诊断与对齐质量相关，但它并不会将每一次冲突都判定为逻辑错误。

paragraphs.en: Study VIII shows the failure in systems that match one pair of ontologies at a time. The agent test asks when a language model curating such mappings reproduces the failure, and whether a runtime check removes it. Two frozen experiments share one task set and one model; they differ in what each agent sees. We built 40 conflict tasks from real OAEI Conference components containing a pairwise-invisible conflict, plus 20 conflict-free controls (median 19 candidate correspondences per conflict task), and froze the design before any scored call. Each task shows the agent every candidate correspondence with entity names and parents, states the transitivity and unique-name rules, and asks it to select the correspondences to keep. Four arms use gpt-6-sol at medium reasoning effort with identical instructions and differ only in the runtime check applied before commit: none, pairwise one-to-one, triangle, or full-network. A fifth, non-LLM arm repairs by repeatedly cutting the weakest link on a shortest conflict chain, in the manner of de Melo’s repair [ 23 ] . All 280 episodes completed.
paragraphs.zh: 实验 VIII 表明，一次仅匹配一对本体论的系统存在失败问题。 智能体测试旨在探究：当语言模型负责整理此类映射时，是否会出现同样的失败；以及运行时检查能否消除该问题。 两个冻结实验共享同一任务集和同一模型；它们的不同之处在于每个智能体所看到的内容。 我们从包含成对不可见冲突的真实 OAEI 会议组件中构建了 40 个冲突任务，并额外准备了 20 个无冲突的对照任务（每个冲突任务平均有 19 个候选对应关系），并在任何评分调用之前冻结了设计。 每个任务都会向智能体展示所有候选对应关系及其实体名称和父类，说明传递性和唯一名称规则，并要求其选择需要保留的对应关系。 四个分支使用 gpt-6-sol 进行中等推理强度的处理，指令完全相同，唯一的区别是在提交前应用的运行时检查：无检查、成对一对一检查、三角形检查或全网络检查。 第五个非 LLM 分支则通过反复切断最短冲突链中最弱的环节来进行修复，其方式类似于 de Melo 的修复方法 [23]。 全部 280 个实验回合均已完成。

paragraphs.en: The agent resolved every conflict on its first submission. The unguarded agent left a pairwise-invisible conflict on 0 of 40 conflict tasks (95% CI 0–8.8%), and no runtime check ever rejected a submission, so all four LLM arms received the same treatment. The frozen decision rule labels the outcome harm , because the network-guarded arm scored slightly lower F1 than the unguarded arm on clean tasks ( − 0.038 -0.038 ). Since the guard never intervened, that difference is sampling variation between independent runs rather than an effect of the guard; the decision rule did not anticipate an arm with zero interventions. Two further findings are clear. The agent beats the non-LLM repair on 26 of 40 conflict tasks versus 10 (4 ties; two-sided sign test p = 0.011 p=0.011 ), mainly through precision (0.75 versus 0.64). On a metamorphic subset of ten tasks, the agent dropped a correspondence whose target was swapped for its superclass in 10 of 10 cases, but its kept set was less stable under presentation changes than under plain resampling: an identical re-prompt reproduced it in 9 of 10 tasks, renumbered candidates in 7 of 10, and JSON formatting in 6 of 10.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体在首次提交时就解决了所有冲突。 未受保护的智能体在 40 项冲突任务中于 0 项上留下了成对不可见的冲突（95% CI 0–8.8%），且没有任何运行时检查拒绝过任何提交，因此所有四个 LLM 分支都受到了相同的处理。 冻结的决策规则将结果标记为有害，因为网络受保护的分支在干净任务上的 F1 分数略低于未受保护的分支（−0.038）。 由于保护机制从未介入，这种差异是独立运行之间的采样变异，而非保护机制的影响；决策规则并未预料到存在零次介入的分支。 还有另外两个发现十分明确。 在 40 项冲突任务中，该智能体在 26 项上优于非 LLM 修复方法，而后者仅为 10 项（4 次平局；双侧符号检验 p = 0.011），这主要得益于其更高的精确度（0.75 对比 0.64）。 在一个由十项任务组成的变形子集中，该智能体在全部 10 个案例中都遗漏了一个目标被替换为其超类的对应关系，但其保留的集合在呈现方式变化下的稳定性不如单纯重新采样：相同的重新提示在 10 项任务中有 9 项重现了该结果，重新编号候选项在 10 项中有 7 项重现，而 JSON 格式调整则在 10 项中有 6 项重现。

paragraphs.en: This is the outcome the theory predicts for a full view: the agent saw every correspondence in each conflict and was told the rule, so a strong model performed the global check itself. The conflicts of Study VIII arise differently. Each matcher sees one pair of ontologies, and the outputs are combined afterward; Theorem 2.1 predicts that this split view is where a guard becomes necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 这是该理论对完整视图所预测的结果：智能体看到了每个冲突中的每一条对应关系，并且被告知了规则，因此一个强大的模型自行完成了全局检查。 研究 VIII 中的冲突以不同的方式产生。 每个匹配器只看到一对本体论，输出则在之后进行合并；定理 2.1 预测，正是在这种分割视图下，保护机制变得必要。

paragraphs.en: The second experiment, frozen separately, tests that prediction on the same 60 tasks with the same model. Each ontology pair in a task is curated by its own agent call that sees only that pair’s candidates and the unique-name rule; the pair results are merged. Three split-view arms differ only in the check applied to the merged network: none, the pairwise one-to-one check, or the full-network check, which sends each flagged witness chain back to the pair agents on it. The full-view agent above serves as the reference. A scale arm gives a single full-view agent entire system networks of 186–300 candidates, with and without the network check. All 70 new episodes completed.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个实验将冻结部分单独处理，使用相同的模型对相同的 60 项任务进行预测测试。 任务中的每个本体论对都由其专属的智能体调用进行整理，该调用仅能看到该对本的候选项和唯一名称规则；各对本的结果随后会被合并。 三种分视图分支仅在合并网络所应用的检查方式上有所不同：无检查、成对一对一检查，或完整网络检查（后者会将每个被标记的见证链重新发送回其中涉及的本对智能体）。 上述全视图智能体用作参考基准。 一个比例尺分支会向单个全视图智能体提供包含 186 至 300 个候选项的完整系统网络，并分别测试有无网络检查的情况。 全部 70 个新剧集均已完成。

sents.zh: 第二个实验将冻结部分单独处理，使用相同的模型对相同的 60 项任务进行预测测试。

sents.en: A scale arm gives a single full-view agent entire system networks of 186–300 candidates, with and without the network check.

paragraphs.en: With the same model and the same candidates, splitting the view produces hidden collisions on 9 of 40 tasks (95% CI 12–38%), against none for the full-view agent. The pairwise check never fires, because these collisions never appear inside a single pair. The network check detects and removes all nine, with no case in the other direction (McNemar one-sided p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), and never fires on the 20 clean tasks, where F1 is unchanged. This is the preregistered safety outcome; the next paragraph reports the repair-quality cost. At scale, the full-view agent left a hidden collision on 1 of 10 whole networks, and the network check removed it with no loss of F1. The outcome is support under the frozen rule.
paragraphs.zh: 在模型和候选者相同的情况下，分割视图导致 40 项任务中有 9 项出现隐藏冲突（95% CI 12–38%），而全视图智能体则未出现任何冲突。 成对检查从未触发，因为这些冲突从未出现在单个成对任务中。 网络检查检测并移除了全部九项冲突，且反向情况未发生（McNemar 单侧 p = 0.002 p=0.002），并且在 20 个无冲突的任务中从未触发，这些任务的 F1 值保持不变。 这是预先注册的安全性结果；下一段将报告修复质量相关的成本。 在大规模测试中，全视图智能体在 10 个完整网络中有 1 个留下了隐藏冲突，而网络检查成功移除了该冲突，且未造成 F1 值的损失。 这一结果是在冻结规则下的支持性证据。

sents.en: With the same model and the same candidates, splitting the view produces hidden collisions on 9 of 40 tasks (95% CI 12–38%), against none for the full-view agent.
sents.zh: 在模型和候选者相同的情况下，分割视图导致 40 项任务中有 9 项出现隐藏冲突（95% CI 12–38%），而全视图智能体则未出现任何冲突。

sents.en: The pairwise check never fires, because these collisions never appear inside a single pair.
sents.zh: 成对检查从未触发，因为这些冲突从未出现在单个成对任务中。

sents.en: The network check detects and removes all nine, with no case in the other direction (McNemar one-sided p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), and never fires on the 20 clean tasks, where F1 is unchanged.
sents.zh: 网络检查检测并移除了全部九项冲突，且反向情况未发生（McNemar 单侧 p = 0.002 p=0.002），并且在 20 个无冲突的任务中从未触发，这些任务的 F1 值保持不变。

sents.en: This is the preregistered safety outcome; the next paragraph reports the repair-quality cost.
sents.zh: 这是预先注册的安全性结果；下一段将报告修复质量相关的成本。

sents.en: At scale, the full-view agent left a hidden collision on 1 of 10 whole networks, and the network check removed it with no loss of F1.
sents.zh: 在大规模测试中，全视图智能体在 10 个完整网络中有 1 个留下了隐藏冲突，而网络检查成功移除了该冲突，且未造成 F1 值的损失。

sents.en: The outcome is support under the frozen rule.
sents.zh: 这一结果是在冻结规则下的支持性证据。

paragraphs.en: Detection and repair separate, as Proposition 3.6 anticipates. On 8 of the 9 repaired tasks, F1 against the reference fell (mean 0.774 versus 0.796), because the runtime sent each flagged chain to every pair agent on it and each dropped its own link: 47 correspondences were removed to resolve 9 conflicts, 34 of them in the reference. Every chain contained at least one reference-absent link, so a single well-chosen drop per conflict was available; this diagnosis was made after scoring. The check therefore detects exactly, and the accuracy of the repair depends on how the runtime assigns it; Section 5.12 describes the follow-up on repair routing.
paragraphs.zh: 检测与修复是分离的，正如命题 3.6 所预期的那样。 在 9 个已修复任务中的 8 个任务中，与参考值相比的 F1 分数有所下降（均值为 0.774，而参考值为 0.796），这是因为运行时将每个被标记的链发送到该链上的每一对智能体，并且每个链都删除了自己的链接：为了解决 9 个冲突，共移除了 47 个对应关系，其中 34 个存在于参考值中。 每条链都至少包含一个参考值中未出现的链接，因此每个冲突都有一个经过精心选择的删除操作可用；这一诊断是在评分之后做出的。 因此，该检查能够精确检测出问题，而修复的准确性取决于运行时如何分配修复任务；第 5.12 节将描述修复路由的后续步骤。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the two experiments locate the runtime’s role. With one model held fixed, a full view lets the agent keep the network coherent itself; split views—the way the systems of Study VIII actually work—produce hidden collisions, and a check that tracks translations across the whole network detects every one of them. Detection is exact in this panel; high-quality repair is not yet solved, as the 0.022 mean-F1 decrease under send-to-all routing shows.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这两项实验明确了运行时所处的角色。 在固定一个模型的情况下，完整的视图能让智能体自身保持网络的连贯性；而分割的视图——即研究 VIII 中的系统实际运作方式——则会产生隐藏的冲突，一个能够追踪整个网络中转换过程的检查机制可以检测出所有这些冲突。 在本面板中，检测是精确的；但高质量的修复尚未解决，正如“发送至所有”路由方式下平均 F1 值下降了 0.022 所显示的那样。

paragraphs.en: A theory of coherence earns trust by predicting when extra structure should not help, not only when it should. The theory makes seven such predictions, and every one we have tested so far has held.
paragraphs.zh: 一种连贯性理论之所以能赢得信任，是因为它不仅预测了额外结构何时会有帮助，还预测了它何时不应有帮助。 该理论做出了七项此类预测，而我们目前测试的每一项都得到了验证。

sents.zh: 该理论做出了七项此类预测，而我们目前测试的每一项都得到了验证。

paragraphs.en: No distributed state, little value from descent. If one actor has one authoritative state and every action is locally validated, explicit local-to-global machinery should add overhead with little gain.
paragraphs.zh: 没有分布式状态，下探带来的价值微乎其微。 如果一个智能体拥有一个权威状态，且每个动作都在本地得到验证，那么显式的本地到全局转换机制只会增加开销，而收益甚微。

sents.zh: 没有分布式状态，下探带来的价值微乎其微。

sents.zh: 如果一个智能体拥有一个权威状态，且每个动作都在本地得到验证，那么显式的本地到全局转换机制只会增加开销，而收益甚微。

paragraphs.en: No representation multiplicity, little value from 𝒢 \mathcal{G} . Representation-equivalence machinery should not improve tasks with one canonical encoding. Conversely, when one semantic object is distributed across reversible heterogeneous views, validators that retain explicit equivalence morphisms (cycle / descent checks) should detect global incoherence that local checks and quotient-first canonicalization miss. Studies VII and VIII support the converse on controlled graphs and on public multi-ontology alignments. Study IX confirms both sides at the agent level: with a full view the check has nothing to add, and with split views it detects every hidden collision the pairwise check leaves. Its send-to-all repair removes those collisions but lowers mean F1, separating detection from repair quality.
paragraphs.zh: 没有表示多重性，从 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 中获得的价值很小。 对于只有一个标准编码的任务，表示等价机制不应带来改进。 相反，当一个语义对象分布在可逆的异构视图之间时，保留显式等价态射（循环/下降检查）的验证器应当能够检测到局部检查和优先商化的标准方法所遗漏的全局不一致性。 研究 VII 和 VIII 在受控图以及公开的跨本体对齐中支持上述相反结论。 研究 IX 在智能体层面证实了这两种情况：在完整视图下，检查无需补充任何信息；而在分割视图下，它能检测到成对检查所遗漏的所有隐藏冲突。 其“发送至所有”的修复机制可以消除这些冲突，但会降低平均 F1 值，从而将检测与修复质量区分开来。

paragraphs.en: No revisions, little value from D D . A one-shot task with immutable inputs should not benefit materially from provenance and invalidation logic.
paragraphs.zh: 没有修订，D D 带来的价值微乎其微。 对于输入不可更改的一次性任务，来源追踪和无效化逻辑不应带来实质性的好处。

paragraphs.en: Known complete dependency closure can match the general runtime. A conventional dependency engine should equal the general semantics on tasks where H H , 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , and freshness are fully captured by that engine. Studies III and VI support this: dependency closure matches the runtime on every stale derivation, and residual-converged Gauss–Seidel and version-aware restart match it on Sobieski. Study IV’s LH2 escape panel extends the same idea to resources: fixed per-role escrow quotas match the shared ledger on safety for an additive budget. Study V’s revision panel extends it to dual-control policy: where the injected change breaks a policy precondition, current-state checks tie the runtime with zero violations.
paragraphs.zh: 已知的完整依赖闭包可以与通用运行时相匹配。 在 H H、𝒞 \mathcal{C} 和新鲜度均被该引擎完全捕捉的任务中，传统依赖引擎应与通用语义保持一致。 研究 III 和 VI 支持这一观点：依赖闭包在所有过时的推导中与运行时一致，而残差收敛的 Gauss–Seidel 方法和版本感知重启方法在 Sobieski 测试中也与之一致。 研究 IV 中的 LH2 逃生面板将这一理念扩展到资源层面：按角色固定的托管配额在安全性方面与共享账本在加性预算下一致。 研究 V 中的修订面板将其扩展至双重控制策略：当注入的变化破坏了策略的前置条件时，当前状态检查可使运行时与零违规状态保持一致。

sents.zh: 已知的完整依赖闭包可以与通用运行时相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Role decomposition without state ownership can fail. Adding planners, verifiers, or more messages should not reliably fix global invariants that no component enforces at commit time. Study I shows the observation-level form: a planner–verifier pair does not significantly beat chance on aliased tasks. Study IV shows the commit-level form: a Planner–Executor–Verifier team shown the live budget still overspends in 4 of 5 runs.
paragraphs.zh: 没有状态所有权的角色分解可能会失败。 添加规划器、验证器或更多消息，不应能可靠地修复那些在提交时没有任何组件所强制执行的全局不变量。 研究 I 展示了观察层形式：一个规划器–验证器组合在存在别名关系的任务上表现并未显著优于随机猜测。 研究 IV 展示了提交层形式：一个规划器–执行器–验证器团队在实际预算中，5 次运行中有 4 次仍然超支。

sents.en: Role decomposition without state ownership can fail.
sents.zh: 没有状态所有权的角色分解可能会失败。

sents.en: Adding planners, verifiers, or more messages should not reliably fix global invariants that no component enforces at commit time.
sents.zh: 添加规划器、验证器或更多消息，不应能可靠地修复那些在提交时没有任何组件所强制执行的全局不变量。

sents.en: Study I shows the observation-level form: a planner–verifier pair does not significantly beat chance on aliased tasks.
sents.zh: 研究 I 展示了观察层形式：一个规划器–验证器组合在存在别名关系的任务上表现并未显著优于随机猜测。

sents.en: Study IV shows the commit-level form: a Planner–Executor–Verifier team shown the live budget still overspends in 4 of 5 runs.
sents.zh: 研究 IV 展示了提交层形式：一个规划器–执行器–验证器团队在实际预算中，5 次运行中有 4 次仍然超支。

paragraphs.en: Semantic guards should remove targeted failures without requiring a stronger model. Holding model and inference budget fixed, a guard that owns the missing invariant should reduce that invariant’s failure rate specifically rather than producing a diffuse benchmark-wide improvement. Study IV supports the safety prediction: aligned budget enforcement changes 5/5 violations to 0/5, observed mean progress does not fall in the five-run comparison, and the unrelated control is unchanged. The LH2 escape panel shows that per-role escrow does the same for safety while an information-only counter does not; its progress comparison with the ledger is descriptive because the attestation gates differ. Study V shows the same specificity across failure types: read-set validation and the committed-effect monitor remove stale-read and silent-revert violations that current-state checks leave (24/25 to 0/25), with no false rejections on uninjected controls.
paragraphs.zh: 语义守卫应能移除目标故障，而无需依赖更强大的模型。 在模型和推理预算固定的情况下，若守卫本身具备缺失的不变性，则应能针对性地降低该不变性的故障率，而非仅带来整个基准测试范围内的泛化改进。 研究 IV 支持了安全性预测：对齐预算的执行将 5/5 项违规改为 0/5，观察到的平均进展在五次运行的对比中未下降，且无关的对照组保持不变。 LH2 逃生面板显示，按角色划分的托管机制对安全性产生了相同效果，而仅仅提供信息类的对照组则没有；其与账本的进展对比具有描述性意义，因为两者的认证门控存在差异。 研究 V 展示了各类故障中的一致性：读集验证和已提交效应监控器能够移除当前状态检查未能解决的陈旧读取和静默回滚违规（从 24/25 降至 0/25），且未对未注入故障的对照组造成误判。

sents.en: Semantic guards should remove targeted failures without requiring a stronger model.
sents.zh: 语义守卫应能移除目标故障，而无需依赖更强大的模型。

sents.en: Holding model and inference budget fixed, a guard that owns the missing invariant should reduce that invariant’s failure rate specifically rather than producing a diffuse benchmark-wide improvement.
sents.zh: 在模型和推理预算固定的情况下，若守卫本身具备缺失的不变性，则应能针对性地降低该不变性的故障率，而非仅带来整个基准测试范围内的泛化改进。

sents.en: Study IV supports the safety prediction: aligned budget enforcement changes 5/5 violations to 0/5, observed mean progress does not fall in the five-run comparison, and the unrelated control is unchanged.
sents.zh: 研究 IV 支持了安全性预测：对齐预算的执行将 5/5 项违规改为 0/5，观察到的平均进展在五次运行的对比中未下降，且无关的对照组保持不变。

sents.en: The LH2 escape panel shows that per-role escrow does the same for safety while an information-only counter does not; its progress comparison with the ledger is descriptive because the attestation gates differ.
sents.zh: LH2 逃生面板显示，按角色划分的托管机制对安全性产生了相同效果，而仅仅提供信息类的对照组则没有；其与账本的进展对比具有描述性意义，因为两者的认证门控存在差异。

sents.en: Study V shows the same specificity across failure types: read-set validation and the committed-effect monitor remove stale-read and silent-revert violations that current-state checks leave (24/25 to 0/25), with no false rejections on uninjected controls.
sents.zh: 研究 V 展示了各类故障中的一致性：读集验证和已提交效应监控器能够移除当前状态检查未能解决的陈旧读取和静默回滚违规（从 24/25 降至 0/25），且未对未注入故障的对照组造成误判。

paragraphs.en: Ownership miss looks like theory miss. A commit guard that enforces a nearby but non-identical state variable can leave the evaluation’s failure mode intact. That residual should be read as incomplete ownership of the graded invariant—the operational content of the aliasing theorem—not as evidence that stronger models or more roles were required. Study IV shows both sides: the first panel’s mismatched ledger does not separate, while the aligned second panel removes the targeted violation.
paragraphs.zh: 所有权缺失看起来就像理论缺失。 一个强制使用邻近但非完全相同的状态变量的提交守卫，可能使评估的故障模式保持不变。 该残余部分应被理解为对分级不变量的不完全所有权——即别名定理的操作内容——而非证明需要更强模型或更多角色的证据。 研究 IV 展示了两种情况：第一面板中不匹配的账本并未分离，而第二面板中经过对齐的账本则消除了目标违规。

paragraphs.en: Predictions 1–3 are Corollary 4.2 with the corresponding map absent: no restriction to a nontrivial cover, no translation between encodings, and no state-changing history. These predictions distinguish the theory from the weaker claim that “more structure is good.” Sometimes more structure should do nothing; sometimes it should make the system slower; and specialized conventional mechanisms should often match the general formalism on their native problems—including escrow quotas for an additive shared budget. Prediction 7 is the evaluation counterpart of Predictions 5–6: the runtime must own the same distinction the test scores.
paragraphs.zh: 预测 1–3 是推论 4.2 的体现，但缺少相应的映射：既没有对非平凡覆盖的限制，也没有编码之间的转换，更没有改变状态的历史记录。 这些预测将该理论与较弱的“更多结构更好”这一主张区分开来。有时，更多结构可能毫无作用；有时则可能导致系统运行变慢；而专门的常规机制通常应在其原生问题上与通用形式体系保持一致——包括为可加共享预算设置托管配额的情况。 预测 7 是预测 5–6 的评估对应项：运行时必须拥有与测试分数相同的区分能力。

paragraphs.en: Section 4.5 derives a team design from read sets, write sets, and constraint scopes. The direct test holds the model and the total budget fixed and compares three ways of organizing the same roles: a common-sense design (a lead agent, with pricing sequenced after engineering), the derived design (owners for cross-role constraints, parallel work under commit-time version checks, and a hub or loop check wherever H H has a cycle), and a fully sequential baseline. The prediction is that the derived design matches the sequential baseline on coherence violations, matches or beats the common-sense design on latency, and that the common-sense design fails exactly on the constraints it leaves without an owner.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.5 节根据读取集、写入集和约束范围推导出一种团队设计。 直接测试保持模型和总预算不变，并比较组织相同角色的三种方式：常识性设计（一个主智能体，其定价在工程之后依次确定）、推导式设计（为跨角色约束指定负责人，在提交时间版本检查下并行工作，以及当 H H 存在循环时设置中心或循环检查），以及完全顺序的基准方案。 预测是：推导式设计在连贯性违反方面与顺序基准方案一致，在延迟方面与常识性设计相当或更优，而常识性设计恰恰会在那些未指定负责人的约束上失败。

paragraphs.en: The work sits at the intersection of agent evaluation, distributed/transactional state, constraint reasoning, compositional semantics, and local-to-global mathematics.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作处于智能体评估、分布式/事务性状态、约束推理、组合语义学以及局部到全局数学的交叉领域。

paragraphs.en: ReAct and Toolformer establish the modern pattern of interleaving language-model reasoning with external actions and tools [ 69 , 86 ] . AgentBench, WebArena, GAIA, OSWorld, and SWE-bench extend evaluation into persistent interactive environments [ 48 , 55 , 59 , 84 , 88 ] . TeamBench adds OS-enforced role separation [ 51 ] ; τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench distributes control between user and assistant [ 12 ] ; and BixBench3 evaluates long computational-science trajectories [ 25 ] . These works provide the environments in which globally distributed state becomes operationally visible. In practice, reliability on such tasks is pursued through context engineering, memory, and agent harnesses that wrap the model with tools, guards, and checks; the present paper gives these practices a specification, saying what a context must contain and what a harness must own and check.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct 和 Toolformer 确立了将语言模型推理与外部动作及工具交替使用的现代模式 [ 69 , 86 ] 。 AgentBench、WebArena、GAIA、OSWorld 和 SWE-bench 将评估扩展到了持久化的交互式环境中 [ 48 , 55 , 59 , 84 , 88 ] 。 TeamBench 增加了操作系统强制的角色分离机制 [ 51 ]；τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 在用户和助手之间分配控制权 [ 12 ]；而 BixBench3 则评估长期的计算科学轨迹 [ 25 ]。 这些工作提供了使全局分布式状态在操作层面可见的环境。 在实践中，这类任务的可靠性通过上下文工程、记忆机制以及将模型与工具、防护和检查集成的智能体框架来实现；本文则为这些实践提供了规范，明确了上下文必须包含的内容以及框架必须拥有和检查的要素。

paragraphs.en: The mathematical ingredients predate agentic AI. Acyclic database schemes characterize when local relational consistency implies global consistency [ 15 ] ; bounded-width constraint systems expose a structural tractability parameter [ 33 ] ; optimistic concurrency control supplies serializable commit semantics under validation conditions [ 52 ] ; Myhill–Nerode characterizes minimal deterministic state for future language behavior [ 46 ] ; and group synchronization relates global frames to cycle consistency [ 54 ] . Set Cover supplies the hardness source for minimum instrumentation [ 50 ] ; coding theory supplies the hardness of minimum syndrome repair [ 17 ] . Coordination-avoidance and escrow methods in databases [ 9 , 65 ] and team decision theory in control [ 45 ] address closely related design questions; Appendices F.3 and F.4 compare them with the present architecture. In data integration, cycle-based detection of erroneous mappings [ 1 ] , identity-constraint violations in linked data [ 23 ] , and inconsistency propagation in connected alignments [ 53 ] study specific instances of the representation-layer obstruction; the present paper treats them as cases of one local-to-global semantics and measures the obstruction on a public benchmark (Studies VIII and IX).
paragraphs.zh: 数学要素的出现早于智能体式人工智能。 无环数据库方案描述了局部关系一致性如何蕴含全局一致性 [ 15 ]；有界宽度约束系统揭示了一种结构可处理性参数 [ 33 ]；乐观并发控制在验证条件下提供了可串行化的提交语义 [ 52 ]；Myhill–Nerode 定理描述了未来语言行为所需的最小确定性状态 [ 46 ]；而群同步则将全局帧与循环一致性联系起来 [ 54]。 集合覆盖问题为最小仪器化提供了难度来源 [ 50]；编码理论则提供了最小综合征修复的难度来源 [ 17]。 数据库中的协调避免和托管方法 [ 9 , 65 ]，以及控制理论中的团队决策理论 [ 45 ]，都涉及密切相关的设计问题；附录 F.3 和 F.4 将其与当前架构进行了比较。 在数据集成领域，基于循环的错误映射检测 [ 1 ]、关联数据中的身份约束违反 [ 23 ]，以及连接对齐中不一致性的传播 [ 53 ]，研究了表示层障碍的具体实例；本文将这些情况视为一种局部到全局语义的实例，并在一个公开基准上测量了该障碍（研究 VIII 和 IX）。

paragraphs.en: Software and systems engineering have used these structures for collaborative development for three decades, each for one layer. Goguen gave concurrent interacting objects a sheaf semantics [ 38 ] ; institutions made heterogeneous specification languages composable [ 39 ] ; Specware composed and refined specifications by categorical colimits [ 75 ] ; and Fiadeiro developed categorical methods for architectural design and connector composition independently of that line [ 27 ] . The viewpoints framework organized multi-stakeholder development around partial perspectives [ 28 ] ; later work argued that inconsistency among those perspectives can be useful to retain rather than always eliminate [ 64 ] ; and view merging computes their integration as a colimit [ 68 ] . Bidirectional lenses keep a pair of views synchronized under updates [ 32 ] ; multi-model consistency management extends this to many models and observes that not every multi-ary relation factors into binary ones [ 80 ] , which is the pairwise-invisible obstruction that Studies VIII and IX measure. Co-design and ologs bring categorical composition to multidisciplinary engineering design and knowledge representation [ 20 , 74 ] , and cycle-consistent map networks do the same for shape collections [ 47 ] . Read against 𝔛 \mathfrak{X} , sheaf semantics, view merging, Specware colimits, and multi-model consistency sit in ℱ \mathcal{F} ; lenses and cycle-consistent correspondences sit in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} ; and refinement morphisms that change the design sit in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . The present framework places them in one semantics and adds what this line of work leaves open: whether the available views contain enough information for any valid action (Section 2 ), which minimal state must be carried forward in time (Section 4.2 ), and when a stochastic proposer may commit.
paragraphs.zh: 在过去三十年中，软件与系统工程一直利用这些结构进行协作开发，每种结构对应一个层次。 Goguen 为并发交互对象赋予了层语义 [38]；机构使异构规范语言具有可组合性 [39]；Specware 通过范畴余极限对规范进行组合与精炼 [75]；而 Fiadeiro 则独立于这一研究路线，发展出了用于架构设计和连接器组合的范畴方法 [27]。 观点框架围绕部分视角组织了多方利益相关者的开发工作 [28]；后续研究指出，这些视角之间的不一致性可能具有保留价值，而非必须始终消除 [64]；而观点合并则将其整合计算为一种余极限 [68]。 双向透镜在更新过程中保持一对视图的同步 [32]；多模型一致性管理将这一方法扩展到多个模型，并观察到并非所有多元关系都能分解为二元关系 [80]，这正是研究 VIII 和 IX 所测量的成对不可见的障碍。 协同设计与 olog 将范畴组合引入跨学科工程设计和知识表示领域 [20, 74]；而循环一致的映射网络则对形状集合实现了同样的功能 [47]。 对照 𝔛 \mathfrak{X} 来看，层语义、观点合并、Specware 余极限和多模型一致性属于 ℱ \mathcal{F}；透镜和循环一致对应关系属于 𝒢 \mathcal{G}；而改变设计的精炼态射则属于 𝒞 \mathcal{C}。 当前框架将它们置于统一的语义体系中，并补充了该研究路线尚未解决的问题：现有视图是否包含执行任何有效操作所需的全部信息（第 2 节）、哪些最小状态必须随时间延续（第 4.2 节），以及随机提议者在何种情况下可以做出承诺。

paragraphs.en: The aliasing theorem belongs to the tradition that treats what a distributed system can do as a function of what its participants know. Knowledge-based analysis shows that coordinated action requires common knowledge, which cannot be attained when communication is not guaranteed [ 42 ] ; FLP and CAP give impossibility results for consensus and replicated state [ 29 , 37 ] ; and team decision theory and decentralized POMDPs make the information structure itself the object of control. Decentralized decision and detection problems are NP-complete even in simple static forms [ 11 ] , and decentralized POMDPs are NEXP-complete in general [ 19 , 45 , 56 , 83 ] . The aliasing theorem is the single-decision, admissibility-valued core of this tradition: it asks not what is optimal or agreed but whether any policy is guaranteed valid, and that question yields the exact minimax value, the semantic-bit bound, and the instrumentation hardness proved here.
paragraphs.zh: 别名定理属于这样一种传统：它将分布式系统所能完成的任务视为其参与者所掌握知识的函数。 基于知识的分析表明，协调行动需要共同知识，而当通信无法保证时，这种共同知识便无法获得 [ 42 ]；FLP 和 CAP 理论为共识和复制状态问题得出了不可能性结论 [ 29 , 37 ]；而团队决策理论和去中心化 POMDP 则将信息结构本身作为控制对象。 即使是在简单的静态形式中，去中心化决策与检测问题也是 NP-完全的 [ 11 ]，而去中心化 POMDP 在一般情况下则是 NEXP-完全的 [ 19 , 45 , 56 , 83 ]。 别名定理是这一传统的单一决策、可接受性值的核心：它探讨的并非何为最优或何为共识，而是是否存在任何策略能被保证有效；而这一问题则得出了此处所证明的精确最小极大值、语义比特界限以及测量难度。

paragraphs.en: This paper brings these lines of work to AI agents as one theory. Acyclic schemes, group synchronization, sheaf semantics, view merging, lenses, version validation, and team decision theory each answer one of the four questions—observation, realization, transition, semantic state—for one kind of system, and none was written for agents. The paper states the four questions once, for any collaboration of AI or human participants; proves the results that connect them (observation-fiber admissibility and its minimax value, exact semantic abstraction, minimum-instrumentation hardness, and their temporal and obstruction consequences); derives the relevant classical structures under explicit assumptions on restriction, translation, and self-updating state; and measures the resulting obstructions on public agent benchmarks. Strong conventional mechanisms are special cases: a version guard, residual solver, transaction manager, or dependency engine matches the general semantics whenever it already captures the complete relevant state relation, as Studies III and VI confirm.
paragraphs.zh: 本文将这些研究路线整合为一种理论，并将其应用于智能体。 无环方案、群同步、层语义、视图合并、透镜、版本验证和团队决策理论各自针对某一类系统回答了四个问题中的某一个——观察、实现、转换和语义状态——但没有任何一项是为智能体而提出的。 本文首先对任何由人工智能或人类参与者组成的协作场景陈述了这四个问题；证明了连接这些问题的结果（观察-纤维可接受性及其最小极大值、精确语义抽象、最小工具化难度，以及它们的时间性和阻碍性后果）；在关于限制、转换和自我更新状态的明确假设下推导出相关的经典结构；并在公开的智能体基准上衡量由此产生的阻碍。 强传统机制是特例：当版本守卫、剩余求解器、事务管理器或依赖引擎已经完整捕捉了相关的状态关系时，它们就与通用语义相匹配，正如研究 III 和 VI 所证实的那样。

paragraphs.en: When every agent passes the checks available in its local scope and the team is still wrong, one possible cause is not model capability but distributed state: the information that decides correctness is spread across contexts, participants, artifacts, representations, and time, and no one holds it all. That is the global coherence problem. It is broader than any one engineering discipline, and narrower than a claim that all or even most agent failures are global.
paragraphs.zh: 当每个智能体都通过了其本地作用域内可用的检查，而团队仍然出错时，一个可能的原因并非模型能力，而是分布式状态：决定正确性的信息分散在不同的上下文、参与者、产物、表示形式和时间中，没有任何一个个体掌握全部信息。 这就是全局一致性问题。 这个问题比任何单一的工程学科更为广泛，但又比“所有甚至大多数智能体失败都是全局性的”这一论断更为狭窄。

paragraphs.en: The theory answers four questions. Observation : if the deciding distinction is not in context, no amount of reasoning can guarantee the right action, and we know exactly how well randomization can do and how many bits of new state close the gap. Realization : join-tree overlap makes pairwise checks enough; cycles remove that guarantee, and no fixed locality bound works universally across unrestricted constraint semantics; agreement across representations can nevertheless be certified in linear time. Transition : re-expressing state is safe, changing it is not, so changes must be checked at commit. Semantic state : the memory worth keeping is exactly the history that changes what can happen next. Two costs run through all four: designing the smallest sufficient context is NP-hard, and repairing an inconsistency can be much harder than detecting it. Together these answers motivate one principled synthesis: a topology of where things meet, categories for what can change, groupoids for what only looks changed, sheaves for whether one world glues, and a history state for what still matters. Under explicit assumptions, these structures realize the properties exact validation requires; familiar tools of practice are domain-specific realizations of the same requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 该理论回答了四个问题。 观察：如果决定性的区别不在上下文中，那么无论进行多少推理都无法保证采取正确的行动；我们确切知道随机化能有多有效，以及需要多少比特的新状态才能弥合这一差距。 认识：加入树的交叠使得成对检查就足够了；循环会消除这种保证，并且没有任何固定的局部性界限能在不受限制的约束语义中普遍适用；尽管如此，不同表示之间的一致性仍然可以在线性时间内得到验证。 转变：重新表达状态是安全的，而改变状态则不安全，因此所有改动都必须在提交时进行检查。 语义状态：值得保留的记忆，恰恰是那些能够改变后续可能事件的历史记录。 贯穿全部四个问题的有两个成本：设计最小且充分的上下文是 NP 难题，而修复不一致性可能比检测它要困难得多。 这些答案共同推动了一种基于原则的合成方法：一个描述事物交汇点的拓扑结构、用于定义可变元素的类别、用于表示看似发生变化的群胚、用于判断不同世界能否融合的层，以及一个记录仍具重要性的历史状态。 在明确假设下，这些结构实现了精确验证所需的特性；实践中常用的工具正是针对相同需求所构建的领域特定实现。

paragraphs.en: The evidence lands on the boundary the theory draws, on both sides. A model that solves every task when it can see the deciding event scores 12–17 of 40 across tested arms when that event is hidden, with no arm significantly above chance, and one sentence of added context stating the missing fact raises the result to 40/40 (Study I). The theorem supplies the general limit; the finite panel is consistent with it. On TeamBench, ordinary teams overspend a shared 20-call budget in 5/5 runs, showing them the live count leaves 4/5, and commit enforcement removes every violation; observed mean progress does not fall in the five-run enforced comparison. On the same task, per-role escrow also reaches zero violations while an information-only counter does not; escrow–ledger progress differences are descriptive because their attestation gates differ (Study IV). Under the stated unique-name diagnostic, matching systems that work one pair at a time produce pairwise-invisible identity collisions across eight OAEI campaigns (Study VIII). Agents given split views reproduce them, and a network-level check detects and removes every one, but the send-to-all repair lowers mean F1 from 0.796 to 0.774 (Study IX). paragraphs.en: The limits are clear. The agent studies use one model family and modest samples, and the aliasing probe is synthetic by design. The studies show that the predicted failures occur, that the tested reasoning, role, and sampling variations do not eliminate them in these panels, and that owning the missing state removes the targeted failures; they do not establish empirical equivalence among inference strategies or measure how much of broad agent-benchmark failure these mechanisms explain. The theorem, rather than the finite panel, supplies the general impossibility result. Natural prevalence and broader replication are the next empirical questions, and the theory says where to look: shared invariants across roles, split views over one object, and state that changes while agents reason about it.
paragraphs.zh: 这些限制是明确的。 相关智能体研究仅使用一个模型家族和有限的样本，且其别名探测机制在设计上即为合成构造。 这些研究表明：预测中的失败确实会发生；在测试的推理、角色和采样变体中，这些失败并未在这些面板中被消除；而掌握缺失的状态则能消除这些目标性失败。但它们并未证明不同推理策略之间的经验等价性，也未衡量这些机制能在多大程度上解释智能体在广泛基准测试中的失败。 提供一般性不可能性结论的是该定理，而非有限的面板数据。 自然普遍性和更广泛的复现性是接下来需要经验验证的问题，而理论则指明了研究方向：跨角色的共享不变量、对单一对象的分割视角，以及智能体在推理过程中状态的变化。

paragraphs.en: This matters most as agent systems move from single assistants to teams and swarms. There, views are split by design and no participant may hold the whole state, so the conditions that permit the studied failures become more common. Such systems need explicit semantics for shared state, equivalence, and commit. The lesson for the agent community runs against instinct: when a team of agents fails, the fix may be not a bigger model, a longer context, or more review, but a harness that owns the state no one holds and puts the right distinctions into each agent’s context. No model and no context, however good, removes the need for an owner of a genuinely shared invariant; and a harness helps only with the state it owns, at the scope it checks, over the history it remembers. The central claim is simple: local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state, but stochastic local intelligence can act reliably inside an explicit shared state with a governed commit. The claim is proved where it can be proved and tested where it must be tested, and it does not depend on any one domain. Multi-agent AI does not need only bigger models. It also needs context engineering with a target and a harness with a specification, and this paper supplies both.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体系统从单一助手向团队和群体演进，这一点变得尤为重要。 在这些系统中，视角被设计成相互分离的，任何参与者都无法掌握完整状态，因此导致所研究故障出现的条件变得更加普遍。 这类系统需要为共享状态、等价性和提交操作定义明确的语义。 这对智能体领域的启示与直觉相悖：当一个智能体团队失败时，解决方案可能并非更大的模型、更长的上下文或更多的审查，而是需要一个能够掌控无人持有状态并将在每个智能体的上下文中引入正确区分的约束机制。 无论模型和上下文多么优秀，都无法消除对真正共享不变量所有者的需求；而约束机制仅能对其自身掌控的状态、在检查的范围内以及在其记忆的历史中发挥作用。 核心论点很简单：局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态，但随机局部智能可以在具有明确共享状态和受控提交机制的环境中可靠运行。 该论点在可证明的领域得到了验证，在必须测试的领域也经过了检验，并且不依赖于任何单一领域。 多智能体人工智能并不仅仅需要更大的模型。 它还需要有明确目标的上下文工程以及具备规范的约束机制，而本文同时提供了这两者。

paragraphs.en: The appendices distinguish three kinds of mathematical statements.
paragraphs.zh: 附录区分了三种类型的数学陈述。

paragraphs.en: Elementary formulations and derived results for the present model. These include the admissible-action form of the Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem, its minimax (fractional-transversal) value, its randomized and adaptive-query extensions and sharp semantic-bit bounds, exact semantic abstraction, the minimum-instrumentation reduction, the fixed- k k Tseitin counterfamily as used here, the prestack form of coherence preservation with its shared-budget counterexample, the bridging results of Section 4.3 (local sufficiency, the groupoid of translations, and the coarsest self-updating exact state), and several runtime-state corollaries, including the linear obstruction (syndrome/cokernel) monitor theorem, the task-dependent state counts, and the fixed-length versus mutual-information contrast. The minimax value is linear-programming duality applied to this setting, and the adaptive version is a decision-tree argument; both are elementary once stated. The underlying indistinguishability and perceptual-aliasing ideas have classical precedents; the paper’s contribution is the particular formulation, extensions, and integration into global-coherence semantics. Proofs of the stated results are given in full.
paragraphs.zh: 当前模型的基础公式与推导结果。 这些包括观察-别名不可能性定理的可允许动作形式、其最小最大（分数横截）值、其随机化和自适应查询扩展以及精确的语义比特界限、精确的语义抽象、最小仪器化简化、此处使用的固定 k Tseitin 反族、具有共享预算反例的相干性保持预堆叠形式、第 4.3 节的桥接结果（局部充分性、平移群和最粗略的自我更新精确状态），以及若干运行时状态的推论，包括线性障碍（综合征/余核）监控定理、任务相关的状态计数，以及固定长度与互信息的对比。 最小最大值是该设定下线性规划对偶性的应用，而自适应版本则基于决策树论证；一旦明确表述，两者都较为基础。 其底层的不可区分性和感知-别名思想已有经典先例；本文的贡献在于特定的公式化、扩展以及将其整合到全局相干语义中。 所陈述结果的完整证明均已给出。

paragraphs.en: Specializations or direct consequences of classical mathematics. Cycle synchronization, Myhill–Nerode minimization, acyclic relational gluing, possibilistic contextuality, treewidth-based CSP algorithms and their lower bounds, bounded-width theory, graph and cellular-sheaf cohomology, Max-Cut hardness of signed-graph balancing, Helly-type local-to-global bounds, invariant confluence [ 9 ] , and optimistic concurrency are established theories. We state the exact form used by the paper and prove the specialized corollaries needed for the AI semantics, while citing the underlying results.

paragraphs.en: Throughout, a guarantee is worst-case unless a distribution is explicitly stated. A stochastic policy may use arbitrary internal computation and randomness. The impossibility statements concern missing information, not bounded model intelligence: if two worlds induce the same complete information available to the policy, unlimited internal reasoning cannot distinguish them.
paragraphs.zh: 除非明确说明某种分布，否则整个过程中所给出的保证均为最坏情况下的保证。 随机策略可以使用任意的内部计算和随机性。 这些不可能性陈述涉及信息的缺失，而非模型智能的有限性：如果两个世界为策略提供的完整信息相同，那么无论内部推理能力多么强大，都无法区分它们。

sents.en: The impossibility statements concern missing information, not bounded model intelligence: if two worlds induce the same complete information available to the policy, unlimited internal reasoning cannot distinguish them.
sents.zh: 这些不可能性陈述涉及信息的缺失，而非模型智能的有限性：如果两个世界为策略提供的完整信息相同，那么无论内部推理能力多么强大，都无法区分它们。

paragraphs.en: This subsection proves the results of Section 2.2 and states in full the refinements summarized there: how often a randomized policy can be right, how many extra bits close the gap, when tool queries suffice, and what changes for near-optimal behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 本小节证明了第 2.2 节的结果，并完整阐述了其中总结的改进之处：随机策略能够正确的频率、需要多少额外比特才能弥合差距、何时工具查询已足够，以及接近最优的行为会发生哪些变化。

paragraphs.en: The result is stronger than the statement that two aliased states have different truth labels. Different labels alone do not force different behavior. The obstruction is behavioral: the fiber must lack a common admissible action. This distinction prevents a false impossibility claim when a conservative action is valid in every aliased world.
paragraphs.zh: 这一结论比“两个具有别名状态的系统拥有不同的真值标签”这一论断更为有力。 仅凭标签不同，并不必然导致行为不同。 阻碍因素在于行为层面：该纤维必须不存在共同的可行动作。 当保守动作在每个别名世界中都有效时，这种区别可以避免错误地得出不可能性结论。

paragraphs.en: A randomized multi-agent protocol with no new external observations can be regarded as a deterministic function of the initial joint observation plus an internal random seed. Conditional on any seed, aliased states still induce the same transcript. After averaging over seeds they therefore induce the same transcript and output distributions. Randomness changes which common distribution is used; it does not refine the observational partition.
paragraphs.zh: 一种没有新外部观察的随机多智能体协议，可被视为初始联合观察与内部随机种子共同决定的确定性函数。 在任何给定种子的条件下，具有别名状态的系统仍会产生相同的转录序列。 因此，在对所有种子取平均后，它们会产生相同的转录序列和输出分布。 随机性会改变所采用的公共分布，但不会改变观察划分。

paragraphs.en: Three consequences follow. First, v ⁡ ( F ) = 1 v(F)=1 exactly when the fiber has a common admissible action, so Theorem 2.1 is the case τ ∗ = 1 \tau^{*}=1 . Second, nonempty pairwise-disjoint admissible sets give τ ∗ ​ ( F ) = | F | \tau^{*}(F)=|F| , so the bound of Theorem 2.3 is attained by choosing uniformly among one admissible action per state. Third, randomization can help substantially when admissible sets overlap without a common element. paragraphs.en: The requirement is targeted: the shared runtime must expose enough semantic distinctions to separate cases that demand different behavior, rather than the whole world. If four otherwise identical program states differ only in which of four mutually exclusive approvals is authoritative, at least two bits of authoritative state are needed to distinguish all four exactly, and with only one bit the worst case is a coin flip. Inference compute and semantic state are different resources, and one cannot pay for the other.
paragraphs.zh: 该要求具有针对性：共享运行时必须提供足够的语义区分，以分离需要不同行为的用例，而非涵盖所有情况。 如果四个原本相同的程序状态仅因四个互斥批准中哪一个具有权威性而不同，那么至少需要两位权威状态比特才能精确区分这四种情况；若仅用一位比特，最坏情况就如同抛硬币。 推理计算和语义状态是两种不同的资源，一种无法为另一种付费。

paragraphs.en: For the unbounded case, let 𝒫 \mathcal{P} be the common refinement of the partitions induced by Ω \Omega and by every q ∈ Q q\in Q . If every block of 𝒫 \mathcal{P} has a common admissible action, the protocol that issues every query and then plays such an action is admissible. Conversely, two states in the same block give the same base observation and the same answer to every query, so any protocol follows the same path on both and plays the same action at the same leaf. That action must therefore be admissible on the whole block. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 对于无界情形，令 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 为 Ω \Omega 和每个 q ∈ Q q\in Q 所诱导的划分之公共加细。 如果 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 的每个块都存在一个共同的容许动作，那么该协议（即发出所有查询，然后执行这样一个动作）是容许的。 反之，同一块中的两个状态会给出相同的基观察结果以及对每个查询的相同回答，因此任何协议在这两个状态上都会遵循相同的路径，并在相同的叶节点处执行相同的动作。 因此，该动作在整个块上必须是容许的。∎

paragraphs.en: An observation-only deterministic policy can guarantee global regret at most ε \varepsilon if and only if every observation fiber has a common ε \varepsilon -optimal action:
paragraphs.zh: 仅基于观测的确定性策略能够保证全局遗憾最多为 ε \varepsilon，当且仅当每个观测纤维都存在一个共同的 ε \varepsilon -最优动作：

paragraphs.en: Hence if one aliased fiber has no action that is ε \varepsilon -optimal in every compatible global state, no amount of observation-preserving reasoning can guarantee ε \varepsilon -optimal global behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，如果某个别名纤维在每一个兼容的全局状态中都没有 ε \varepsilon -最优的动作，那么无论进行多少种保留观察的推理，都无法保证全局行为是 ε \varepsilon -最优的。

paragraphs.en: A policy has worst-case regret at most ε \varepsilon precisely when its selected action belongs to C ε ​ ( x ) C_{\varepsilon}(x) for every possible state x x . The statement is therefore exactly Theorem 2.1 applied to the admissibility correspondence C ε C_{\varepsilon} . (For ε = 0 \varepsilon=0 the set C 0 ​ ( x ) C_{0}(x) may be empty when the infimum is not attained; the theorem then correctly reports that no guarantee exists.) If every observation fiber has a common ε \varepsilon -optimal action, choose one such action for each fiber and obtain the guarantee. paragraphs.en: For intuition, imagine two operating conditions that look identical to a team: in one, plan A A is near-optimal and plan B B costly; in the other, the ranking reverses. If no single plan lies within tolerance in both worlds, the team cannot guarantee even an approximately optimal choice until the missing distinction becomes observable. This extension is intentionally conditional rather than a blanket claim that local reasoning cannot attain global optimality. If aliased states happen to share one ε \varepsilon -optimal action, then the information deficit does not prevent an ε \varepsilon -optimal guarantee. The obstruction arises only when the hidden distinction changes what counts as sufficiently good global behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 为了直观理解，可以设想两种对团队而言看似完全相同的运行条件：在第一种条件下，计划 A 接近最优，而计划 B 成本高昂；在另一种条件下，两者的排名则恰好相反。 如果不存在一个在两种情况下都符合容差范围的单一计划，那么在该缺失的区分变得可观察之前，团队甚至无法保证做出一个近似最优的选择。 这种扩展是有意设定为条件性的，而非笼统地断言局部推理无法达到全局最优。 如果具有别名状态的两个情况恰好共享同一个 ε-最优动作，那么信息缺失并不会妨碍实现 ε-最优的保证。 阻碍仅当隐藏的区分改变了何种全局行为被视为足够良好时才会出现。

Consequently the greedy Set Cover algorithm, which repeatedly selects the observable separating the most still-unseparated conflicting pairs, achieves an H ⁡ ( | P | ) ≤ ln ⁡ | P | + 1 H(|P|)\leq\ln|P|+1 approximation when the finite conflict universe is explicit. The bound cannot be improved much. In the reduction above the conflicting pairs are exactly { x 0 , x u } \{x_{0},x_{u}\} for u ∈ U u\in U , so | P | = | U | |P|=|U| and instrumentation size equals cover size. Any ( 1 − ϵ ) ​ ln ⁡ | P | (1-\epsilon)\ln|P| approximation for Exact-Instrumentation would therefore give a ( 1 − ϵ ) ​ ln ⁡ | U | (1-\epsilon)\ln|U| approximation for Set Cover, which is impossible in polynomial time unless P = NP \mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP} [ 24 ] . The problem generalizes the Minimum Test Collection problem of Garey and Johnson [ 34 ] , which is the special case in which all admissibility profiles are distinct and observables are binary. It is also closely related to finding a minimum decision-relative reduct in rough-set theory, where the conflicting pairs P P form the discernibility matrix and the decision attribute plays the role of the admissibility profile [ 72 ] . The hardness itself is therefore expected. What the admissibility form adds is its meaning: the attributes that must be kept are exactly those that separate worlds where different actions are valid.

paragraphs.en: Let local relation R A ​ B R_{AB} contain assignments satisfying A = B A=B , R B ​ C R_{BC} assignments satisfying B = C B=C , and R A ​ C R_{AC} assignments satisfying A ≠ C A\neq C , with Boolean variables. But a global assignment would imply A = B = C A=B=C from the first two relations and A ≠ C A\neq C from the third, contradiction. Hence pairwise matching does not imply a global realization on this cyclic scope pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 令局部关系 R_{AB} 包含满足 A = B 的赋值，R_{BC} 包含满足 B = C 的赋值，而 R_{AC} 包含满足 A ≠ C 的赋值，其中变量为布尔变量。 每个关系在其共享变量上都投影到 {0,1}，因此两两投影是一致的。 但一个全局赋值将意味着：从前两个关系中得出 A = B = C，而从第三个关系中得出 A ≠ C，这构成矛盾。 因此，在这种循环作用域模式下，两两匹配并不保证存在全局实现。

With no overlaps, every tuple in ∏ i X ⁡ ( U i ) \prod_{i}X(U_{i}) is a matching family, and ρ : X ⁡ ( U ) → ∏ i X ⁡ ( U i ) \rho:X(U)\to\prod_{i}X(U_{i}) is the inclusion. It is injective, and for m ≥ 2 m\geq 2 and B ≥ 1 B\geq 1 it is not surjective: the tuple ( B , B , 0 , … , 0 ) (B,B,0,\ldots,0) has no preimage. Now add a ledger scope U 0 U_{0} whose local state is the spend vector, with local constraint ∑ i s i ≤ B \sum_{i}s_{i}\leq B , overlapping each U i U_{i} in the i i -th spend. A matching family must now agree with a ledger state that satisfies the constraint, so every matching family has exactly one global preimage and ρ \rho becomes bijective. This is the formal content of adding an authoritative ledger.

paragraphs.en: The BFMY theorem cited in the main text is classical: acyclicity of the relation-scope hypergraph is equivalent to several desirable local-to-global properties, including forms in which pairwise consistency suffices for global consistency [ 14 , 15 ] . We use it as a structural boundary, not as an original theorem. Combined with the cyclic example, it says that topology can determine whether local consistency is already globally decisive.
paragraphs.zh: 正文中引用的 BFMY 定理属于经典理论：关系范围超图的无环性与若干理想的局部到全局性质等价，其中包括成对一致性足以保证全局一致性的形式 [ 14 , 15 ]。 我们将其用作结构边界，而非作为原始定理。 结合循环示例来看，该定理表明拓扑结构可以决定局部一致性是否已具备全局决定性。

paragraphs.en: This is a statement about bounded-order joint satisfiability, not about every possible notion of local consistency. Some structured classes admit bounded witness theorems, as Helly’s theorem and acyclic relational schemes demonstrate. The conclusion is only that no fixed universal locality order works across unrestricted constraint semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个关于有界阶联合可满足性的陈述，而非关于所有可能的局部一致性概念。 某些结构化类允许存在有界见证定理，正如赫利定理和无环关系模式所证明的那样。 结论仅仅是：没有任何固定的通用局部性阶数能在不受限制的约束语义中普遍适用。

paragraphs.en: On an n n -cycle the Tseitin contradiction can require all n n vertex equations before inconsistency appears, yet the graph has constant treewidth and total charge parity can be checked in O ⁡ ( n ) O(n) time. Thus “requires a global witness” does not imply “computationally hard.” This distinction is essential when interpreting agent failures.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个 n 圈图中，Tseitin 矛盾可能需要用到全部 n 个顶点的方程才会出现不一致，但该图的树宽是常数，且总电荷奇偶性可以在 O(n) 时间内检查。 因此，“需要全局见证”并不意味着“计算困难”。在解释智能体失败时，这种区别至关重要。

paragraphs.en: It also separates subfamily checking from propagation. On the cycle, variables are edges and each vertex constraint is binary, so the primal graph is itself an n n -cycle of treewidth two. Instances whose structure has treewidth less than k k are decided by k k -consistency [ 22 ] , so 3-consistency, which derives new binary constraints along paths, detects the contradiction although no small subfamily does. Tseitin systems on bounded-degree expanders defeat propagation as well: they require resolution width Ω ⁡ ( n ) \Omega(n) [ 16 ] , and resolution width corresponds to the level of consistency needed [ 5 ] , so k k -consistency fails for every k = o ⁡ ( n ) k=o(n) .
paragraphs.zh: 它还将子族检查与传播分离开来。 在环中，变量是边，每个顶点约束都是二元的，因此原始图本身是一个树宽为 2 的 n n 环。 结构树宽小于 k k 的实例可通过 k k -一致性判定 [ 22 ]，因此 3-一致性（它沿路径推导出新的二元约束）能够检测到矛盾，尽管没有任何小的子族能做到这一点。 在受限度扩展器上的 Tseitin 系统同样会阻碍传播：它们需要 Ω ⁡ ( n ) \Omega(n) 的分辨率宽度 [ 16 ]，而分辨率宽度对应于所需的一致性级别 [ 5 ]，因此对于每个 k = o ⁡ ( n ) k=o(n)，k k -一致性都会失败。

paragraphs.en: For a fixed finite constraint language the question “what structure determines the order of globality?” has a precise answer. By the bounded-width theorem of Barto and Kozik, some fixed level of local consistency decides every instance exactly when, for a core language, its algebra of polymorphisms omits tame-congruence types 1 and 2 [ 13 ] . Type 1 is an additional obstruction in the general case. Within the Taylor/tractable regime, which already omits type 1, affine equations over nontrivial finite Abelian groups (type 2) are the remaining canonical obstruction; parity is its simplest representative here.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个固定的有限约束语言，问题“何种结构决定了全局性的顺序？”有一个明确的答案。 根据 Barto 和 Kozik 的有界宽度定理，对于某个固定的局部一致性级别，当且仅当核心语言的代数多态性不包含驯从同余类型 1 和 2 时，该级别能够精确判定每个实例 [13]。 在一般情形下，类型 1 是一个额外的阻碍因素。 在 Taylor/可处理机制中（该机制已排除了类型 1），非平凡有限阿贝尔群上的仿射方程（类型 2）是剩余的典型阻碍；其中，奇偶性是最简单的代表形式。

paragraphs.en: When constraints are inserted over time without deletions, weighted union–find (disjoint-set union with group potentials) can maintain component membership and relative frame potentials. Each inserted edge either joins two components or closes a cycle; in the latter case its implied transform is compared with the stored relative potential. Under standard union-by-rank/path-compression assumptions, the data-structure part costs O ⁡ ( α ⁡ ( | V | ) ) O(\alpha(|V|)) amortized per insertion, multiplied by the cost of the necessary group operations. This is a standard dynamic-connectivity specialization; deletions require different machinery and are not covered by the bound.
paragraphs.zh: 当约束随时间不断添加且从未删除时，加权并查集（带组势的连通分量并查集）可以维护分量的成员关系和相对框架势。 每条新添加的边要么连接两个分量，要么闭合一个环；在后一种情况下，其隐含的变换会与存储的相对势进行比较。 在标准的按秩合并/路径压缩假设下，数据结构部分的摊销成本为每次插入 O⁡(α⁡(|V|)) O(\alpha(|V|))，再乘以必要组操作的开销。 这是一种标准的动态连通性特化方法；删除操作需要不同的机制，且不在该复杂度界限的覆盖范围内。

paragraphs.en: For acyclic relational joins, join-tree/semijoin algorithms give an even sharper data-complexity statement. Yannakakis-style evaluation of full acyclic joins can be performed in time linear in input plus output size under standard relational cost assumptions [ 85 ] . These classical results justify the paper’s claim that global coherence is not synonymous with global recomputation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于无环关系连接，连接树/半连接算法能够给出更精确的数据复杂度描述。 在标准的关系成本假设下，Yannakakis 风格的完整无环连接评估可以在与输入和输出规模均呈线性的时间内完成 [85]。 这些经典结果证明了本文提出的观点：全局一致性并不等同于全局重新计算。

Thus some state algebras have a bounded local-to-global witness order even though Proposition C.1 rules out a universal order across unrestricted constraints.

paragraphs.en: This is the general syndrome-decoding form. Classical coding-theory results show minimum-weight decoding to be NP-hard/NP-complete in standard formulations [ 17 ] . Thus a class can admit cheap exact detection while optimal repair is computationally hard. The agent-runtime implication is prevention-oriented: validating an obstruction before commit can be much easier than finding the smallest post-hoc set of local artifacts or assertions to change. The reduction is valid for arbitrary codes because every full-row-rank parity-check matrix H H arises as N T N^{T} for some A A : take the columns of A A to be a basis of ker ⁡ H \ker H .
paragraphs.zh: 这是通用的综合征解码形式。 经典编码理论的研究结果表明，在标准表述中，最小权重解码是 NP 难的/NP 完全的 [17]。 因此，一个类别可能允许低成本精确检测，但最优修复在计算上却具有难度。 对智能体运行时间的影响是预防导向的：在执行前验证障碍物的存在，可能比事后找出需要修改的最小的局部产物或断言集合要容易得多。 这种归约对任意码都有效，因为每个全行秩的奇偶校验矩阵 H 都可以表示为某个矩阵 A 的转置 N^T：只需将 A 的列向量作为 ker H 的一组基即可。

An edge then agrees with h h exactly when h i ≠ h j h_{i}\neq h_{j} , that is, when the bipartition defined by h h cuts it. paragraphs.en: The classical Myhill–Nerode theorem states that a language is regular iff this relation has finitely many classes, and in that case the minimal deterministic automaton has exactly one state per class [ 46 ] . paragraphs.en: The completeness of the semantic read set is essential. If a write depends on an undeclared object, that object can change without invalidating the transaction, defeating the argument. Likewise, phantom/range dependencies require a representation capable of versioning the relevant predicate or range; the proposition is not a substitute for the richer machinery of database concurrency control [ 52 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 语义读取集的完整性至关重要。 如果某个写操作依赖于一个未声明的对象，那么该对象可以发生变化而不会使事务失效，从而推翻这一论点。 同样地，幻影/范围依赖需要一个能够版本化相关谓词或范围的表示机制；这一命题无法替代数据库并发控制中更复杂的机制 [ 52 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Two artifacts can contain identical values while one was derived from current dependency versions and the other from superseded versions. paragraphs.en: The two conditions are the two sheaf axioms, weakened in one useful way. Separatedness is needed only up to admissibility: the runtime needs a sheaf of the admissibility quotient, not of the whole world. Gluing is needed only for families that some participant can actually commit. The topology H H declares which scopes exist, and Section 3 exhibited both failures: aliasing when the cover is too coarse, and the shared budget of Section 3.2 when no scope contains a global constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个条件就是两个层公理，以一种有用的方式进行了弱化。 分离性仅在容许性范围内需要：运行时需要一个容许性商的层，而非整个世界的层。 粘合仅对那些某个参与者确实可以承诺的族是必要的。 拓扑 H H 声明了哪些作用域存在，而第 3 节展示了两种失败情况：当覆盖过于粗略时发生的别名问题，以及当没有作用域包含全局约束时出现的第 3.2 节中的共享预算问题。

sents.en: Gluing is needed only for families that some participant can actually commit.
sents.zh: 粘合仅对那些某个参与者确实可以承诺的族是必要的。

sents.en: The topology H H declares which scopes exist, and Section 3 exhibited both failures: aliasing when the cover is too coarse, and the shared budget of Section 3.2 when no scope contains a global constraint.
sents.zh: 拓扑 H H 声明了哪些作用域存在，而第 3 节展示了两种失败情况：当覆盖过于粗略时发生的别名问题，以及当没有作用域包含全局约束时出现的第 3.2 节中的共享预算问题。

paragraphs.en: Part (i) is the aliasing theorem at the translation map: a lossy translation merges states. Parts (ii) and (iii) say that the translations of an exact state are exactly a groupoid with trivial holonomy. When encodings are fixed only up to a symmetry of the object—a coordinate frame, a labeling, a unit choice—translations are determined only up to that symmetry, the groupoid acquires nontrivial automorphism groups, and quotienting by the symmetry before checking cycles discards the holonomy that detects the error (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第 (i) 部分是翻译映射处的混叠定理：有损翻译会合并状态。 第 (ii) 和第 (iii) 部分指出，精确状态的翻译恰好构成一个具有平凡全曲率的群胚。 当编码仅在对对象的一种对称性（如坐标框架、标签或单位选择）下保持唯一时，翻译也仅在该对称性的意义下确定；此时群胚会获得非平凡的自同构群，而在检验循环前对对称性进行商运算，则会丢弃用于检测错误的全曲率（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Section 3.1 introduced the sheaf idea in plain terms: ask whether local states that agree on every overlap come from one global state. The refined state model keeps the same logic but allows equivalent representations to be tracked explicitly through a groupoid-valued assignment
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.1 节以通俗易懂的方式介绍了层（sheaf）的概念：需要判断在每一个重叠区域上都一致的地方状态，是否源自于一个全局状态。 改进后的状态模型保留了相同的逻辑，但允许通过群胚值赋值显式地追踪等效表示。

sents.zh: 改进后的状态模型保留了相同的逻辑，但允许通过群胚值赋值显式地追踪等效表示。

paragraphs.en: Here 𝖴 \mathsf{U} is the collection of local scopes, J J specifies which families of scopes count as covers of a larger scope, ( − ) o ​ p (-)^{op} reverses restriction arrows in the usual presheaf convention, and 𝐆𝐩𝐝 \mathbf{Gpd} is the category of groupoids—categories whose every morphism is invertible. Since a groupoid is a category in which every morphism is invertible, 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is not a second kind of mathematics beside 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . It is the reversible core of representation change, kept as a separate slot so the runtime can tell a genuine change of state (revising a design from 1 ​ m 1\,\mathrm{m} to 1.2 ​ m 1.2\,\mathrm{m} ) from a re-encoding ( 1 ​ m 1\,\mathrm{m} as 100 ​ cm 100\,\mathrm{cm} ). Descent is the existence-and-coherence condition for gluing those local objects and equivalences into a global object. Noninvertible transformations live in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} ; formally they are morphisms of a category-valued prestack whose groupoid core is 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , and Proposition F.4 shows that, unlike re-representations, they must be checked for realization at commit. Temporal state records only distinctions from the past that can affect current or future admissibility. Neither 𝒮 \mathcal{S} nor descent performs optimization by itself; an optimizer, solver, diffusion process, or agent may search over states, while the sheaf/descent structure defines which candidate states count as globally coherent.
paragraphs.zh: 此处 𝖴 \mathsf{U} 是局部作用域的集合，J J 指定哪些作用域族可视为更大作用域的覆盖，( − ) o ​ p (-)^{op} 按照常规预层约定反转限制箭头，而 𝐆𝐩𝐝 \mathbf{Gpd} 是群胚范畴——即每个态射均可逆的范畴。 由于群胚是一种每个态射均可逆的范畴，因此 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 并非与 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 并列的第二种数学体系。 它是表示变换的可逆核心，被保留为一个独立槽位，以便运行时能将真正的状态变化（将设计从 1 ​ m 1\,\mathrm{m} 修订为 1.2 ​ m 1.2\,\mathrm{m}）与重新编码（将 1 ​ m 1\,\mathrm{m} 表示为 100 ​ cm 100\,\mathrm{cm}）区分开来。 下降是那些局部对象和等价关系粘合为一个全局对象的存在性与相干性条件。 不可逆的变换存在于 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 中；形式上，它们是某个以范畴为值的预栈的态射，其群胚核心为 𝒮 \mathcal{S}，而命题 F.4 表明，与重新表示不同，这些变换必须在提交时进行实现性检查。 时间状态仅记录那些可能影响当前或未来可接受性的与过去不同的变化。 𝒮 \mathcal{S} 和下降本身都不执行优化；优化器、求解器、扩散过程或智能体可以在状态空间中搜索，而层/下降结构则定义了哪些候选状态被视为全局相干的。

paragraphs.en: The bridge of Section 4.3 —a necessity for sufficient information, followed by structures chosen to preserve it as it is distributed—recurs in established fields.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.3 节的桥梁——即对充足信息的必要性要求，以及随后为在信息分布过程中保持其完整性而选择的结构——在已有领域中也反复出现。

paragraphs.en: Whether decentralized decision makers can act well depends on the information structure rather than on individual rationality [ 56 ] . Witsenhausen’s counterexample shows that even simple dynamics become intractable under a nonclassical information structure [ 83 ] . The partially nested condition of Ho and Chu—if one agent’s action affects what another observes, the second must know what the first knew—restores tractability [ 45 ] . The shared-budget ledger is an instance of that condition: every role’s spend affects every other role’s admissible actions, so every role must see the aggregate.
paragraphs.zh: 去中心化的决策者能否做出良好决策，取决于信息结构而非个体理性 [ 56 ] 。 Witsenhausen 的反例表明，即使在非经典的信息结构下，简单的动态系统也会变得难以处理 [ 83 ] 。 Ho 和 Chu 提出的部分嵌套条件——如果一个智能体的行动会影响另一个智能体的观察内容，那么后者必须知道前者所了解的信息——能够恢复系统的可处理性 [ 45 ] 。 共享预算账本就是该条件的一个实例：每个角色的支出都会影响其他所有角色允许采取的行动，因此每个角色都必须看到汇总后的信息。

paragraphs.en: An object without a global chart is described by local charts on a cover, transition maps between overlapping charts, the cocycle condition on triple overlaps, and gluing [ 79 ] . These correspond to H H , 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , cycle consistency, and ℱ \mathcal{F} . The impossibility theorem supplies the premise that no participant holds a global chart, and Proposition F.2 is the statement that transition maps of an exact state satisfy the cocycle condition.
paragraphs.zh: 一个没有全局图表的对象，由覆盖上的局部图表、重叠图表之间的转换映射、三重重叠处的上循环条件以及粘合来描述 [ 79 ] 。 这些分别对应于 H H 、𝒢 \mathcal{G} 、循环一致性和 ℱ \mathcal{F} 。 不可能性定理提供了前提，即没有任何参与者拥有全局图表；而命题 F.2 则指出，一个精确状态的转换映射满足上循环条件。

paragraphs.en: The admissibility quotient ∼ C \sim_{C} is a minimal sufficient statistic for the decision problem in the sense of statistical decision theory [ 8 ] . A recursively updatable sufficient statistic, such as the belief state of a filter, is the self-updating state of Theorem F.3 , and Kalman’s minimal realization theory is its linear-systems form [ 44 , 49 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 可接受性商数 ∼ C \sim_{C} 是决策问题在统计决策理论意义下的一个最小充分统计量 [ 8 ] 。 一种可递归更新的充分统计量，例如滤波器的信念状态，就是定理 F.3 中的自更新状态，而卡尔曼的最小实现理论则是其线性系统形式 [ 44 , 49 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In the categorical theory of patches, repository states are objects, patches are morphisms, and a merge is a pushout; a merge conflict is a failure of the pushout to exist in the category of files [ 61 ] . This is the gluing failure of Section 3.1 in a setting familiar to every software engineer.
paragraphs.zh: 在补丁的范畴理论中，仓库状态是对象，补丁是态射，而合并则是一个推出；合并冲突是指推出在文件范畴中不存在 [ 61 ]。 这是第 3.1 节中粘合失败现象在一个所有软件工程师都熟悉的场景中的体现。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 2.1 establishes that the missing distinction must come from somewhere and leaves open where. This appendix lists the alternatives, states what each gives up, and says when the theory predicts each one suffices. The comparison locates the proposed runtime within a design space, in the way that the CAP theorem locates distributed databases [ 37 ] .

paragraphs.en: If some action is admissible in every state of an aliased fiber—stop, escalate to a human, do nothing—the fiber intersection is nonempty and Theorem 2.1 no longer bites. The price is progress. Proposition 2.4 makes this precise: a validator that always falls back to the common action is sound, but its progress is limited to that action. Many deployed agents take this route implicitly by asking for confirmation. It is appropriate when stalling is cheap; it is not when the task requires completion under a budget.
paragraphs.zh: 如果某个动作在关联纤维的每个状态中都是可接受的——无论是停止、升级至人类介入，还是什么都不做——那么该纤维交点非空，定理 2.1 便不再适用。其代价是取得进展。 命题 2.4 对此作出了明确说明：一个始终回退到通用动作的验证器是可靠的，但其进展仅限于该动作。 许多已部署的智能体通过请求确认，以隐性的方式采取了这一策略。 当拖延成本较低时，这种做法是合适的；但当任务需要在预算限制下完成时，则不然。

paragraphs.en: Agents can query tools, broadcast their state, write to a shared blackboard [ 26 ] , or delegate the decision to one agent that sees everything. Theorem B.4 characterizes exactly when bounded queries suffice, and Corollary 2.2 shows that communication cannot exceed the joint observation, which full communication trivially attains. These are genuine alternatives to exposing state. They share one requirement with the proposed runtime: the queried fact must exist somewhere in authoritative form. A query for “commands used so far” presupposes an accurate counter; a blackboard presupposes that every writer records its spend. The design choice is therefore between agents pulling authoritative state and a runtime pushing or enforcing it, not between having and not having it. Delegating to an all-seeing agent centralizes reasoning as well as state, which the proposed architecture avoids.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以查询工具、广播自身状态、向共享黑板写入内容 [26]，或者将决策权委托给一个能观察到一切的智能体。 定理 B.4 精确描述了在何种情况下有限的查询就足以解决问题，而推论 2.2 表明通信量不可能超过联合观察所得到的信息量，而完全通信显然能达到这一上限。 这些是替代暴露状态的真正可行方案。 它们与所提出的运行时机制有一个共同要求：被查询的事实必须以权威形式存在于某个地方。 对“迄今使用的命令”的查询预设了准确的计数器；而使用黑板则预设了每个写入者都记录了自己的消耗情况。 因此，设计上的选择在于智能体主动获取权威状态，还是由运行时机制主动推送或强制执行该状态，而非是否存在状态本身。 将决策权委托给一个全知智能体，会将推理过程与状态一并集中化，而这正是所提出的架构所要避免的。

paragraphs.en: The strongest alternative comes from databases. Bailis et al. characterize coordination-free safety relative to an invariant, transaction set, merge operator, common ancestor, and reachable states through invariant confluence [ 9 ] . When every pair of invariant-satisfying states reachable from a common ancestor merges to another invariant-satisfying state, those transactions need no global coordination; conflict-free replicated data types can realize suitable cases by construction [ 70 ] . In the language of Section 3.1 , this is a condition under which the reachable committed local families glue. The independent spend-increment transactions of Proposition 3.3 do not satisfy it under additive merge when m ≥ 2 m\geq 2 and B ≥ 1 B\geq 1 : from the valid common ancestor s = 0 s=0 , one replica commits s 1 = B s_{1}=B and another commits s 2 = B s_{2}=B ; each state satisfies ∑ i s i ≤ B \sum_{i}s_{i}\leq B , but their merge has ∑ i s i = 2 ​ B > B \sum_{i}s_{i}=2B>B . Some coordination or restructuring is therefore necessary. Escrow methods split the bound into local quotas B i B_{i} with ∑ i B i = B \sum_{i}B_{i}=B [ 65 ] . Each quota is a local constraint, so no global check is needed, at the cost of flexibility: one role cannot borrow another’s unused share. Escrow keeps the cover and instead shrinks each local state space to { 0 , … , B i } \{0,\ldots,B_{i}\} ; every tuple of local states then satisfies ∑ i s i ≤ B \sum_{i}s_{i}\leq B , so ρ \rho becomes surjective without a shared ledger scope.
paragraphs.zh: 最强的替代方案来自数据库。 Bailis 等人将无协调安全性相对于一个不变量、事务集、合并算子、共同祖先和可达状态进行了描述，这通过不变量汇合性实现 [9]。 当从共同祖先可达的每对满足不变量的状态合并为另一个满足不变量的状态时，这些事务无需全局协调；冲突自由的复制数据类型可以通过其构造实现合适的情况 [70]。 用第 3.1 节的语言来说，这是一个可达的已提交本地族能够粘合的条件。 在命题 3.3 中，当 m ≥ 2 且 B ≥ 1 时，独立的支出增量事务在加法合并下不满足该条件：从有效的共同祖先 s = 0 出发，一个副本提交 s₁ = B，另一个提交 s₂ = B；每个状态都满足 ∑ᵢsᵢ ≤ B，但它们的合并结果 ∑ᵢsᵢ = 2B > B。 因此，需要某种协调或重构。 托管方法将界限拆分为本地配额 Bᵢ，且满足 ∑ᵢBᵢ = B [65]。 每个配额都是本地约束，因此无需全局检查，但代价是灵活性降低：一个角色无法借用另一个角色的未使用份额。 托管方法保留覆盖范围，而是将每个本地状态空间缩小为 {0, …, Bᵢ}；此时，所有本地状态的元组都满足 ∑ᵢsᵢ ≤ B，因此 ρ 在没有共享账本范围的情况下成为满射。

paragraphs.en: A stronger model, or one trained to track state in context, may be right almost always. The theorems concern worst-case guarantees under missing information. When the relevant distinction is present in the observation, nothing is impossible and learning can close the gap; Theorem B.2 bounds only what is achievable when it is absent. The choice is appropriate when occasional violations are tolerable and inexpensive to detect afterward. The detection-versus-repair results, including Proposition 3.6 , indicate when afterward is expensive.
paragraphs.zh: 一个更强大的模型，或者一个经过训练以在上下文中跟踪状态的模型，几乎总是正确的。 这些定理涉及在信息缺失情况下的最坏情况保证。 当相关的区别存在于观察中时，一切皆有可能，学习可以弥合差距；定理 B.2 仅界定了在区别不存在时可实现的情况。 当偶尔的违规是可以容忍的，并且事后检测成本较低时，这种选择是合适的。 检测与修复的结果（包括命题 3.6）表明，在何种情况下事后处理成本会很高。

paragraphs.en: Transactions, dependency engines, version-aware restarts, residual solvers, and workflow engines already implement parts of the semantics, and Studies III and VI show them tying with the general runtime. Corollary 4.2 predicts this: whenever one mechanism captures the full relevant state relation, it satisfies the required conditions. The general runtime is warranted at boundaries where no single mechanism spans the state, such as a shared budget across roles with different tools, or provenance that crosses artifacts managed by different systems.
paragraphs.zh: 交易、依赖引擎、版本感知重启、残差求解器和工作流引擎已经实现了部分语义，研究 III 和 VI 表明它们与通用运行时相衔接。 推论 4.2 对此做出了预测：只要某个机制能够完整捕捉相关的状态关系，它就能满足所需条件。 在没有任何单一机制覆盖整个状态的边界处，通用运行时的合理性得到了保障，例如不同角色之间共享预算且使用不同工具的情况，或跨越由不同系统管理的数据产物的情况。

paragraphs.en: These baselines were run as the LH2 escape panel of Study IV. The query baseline still overspent in 4/5 runs; the conservative baseline prevented overspend by stopping at 15; and the escrow baseline (executor 14 + verifier 6) matched the shared ledger at 0/5 violations and improved mean partial score on that panel. The frozen reading is that restructuring the local state spaces suffices for this additive budget; a unique shared-ledger claim is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 这些基线模型在研究 IV 的 LH2 逃逸面板中运行。 查询基线模型在 5 次运行中有 4 次仍超出预算；保守基线模型通过在第 15 步停止避免了超支；而托管基线模型（执行者 14 + 验证者 6）在该面板上实现了 0/5 的违规率，并与共享账本一致，同时提升了平均部分得分。 目前的定论是，重构局部状态空间足以满足这种累加预算；无需提出独特的共享账本主张。

paragraphs.en: Section 4.2 states this result in words: re-expressions preserve coherence, and state changes must be checked at commit. Here we state it formally, in the language of prestacks and effective descent, and spell out exactly what is assumed and what follows.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.2 节用文字表述了这一结果：重表达式会保持连贯性，并且状态变更必须在提交时进行检查。 在此，我们使用预栈和有效下降的语言形式化陈述该结论，并明确说明哪些是假设、哪些是推论。

paragraphs.en: Formally, because a groupoid is already a category, one could in principle put every edit and every unit conversion into a single large category. The two classes behave differently under descent (Proposition F.4 ), so the state assignment used for transitions is category-valued, with groupoid core 𝒮 \mathcal{S} for the equivalence level. For each scope U U let 𝒮 𝒞 ​ ( U ) \mathcal{S}_{\mathcal{C}}(U) be a category of local states and local actions, with restriction functors, whose groupoid core is 𝒮 \mathcal{S} . paragraphs.en: The proposition is a preservation theorem. Whether local models are scientifically correct, whether the selected action is useful, whether a coherent target exists for every proposal, and whether the runtime allows sufficient progress are separate questions, corresponding respectively to local truth, planning/objective quality, realizability, and the soundness/progress/completeness distinctions of Appendix B.2 .
