paragraphs.en: The descent proof is extensional: it describes one compatible before/after family. A runtime that commits only part of that family can expose an intermediate state not represented by either descent datum. Atomic commit, or another mechanism that prevents observers from treating the partial family as authoritative, is therefore an execution-level condition for implementing the mathematical transition as one semantic step.
paragraphs.zh: 下降证明是外延性的：它描述了一个兼容的“之前/之后”族。 一个仅提交该族部分内容的运行时，可能会暴露出既未被任一下降数据所表示的中间状态。 因此，原子提交或另一种能防止观察者将部分族视为权威机制的执行级条件，是实现数学转换作为单一语义步骤的关键。

paragraphs.en: Study I realizes this construction and the next one on revision logs. Create paired task instances x , x ′ x,x^{\prime} with identical model-visible prompts, tool descriptions, and local artifacts but different hidden authoritative state such that the required actions are disjoint. Example: the visible task requests a resource-consuming operation while an authoritative shared ledger differs between the two instances. Under the aliased condition, Theorem 2.1 predicts that no deterministic observation-only policy can be correct on both, and Theorem 2.3 bounds randomized success for larger aliased families. The causal intervention exposes exactly the missing ledger field, leaving model, tool set, prompt wording, and inference budget fixed. Success should jump only after the observation partition is refined.
paragraphs.zh: 研究 I 识别出这一构造以及修订日志中的下一个构造。 创建成对的任务实例 x, x′，其模型可见的提示、工具描述和局部工件完全相同，但隐藏的可授权状态不同，从而使得所需动作互不重叠。 示例：可见任务请求一个资源消耗型操作，而两个实例之间的共享授权账本存在差异。 在别名条件下，定理 2.1 预测不存在任何确定性观察-only策略能同时在这两个实例上正确；而定理 2.3 则对更大的别名族中随机化成功的可能性设定了界限。 因果干预恰好暴露了缺失的账本字段，同时保持模型、工具集、提示措辞和推理预算不变。 只有在观察分区被细化之后，成功率才应出现跃升。

sents.en: Study I realizes this construction and the next one on revision logs.

sents.en: Create paired task instances x , x ′ x,x^{\prime} with identical model-visible prompts, tool descriptions, and local artifacts but different hidden authoritative state such that the required actions are disjoint.

sents.en: Example: the visible task requests a resource-consuming operation while an authoritative shared ledger differs between the two instances.
sents.zh: 示例：可见任务请求一个资源消耗型操作，而两个实例之间的共享授权账本存在差异。

sents.en: Under the aliased condition, Theorem 2.1 predicts that no deterministic observation-only policy can be correct on both, and Theorem 2.3 bounds randomized success for larger aliased families.
sents.zh: 在别名条件下，定理 2.1 预测不存在任何确定性观察-only策略能同时在这两个实例上正确；而定理 2.3 则对更大的别名族中随机化成功的可能性设定了界限。

paragraphs.en: Within the aliased condition, increase chain-of-thought budget, number of self-reflection passes, number of agent roles, and communication rounds while keeping the joint observation unchanged. These changes may improve other task components but cannot remove the constructed impossibility. If performance on the aliased decision approaches certainty without new information, then either the instances are not truly aliased, their admissible sets are not actually incompatible, or the system has an unintended information channel. The experiment is therefore a direct test of the theorem’s assumptions as well as the agent architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 在别名条件下，增加思维链预算、自我反思次数、智能体角色数量和通信轮数，同时保持联合观察不变。 这些变化可能会改善任务的其他部分，但无法消除所构建的不可能性。 如果在没有新信息的情况下，别名决策上的表现接近确定性，那么要么这些实例并非真正的别名，要么它们的可行集实际上并非不相容，要么系统存在一个未预期的信息通道。 因此，该实验直接检验了该定理的假设以及智能体架构。

paragraphs.en: Embed parity constraints across a variable number of artifacts or agents. Construct instances for which every subset of at most k k local constraints is satisfiable while the complete family is not, as in Appendix C.2 . Compare validators that inspect only fixed-size neighborhoods against a global parity/linear-algebra validator. Scaling n n with fixed k k tests the claim that no universal fixed local-check order suffices for unrestricted semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 在数量可变的工件或智能体之间嵌入奇偶校验约束。 构造这样的实例：其中任意至多 k 个局部约束的子集均可满足，但完整的约束集合则不可满足，如附录 C.2 所示。 将仅检查固定大小邻域的验证器与全局奇偶校验/线性代数验证器进行比较。 在 k 固定的情况下扩大 n 的规模，可以检验这样一个论断：对于无限制的含义而言，不存在任何通用的固定局部检查顺序足以满足需求。

paragraphs.en: Study VII realizes this construction on ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} labels. Represent one latent object in several coordinate/schema views connected by reversible transforms. Generate coherent instances from random vertex frames and incoherent instances by corrupting one non-tree edge. A spanning-forest validator should detect every corruption that creates nontrivial cycle product in O ⁡ ( | V | + | E | ) O(|V|+|E|) group operations. This experiment directly exercises H + 𝒢 H+\mathcal{G} without requiring a domain-specific engineering representation.
paragraphs.zh: 研究 VII 在 ℤ₂ \mathbb{Z}_{2} 标签上实现了这一构造。 用多个通过可逆变换相互连接的坐标/模式视图来表示一个潜在对象。 从随机顶点框架生成连贯实例，并通过破坏一条非树边生成不连贯实例。 一个生成森林验证器应以 O(|V|+|E|) 次群运算检测出所有会产生非平凡循环积的破坏。 该实验无需特定的领域工程表示，即可直接运用 H + 𝒢 H+\mathcal{G}。

paragraphs.en: For a linear obstruction system, first measure exact detection cost through syndrome computation. Then ask the system to find a minimum-cardinality set of local edits that restores coherence. The theory predicts a qualitative separation: exact detection remains polynomial while optimal repair inherits the hardness of minimum syndrome decoding in the general case. Approximation or heuristic repair can still be practically useful; the claim concerns worst-case exact optimality.
paragraphs.zh: 对于线性阻塞系统，首先通过综合征计算来精确测量检测成本。 然后要求系统找到一个局部编辑的最小基数集合，以恢复一致性。 该理论预测存在一种定性分离：精确检测仍保持多项式复杂度，而最优修复则在一般情况下继承了最小综合征解码的困难性。 近似或启发式修复在实践中仍然可能有用；此论断关注的是最坏情况下的精确最优性。

sents.zh: 对于线性阻塞系统，首先通过综合征计算来精确测量检测成本。

sents.en: Then ask the system to find a minimum-cardinality set of local edits that restores coherence.
sents.zh: 然后要求系统找到一个局部编辑的最小基数集合，以恢复一致性。

paragraphs.en: These constructions give a cleaner empirical program than simply adding more benchmarks. Each benchmark task should identify which theorem assumption it instantiates, what intervention changes that assumption, and what outcome would falsify the predicted mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 这些构建方法比单纯增加更多基准测试能提供更清晰的实证程序。 每个基准测试任务都应明确其实例化的定理假设、改变该假设的干预措施，以及何种结果会推翻所预测的机制。

paragraphs.en: This panel has been run; Section 5.6 reports it. As executed, it injected stale reads, authority changes, and silent reverts into 12 deterministic tasks (four per family) and compared three arms: unguarded, conventional current-state preconditions, and the coherence runtime. The frozen design did not include the separate “normal conversational workflow” arm of the original outline; the stock τ 2 \tau^{2} agent serves as the unguarded arm. The remaining extensions are uninjected frequency measurement, more models, and a redesign of the two tasks in which agents re-read before acting.
paragraphs.zh: 此面板已运行；第 5.6 节对此进行了报告。 在实际执行中，它向 12 个确定性任务（每个任务族四个）注入了陈旧读取、权限变更和静默回滚，并比较了三种方案：无防护组、传统的当前状态先决条件组以及一致性运行时组。 该冻结设计未包含原始大纲中独立的“正常对话工作流程”方案；标准的 τ 2 \tau^{2} 智能体充当无防护组。 其余扩展部分包括未注入的频率测量、更多模型，以及对两个智能体在行动前会重新读取的任务进行重新设计。

sents.zh: 此面板已运行；第 5.6 节对此进行了报告。

paragraphs.en: BixBench3 is attractive because it operates at research-study scale and grades multiple structured outputs derived from public raw data [ 25 ] . The coherence experiment should not ask whether the model “knows biology” better. It should inject controlled changes to an upstream datum, parameter, or method choice and measure whether dependent tables, figures, intermediate analyses, and conclusions are correctly invalidated and regenerated. This directly tests H + 𝒞 + ℱ + D H+\mathcal{C}+\mathcal{F}+D in a domain whose local truth mechanism is the released analysis and deterministic grader. The model can remain responsible for interpretation and tool use; the experiment measures whether the surrounding state semantics keeps the derivation current.
paragraphs.zh: BixBench3 之所以具有吸引力，是因为它在研究级规模上运行，并对源自公开原始数据的多种结构化输出进行评分 [25]。 连贯性实验不应询问模型是否“更了解生物学”。 该实验应向上游的数据、参数或方法选择注入受控的变化，并测量依赖的表格、图表、中间分析和结论是否被正确失效并重新生成。 这直接测试了 H + 𝒞 + ℱ + D（H+\mathcal{C}+\mathcal{F}+D），在一个其局部真理机制为已发布分析和确定性评分器的领域中进行。 模型仍可负责解释和工具使用；该实验测量的是周围状态语义是否使推导过程保持当前有效。

paragraphs.en: Studies VII and VIII already close the deterministic cycle suite and a multi-year real-data prevalence check, and Study IX covers both full-view and split-view agents. Remaining work: repair routing for split-view merges, and agent-facing metamorphic tasks built from known semantics-preserving transforms (schema rename, units, frames, serialization, identifier renaming, harmless reorderings, behavior-preserving refactors) and from the concrete holonomy failures Study VIII found, with non-equivalent near-neighbors so that collapsing every change into one class cannot pass. For equivalent states x ≃ x ′ x\simeq x^{\prime} , evaluate invariance or equivariance
paragraphs.zh: 研究 VII 和 VIII 已经完成了确定性循环套件以及为期多年的真实数据流行率检查，而研究 IX 则涵盖了全视图和分视图智能体。 剩余工作：修复分视图合并的路由问题，以及基于已知语义保持转换（模式重命名、单位、帧、序列化、标识符重命名、无害的重排序、行为保持的重构）和研究 VIII 发现的具体的整体性失败所构建的智能体相关形态变化任务，同时确保非等价的近邻存在，以避免将所有变化归入同一类别的做法能够通过验证。 对于等价状态 x ≃ x ′ x\simeq x^{\prime}，评估其不变性或协变性。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench and OSWorld are valuable future tests because they provide persistent executable environments, not because every task is inherently a coherence task. Select or construct subsets with explicit dependency closure, cross-file or cross-application invariants, version changes, or terminal commit requirements. The theory predicts little or no gain on tasks that are purely local and one-shot. That negative prediction should be tested rather than hidden.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 和 OSWorld 是有价值的未来测试，因为它们提供了持久的可执行环境，而不是因为每个任务本质上都是连贯性任务。 选择或构建具有明确依赖闭合、跨文件或跨应用不变量、版本变更或最终提交要求的子集。 该理论预测，对于纯粹局部且单次执行的任务，收益很少甚至没有。 这种负面预测应当被验证，而不是被隐藏。

paragraphs.en: If two enabled actions preserve each other’s enabledness and commute on state, then swapping their order leaves the final semantic state unchanged. Classical trace theory identifies schedules related by adjacent swaps of independent actions. Thus k k mutually independent actions have k ! k! sequential interleavings but only one trace class. This is a trajectory-level analogue of symmetry quotienting: explicit semantics can remove redundant schedules without conflating genuinely interacting actions.
paragraphs.zh: 如果两个已启用的动作能够相互保持对方的启用状态，并且在状态上可交换，那么交换它们的顺序不会改变最终的语义状态。 经典迹理论将那些通过独立动作的相邻交换而相关的调度识别出来。 因此，k 个相互独立的动作有 k! 种序列交织方式，但只有一个迹类。 这是轨迹层面对称性商化的一个类比：显式语义可以在不混淆真正相互作用的动作的前提下，移除冗余的调度。

paragraphs.en: The main impossibility result has a particularly direct interpretation for agent design.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的不可能性结果对于智能体设计而言具有一个尤为直接的解读。

paragraphs.en: Adding an agent role whose initial view is a deterministic function of already available information cannot refine the joint observation partition. Such a role may improve computation but cannot remove an aliasing impossibility.
paragraphs.zh: 添加一个智能体角色，其初始视图是已有信息的确定性函数，无法优化联合观察划分。 这样的角色或许能提升计算效率，但无法消除别名冲突的不可能性。

paragraphs.en: Longer chain-of-thought or more sampling can improve proposal quality inside one information state, but Theorem 2.3 gives families where success remains information-limited.
paragraphs.zh: 更长的思维链或更多的采样可以在单一信息状态内提升提案质量，但定理 2.3 给出了一些族，在这些族中，成功仍然受限于信息。

paragraphs.en: External tool calls can remove impossibility only if they return genuinely new state information or change the world so that a common valid action emerges; Theorem B.4 states exactly when a bounded number of queries suffices. Merely reformatting or re-reasoning over the same evidence cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 外部工具调用只有在返回真正新的状态信息或改变世界以产生一个有效的通用动作时，才能消除不可能性；定理 B.4 明确指出了在何种情况下有限次查询就足够了。 仅仅对相同证据进行重新格式化或重新推理是无法做到这一点的。

paragraphs.en: A semantic runtime need not expose all authoritative state to the model. It may maintain compressed sufficient statistics, version vectors, obstruction syndromes, or equivalence frames outside the prompt and use them at validation/commit time.
paragraphs.zh: 语义运行时不必向模型暴露所有权威状态。 它可以在提示词之外维护压缩后的充分统计量、版本向量、阻塞综合征或等价帧，并在验证/提交时使用它们。

paragraphs.en: Safety-only evaluation is incomplete. A reject-all runtime is sound. Agent systems should separately measure soundness, progress, and completeness, plus task quality conditional on admissible execution.
paragraphs.zh: 仅评估安全性是不完整的。 拒绝所有输入的运行时是可靠的。 智能体系统应分别衡量可靠性、进展和完整性，以及在有许可执行条件下的任务质量。

sents.en: Safety-only evaluation is incomplete.
sents.zh: 仅评估安全性是不完整的。

sents.zh: 拒绝所有输入的运行时是可靠的。

sents.en: Agent systems should separately measure soundness, progress, and completeness, plus task quality conditional on admissible execution.
sents.zh: 智能体系统应分别衡量可靠性、进展和完整性，以及在有许可执行条件下的任务质量。

paragraphs.en: The theory proves targeted statements: certain information deficits make correct action impossible; certain structural classes admit local-to-global reconstruction while unrestricted classes do not; certain representation-consistency problems have efficient exact certificates; and temporal/action semantics determine a minimum amount of state that cannot be removed without changing legal futures. These are deliberately more precise than blanket claims that every global property is hard, that every local agent architecture fails, that explicit semantic state guarantees optimality, or that one formalism dominates all domains.
paragraphs.zh: 该理论证明了若干具体论断：某些信息缺失会使正确行动成为不可能；某些结构类别允许从局部到全局的重建，而无限制的类别则不允许；某些表示一致性问题存在高效的精确证明；此外，时间/行动语义学决定了状态的一个最小量，若移除该部分而又不改变合法的未来路径，则是不可能的。 这些论断有意比那些笼统的断言更为精确——例如，并非所有全局属性都难以处理，也并非所有局部智能体架构都会失败，显式的语义状态并不必然保证最优性，也没有哪一种形式化方法在所有领域中都占据主导地位。

sents.en: The theory proves targeted statements: certain information deficits make correct action impossible; certain structural classes admit local-to-global reconstruction while unrestricted classes do not; certain representation-consistency problems have efficient exact certificates; and temporal/action semantics determine a minimum amount of state that cannot be removed without changing legal futures.
sents.zh: 该理论证明了若干具体论断：某些信息缺失会使正确行动成为不可能；某些结构类别允许从局部到全局的重建，而无限制的类别则不允许；某些表示一致性问题存在高效的精确证明；此外，时间/行动语义学决定了状态的一个最小量，若移除该部分而又不改变合法的未来路径，则是不可能的。

sents.en: These are deliberately more precise than blanket claims that every global property is hard, that every local agent architecture fails, that explicit semantic state guarantees optimality, or that one formalism dominates all domains.
sents.zh: 这些论断有意比那些笼统的断言更为精确——例如，并非所有全局属性都难以处理，也并非所有局部智能体架构都会失败，显式的语义状态并不必然保证最优性，也没有哪一种形式化方法在所有领域中都占据主导地位。

paragraphs.en: These boundaries are part of the contribution: the theory tells an AI systems designer when more model intelligence can help and when the bottleneck lies elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 这些界限是贡献的一部分：该理论告诉人工智能系统设计师，在何种情况下模型智能的提升会有所帮助，而在何种情况下瓶颈则存在于其他方面。
